Ani binigo ainde agali haguane-o iname dabo handalu kamaria wali agali uruni tigua mana ko mbira bialu Ngode Datagaliwabenaga bi mana lo winigo mo habolo heagua nde iname puwa wai bialu ina wayali holeberemago mali̱ya.
Anigo iname handalu kamaria tigua ko bini mbira nawiyagua nde ti helo waholene karulapego irane Ngode Datagaliwabe tinaga Anduane Homogo kagome ti baya hanguore handaya ho kagola ina wali agali dindi bibahendeha bu karunaga deni taga tene handa walia holene dege wulebirago helo wahami̱ya, lene.
Agiohanda bi lai hayagola agali maru Holoberenesenaga balai anda tamuha heyu homabu bu hearume bi lagalaga bialu keba hai hene. Ani lalu howa Holoberenesenaga ami agali haru haga hearumebi agali iba solowara angeha haga hearumebi Moabali bu hearumebi bi hongo howa lalu, Agio ibu homolene karulape, lai hene.
Ani lowa lalu, Irane agome Isaraele wali agali gi haramabe. Tinaga hongo nawiore howa tigua ina baba wai nabulebira.
Agali haguane-o í̠naga ami agalime abaleore bope holebirago ai ina abaleore áyu ogoni ma, lene.
Agali ho mabu biaru tigua keba howa bi lai heagola Asirianaga ami hearunaga agali haguane Holoberenesehanda heyuwa Agiohondo keba howa agali tara hearunaga denibi Amononaga ami agali hearunaga deni howabi lai lene.
Ibugua lalu, Í̠ Agio kegonibi tí maru Isaraelenaga biabe bia haga kemirubi tígua manda bialu kemiria ti ai kemada lo manda bidemibe. Í̠na lalu, Tínaga Ngode Datagaliwabehanda tí baya hangu handaya ho holebirago iname Isaraele baba wai nabimi̱ya, laribe. Ai Ngode Datagaliwabe ogoni ibu ai kabe. Nebugadenesa ibu inanaga Ngode Datagaliwabe kagoni ndobe. Ibunaga ami agali karu ibilalu Isaraele bibahende bo wahaiore holebirago ndobe. Tínaga Ngode Datagaliwabe kagome ti biamogo nabulebira.
Ina Nebugadenesa ibunaga biabe bia haga kemarume ti bo wahai holene erekui nabi ti yamo daga nawini mbira ka. Tigua inanaga ami agali nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga hongo gibihe karunaga hongo bope habe nahe ka.
Iname balu bo hedaore holeberema. Ani beremagola tínaga daramame hari bare ngaru bu dambi hai halu homene tinginime dindi tigabi ngaru ereba hai holebira. Tí ina baba hongo karula nape ka. Tí aria lenego mbiraoreli hangubi yu wahene nahe loleberema. Bi o larogoni dindi bibahendenaga agali haguane timbuniore kago Kini Nebugadenesanaga bi laro. Ai ibunaga bi ogoni lo wa naholebiraore.
Anigo Agio í̠ Amonoali ami ko mbira kegoni. Ai i̱naga waitigi mbira henedane áyu handa walia ko. Í̠na i̱naga dengui nahende keore dege i̱na hameigini Iyibi dindiha howa ibida ibini uruni bo wahaiore holebero.
I̱na dai berongi ami agali tigua í̠ ayu tibume dibaragola í̠naga tingini agali bo wahene ngaru dege dombeneha wulebere.
Áyu í̠ i̱naga biabe biaga agali tigua haru halu hari bare ngagoha puwa tano mbira harigani kaware ngagoria helolebira.
Í̠ áyu ogo homabelo ndo mani Isaraele wali agali baba mandagi homabelo.
Í̠na manda bialu keria iname ti babe nahe ko lo manda bu heagua nde í̠naga miniha genda aginaga yu kebe. Ai ogoni hangu i̱naga bi lai haru. I̱naga bi ogoni bame lo waholene nawiore, lene.
Ai Holoberenesehanda agali ibunaga biabe biaga hearuhondo lamialu, Tígua Agio gi geru minu daba haga bialu yalu puwa Bedulia tano ngagoria Isaraele bu karu milimu, lene.
Ani layagola tigua Agio gi geru minu daba haga buwa yalu dindi tigabi wiagoha pupe halu pene. Ani pu dege bialu hari bare wiagoha puabo halu Bedulia tano wiago andaneha iba uli wiagoria anda pene.
Ani piyagola agali tano ogoniha hayadarume ami agali ibiyago tinaga danda timu yandere wiaru mo yalu haru bare wiagoha piai hene. Ani pu howa agali maru ege to̱le̱ timbuni pume hendeho yuwa baga mugube hearume waitigi ibiyaru hari bareha irigi halu naibilo hariga handai halu hene.
Ani piyagola ami agali biaru ti ege to̱le̱ timbuni heagoha birado hene. Tigua pume Agionaga gi geru minu kabu buwa hari heago teneha ngelene. Ngelalu tinaga agali haguane hearia dai bini.
Ti Isaraele tano yu wahalu ti daliape howa handalu hearia Agio ibu palearia hendene. Ani hondowa pume gi geru daba heago hadape halu Bedulia tano haru pene. Puwa tanonaga agali haguane berearu deni heyu helene.
Horo ogoningi Simeono hameigini aria Maiga igini Usiabi Odoniele igini Kabarisibi Melegiele igini Kamisibi ti agali haguane hene.
Tigua tanonaga agali hearu ibidaba layagola urunibi igiri daliahe hearubi wali berearubi mo ngoai hagane wiagoria íbu ngoai hene. Agio ibu agali biaru dombeneha heagola Usiahanda ibuhondo, Bibahende biyadarunaga te la, lene.
Ani layagola Agiohanda ladai bialu mbirale bibahende abale ti Holoberenese baba mo ngoai howa bi lene biago lamiai hene. Ani bialu bi ibunime Asiria biaruhondo layarubi lamia dege bini. Ani lalu mine halu bi mbira Holoberenese ibugua Isaraele mege bialu layagobi lamia dege bini.
Wali agalime Agiohanda bi layago hale howa tinaga dengui dindini paliape howa Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lalu hene.
Tigua Anduane Homogo dahuliya andaganaga Ngode Datagaliwabe olowa lalu, Waitigime inahondo tiga nabi ngago bialu kagoni de handalu ina taga timbuni ho kamarubi de hondowa biamogo bibe. Ani bialu ina í̠naga wali agali kemaruhondo bu mini gubaliniha daraho haabo habe, lene.
Ani lowa tigua Agionaga bu miniha mo hongo halu mo turu howa
bi lo mbira hai howa Usiahanda Agio haru halu ibu andaga puwa ibugua agali haguane bu hearunaga tomo timbuniore dawa manda manda bini. Ai horo ogoningi mbiraga tigua Isaraele wali agalinaga Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ti biamogo bilonaga bi lene. Tigua Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lalu heaore dege gao lene.
Horo mendengi Holoberenese ibugua ibunaga ami agali hearubi ami agali tara ibu biamogo bialu wai mogo ibini hayarubi bibahendehondo ogodagua bidaba lalu wai hono miai hene. Tihondo lalu, Tígua egerebagi gao laragola abale heyalu puwa Bedulia tano ho hagira bialu hariga uyura hari neneha irigi halu piaga ngago hapai howa tanoha Isaraele wali agali baba wai bilimu, lene.
Horo ogoningi dege ami agali uruni ti heyalu abale pene. Ami agali geni piaga bibahende daosini dege handari mbirani pira karia (170,000) bibahende hene. Ami agali nogo hosi erekunini biruwa wai biagaru daosini homberia (12,000) hene. Ani bialu ami agali dewaore nu dabudabu wiaru yilo helene. Uruni bibahende biamaga hayagola daga labe naheore hene.
Tigua puwa Bedulia tano wiagonaga dindi ulini iba hambiaga bereagoria balai anda bini. Tigua anda bu henedago timbuniorenaga arane mendehayagi Bedulia tano howa pialu amuraore Siamono wiagoria tagira pene. Mendehayagi nde Dodana tano ngagoria howa bima pialu Balabaimi ngagoria tagira pene. Siamono ogoni Yaserili tanohayagi handa dai biaga wini.
Isaraele tigua ami agali daga labe nahe dewaore íbu heago hondowa ti gi timbuniore ho howa tini dege dege ladene bialu lalu, Ami agali dewaore kagome tomo ngago damene bibahende nai holobada. Hari timbuni wedarubi dindi tigabi ngarubi hari emene wedarubi tinaga genda nayulubada, lene.
Ani lalu agali mbira mbira bibahendeme wai bulene ale yagayaga bialu pabe neneni mamage haga anda heagoria ira delowa mamage halu egabi lene.
Ani bialu egerebagi Holoberenesehanda ami agali nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga hearu bibahende dindi tigabi hamama bayale wiagoria haru tagira ibuwa wai dagia bayago Isaraele wali agali Bedulia tanoha hearume hari bare wiagoria howa handabe halu hendene.
Ibugua tanoha hariga irigi halu polene wiago baya hangu handalu iba hambiaga uli wiarubi baya hanguore deme handaiore hene. Iba hambiaga uli wiaru bibahendeore ibu karulai howa ibunaga ami agalirume mamage howa handaya ho helalu ibunaga balai anda hayadagoha dai bini.
Ani biyagola Idomo agali haguane hearubi Moaba agali haguane hearubi wali agali iba solowara bedago ange ange paluyu pedarunaga agali haguane hearubi bibahende Holoberenese hearia ibuwa tigua ibuhondo lamialu lalu,
Agali haguane-o í̠na mini iname ngemago taliriyagua nde í̠naga ami agali karuni bai naholebira.
Isaraele tinaga hongo holene danda timuha nawi hari bare timbuni ngagoha ngelo ka. Ani laramago irane áyu hari bare ngagoha irigi halu wali agali ti kagoha anda polene nakarulape kemagoni ndobe.
Anigo agali haguane-o í̠na wai tiga tiga nabiriyagua í̠naga ami agali maru bo biba holebira.
Wahalu í̠naga ami agaliru haru howa tinaga balai anda kagoria hondo holene nga. Anigo agali í̠naga biabe biaga karume iba hambiaga uli hari teneha ngaru dege baya hangu mamage howa handaya ho holene nga.
Ani laramago irane wali agali Bedulia tanoha karu ti iba ogoniha dege hambu ibagaya. Tigua iba noahalu homabehe ngagola tinaga tano ngago inanaga giha ya holebira. Inanaga agali karu heba iname hari nene ngago irigi howa balai anda kaware biapara howa wali agali maru ibida tagira poligonaga mamage hole poloma̱ya.
Wali agalibi waneiginibi bibahende hina garime homai holebira. Iname bo polene henge nawi. Tini minana homalu tinaga tingini hariga tene ngaruha homo wima polebira.
Tigua í̠naga bi mo wahalu tini í̠naga giha ya nahayagonaga pani ogoni, lene.
Ani layagola Holoberenese halu ibunaga ami agali haru haga bu hearu tigua hariga ogoni bayaleoreda lowa tini lo mbira halu tigua, Agali maru mamage hole pudaba, lene.
Ani laya handala Moaba ami agali hearu heba Asiria ami daosini duria heba (5,000) ti haru mandagi hole pene. Tigua puwa balai anda hari tene wiagoria bialu Isaraele wali agali iba hambu piaga hariga wiagoria hapai hene.
Ani helalu Idomo amibi Amono amibi tigua hari bare wiagoria Dodana tano handabe howa balai anda bu hene. Ani bialu maru dindi abene unurahayagi pelalu maru amu ni tagira ibiragohayagi iba Mogomu poragoha dindi mini Kusi dindi kawareni Agaraba tano ngagoha hole pelene. Asiria tini dindi tigabi bayale wiagoria balai anda bu hene. Ti dindi ogoniha wiago bibahendeni haiore hene. Tinaga balai anda heagobi tinaga dabu dabu wialubi bibahende daga labe nahe dewaore wini.
Isaraele wali agali ti waitigime ho hagira biyagola tigua ibida pora bialu polene hariga nawiore howa mogo timbuni lalu gi howa tigua Ngode Datagaliwabe tinaga Anduane Homogo olalu ti biamogo bia lowa bi lalu hene.
Asiria ami agali hearume ami agali damene hearubi ami agali nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga hearubi garo nogo hosime gililagani heyu howa wai biaga hearubi bibahendeme Isaraele wali agali ho hagira bu heane dege horo pira tebirani maria (34) hene. Ani heagola Bedulia tano wali agalinaga iba be todobene wiaruha iba nabere bameore wiai hene.
Ani bialu tanoha iba hambiaga uli wiarubi iba nabere iba biba hai habeheore wini. Ani biyagola tigua horo mbira mbiranaga iba emene ogoni tale bigi bialu wali agali bibahende nai helo manda bialu tale bigi bialu hene.
Ainde waneigini galiru mo ko halu homabehe wiai hene. Ani bialu wali berearubi igiri daliahe hearubi bibahende de mborere bialu hariga timbuni pearuhabi tanonaga wai pabe heagonaga pabe panga heago kawarenibi odopeho wima pene. Ani bialu ti hongo naheore wini.
Anidagua biyagola wali agali bibahende bu hearubi waneigini bu hearubi bibahende ibalu Usia halu agali haguane biaru bereagoria ho mabu bu howa bi hongo howa ladagadaga bialu lai lalu hene. Tigua lalu,
Ngode Datagaliwabe ibunime tinaga miniha ngemigobi inanaga miniha ngemagobi mo tale bulebira. Ai tígua Asiria ami bialu baba bi lalu mo palia holene wiago waharimigome ko timbuniore inahondo birimi.
Áyuore ina pele ngulene mbira naheore. Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ina waitiginaga giha minu ya hayagoni ndobe. Ami agalirume tanoha anda ibuwa handalu karia ina bibahende iba noa howa homai halu tingini dindini wima pedaria hondolobada.
Ainde wahalu Holoberenesenaga ami agali biaru heba ami agali marubi tanoha ibidaba lowa tano bibahende ti mialu mbirale tanoha ngarubi mo ko halu mo page yai hole ibidaba lalu oladaba.
Ina garabaya hangu biragola garabaya biabe ale bia haga howa biabe bialu holene karulape wialu ina abale homolenego nakarulapeda. Iname ogonidagua birimayagua nde ina homa nabi holeberema. Ina waneigini gali bu karu homaragola inane de hondolene nakarulapebi ani bialu walibi waneiginibi mo ko heneore bedago hondolene nakarulapeore holobada.
Iname heneneore laramago ai Ngode Datagaliwabe ibunime ti maname mo daba ki bulene karulape. Ibuni Ngode Datagaliwabe ina mamalirunaga Anduane Homogo kago ibugua mana ko iname bialu kemagonaga pani ngialu inanaga mamalirume ko biyagonaga pani ngia dege biaga kago ainde mbirale ko uruni inaha anda naibilo ibunihondo bi lama, lene.
Ani lowa wali agali bu hearu bibahendeme dugu bialu bi hongo howa ladaga halu Ngode Datagaliwabe tinaga Anduane Homogo kagohondo bi lalu hene.
Ani lalu heagola Usia ibugua tihondo lamialu lalu, Hameneru-o áyu tígua hongo ho ala holene karulape nga. Abale gede holene nawigo harugo lowa horo duriane agima hondo hami̱ya. Horo ogoningi Ngode Datagaliwabe inanaga Anduane Homogo kagome ina wahalu napolebirago harugo lowa malia howa holene nga.
Ai horo dauru ogoni piai haragola ina mo wialu biamogo bulene mbira nawiyagua nde tígua laramigonidagua bimi̱ya, lene.
Ani lalu Usiahanda wali agali uruni tini biabe bialu hagadaruha hole pudaba lene. Agali ti wai pabe neneni mamage agalirunaga anda mamage helo biama irigi hene hearuha hole pudaba lalu, Wali waneiginiru tí nde tíni andaga dai bidaba, lene. Anigo tano ogoniha wali agali bu hearunaga bu miniha genda timbuni ngelo hene.
Horo ogoningi mbirale uruni bira layagola Yudidi ibu hale hene. Yudidi ibu Merari wane berene. Merari ibu Oso igini howa Oso ibu Yosebe igini hene. Yosebe ibu Osiele igini halu Osiele ibu Elegia igini halu Elegia ibu Ananaiasa igini hene. Ananaiasa ibu Gideono igini hene. Gideono ibu Labaimi igini hene. Labaimi ibu Ahidubu igini hene. Ahidubu ibu Elaya igini hene. Elaya ibu Hiligia igini halu Hiligia ibu Eliaba igini hene. Eliaba ibu Nadaniele igini halu Nadaniel ibu Selumiele igini hene. Selumiele ibu Surisadai igini halu Surisadai ibu Yagaba igini hene.
Yudidi agalini mini Manase henego ibu nde Yudidila libu hameigini mbiraore damenela pene. Ainde agali ogoni ibu mabuha balawa wabiaga mini bali mabuha howa lini dearu gandu lowa mo mogobu wigi bialu hearia homene.
Ai agali Manase ogoni ibugua agali maru bali lini deago gandulo mogo bialu heago haru heagola nime ibunaga haguaneni hongoheore daba hayagola ibu andaga pialu Bedulia tanoha ibuni dagiani palearia homene. Ai ibunaga tingini ibu aba mamaru hora heagoria dege Dodana tano Balamono tanola hengene wiagoria hora hene.
Ani bialu Yudidi ibu dara howa duguanda mali tebirani ege maria ibuni daluha biraabo hene.
Ibu anda dangini tigabi mbarale wiagoria hobane mbira bia howa ibugua ogoriani dara howa biagane aga karulo biraga berene.
Ibu dara ho birayadagoha biruwa tomo dewa nane wahowa berene. Anigo ai Sabada horo mendengi hole lowa horo pigane harangibi horo Sabada ibuni tagira ibirangibi horo timbuni malinaga ege pigane ngabulo mbiraga piganengibi horo ogoni ibuni tagira ibirangibi horo Isaraele tinaga Ngode Datagaliwabe bi lolene tagira ibirangi tinaga horo timbuni turu ho haga winigo tagira ibirangibi horo uruni bibahende ibirangi Yudidi ibu tomo wanahe nolene ngadagua naga berene.
Ai Yudidi ibu wali baya tara mbira ibunaga dengui bayaore wali maru berearubi ndo ibu bayaore mbira berene. Ainde ibu agalini Manase homayagola muni ngolo dewaorebi wali agali biabe biaga hearubi nogo bibahendebi maburubi dindibi ibuni karulai hene. Ani karulai howa Yudidi ibuni handaya ho haga berene.
Bi wahalu wali agalibi mbiralime ibuhondo bi ko mbira lade habe naheore ibu Ngode Datagaliwabe andaneha biraabo howa bi lalu biraga berene.
Wali agali bu hearume ti iba nalu holene nawidagome tiha mo ko holene timbuniore wiyada lowa tigua keba howa Usiahondo lai lalu heago Yudidi ibu hale ho berene. Ani bialu Usiahanda bi layago leagola horo duria howa tano ogoni Asiria ami agali karuhondo mimi̱ya lalu gi dolalu lo wiyagobi Yudidi ibu hale hadege bini.
Ani hale howa Yudidihanda wali mbira ibunaga mbirale ngago damene bibahende handaya ho hai haga bereagohondo lamialu, Usiabi Kabarisibi Kamasibi tanonaga agali haguane tebirali uruni i̱ bedoria ibidaba laya lalu lamule pu, lene.
Agali tebirali uruni ibiyagola ibugua tihondo lamialu lalu, Tí Bedulia tanonaga agali haguane bedemiru tígua bi i̱na larogo hale hadaba. Tígua wali agalihondo bi áyu lamirimigo nakarulape larimi. Tígua mbirale buleore lowa Anduane Homogonaga deni howa gi dolowa lalu Anduane Homogohanda horo duria ogoniha ina biamogo nabiyagua nde tigua tano ogo waitigi giha mo ya hami̱ya larimiya.
Anigo tí ai howa tígua horo duria ko tagira ibirangi Ngode Datagaliwabe kago bahondolene manda birimibe. Tígua Ngode Datagaliwabe bolangua halu tí daliga holene manda bu kemibe.
Tígua Anduane Homogo Bibahendenaga Hongo Haihe kago bahondolene manda birimida. Tí mini nawiore harimida lo manda bido.
Tígua agalinaga bu habaneha manda bu kago ogoale bu ka lalu manda biade habe naheore kemigoni ndobe. Ani bialu agalinaga miniha yado kago handabe naheore kemigoni ndobe. Ani ngago ai tígua Ngode Datagaliwabe ibu mbirale ngago wabiai haga kagonaga miniha wu kago agua handa walia holeberemibe. Mbaliniru-o darabioredago tígua Anduane Homogo inanaga Ngode Datagaliwabe kago ibugua ina baba keba helo tígua mo keba nahalimu.
Ibugua ina horo duria uruni andaneha howa biamogo bua nahayagua nde horo tara mendengi biamogo bulene hongohe karulape ka.
Ina Anduane Homogo inanaga Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mini hamelo ngago handaya ho hagane ndo kema. Iname mo giha ladebodebo bia bulene Ngode Datagaliwabe ibu ina wali agali kamago ale ndo ka.
Ani kago manda bialu iname hondo howa ibugua ina dara halu biamogo angi birabe hondole ema nabi howa biamogo bia lowa ibunihondo olalu haabo holene nga. Inanaga dugu bialu kemago ibunaga hameme hale hoa biyagua nde hale holebira.
Bamba ina mamaliru howa hama ibinigo áyu kemagoni howa hameigini mbiralimebi dindi gibuni podenehayagi habagi ho henemebi aba igini emene mbiramebi mbirale dama mitangi bialu bi pupu wule gime wabini wiaruhondo bi pupu nawi hama ibinigo áyu kemagoni ndobe. Bambaore inanaga mamali alaore headarume nde dama mitangi bialu bi pupu wule gime wabini wiaruhondo bi pupu wialu heneya.
Anidagua bialu hemiria Ngode Datagaliwabehanda tí waitigi giha pilopaga helayagola bibahende tini homai halu mbirale wiarubi mo page biai helalu biyagola ti bibahende ko hai hene.
Ani binigo áyu iname bi pupu wule gime wabini urunialehondo pupu nawi wahai halu iname Anduane Homogo ibuni inanaga Ngode Datagaliwabe kago ibu hanguhondo bi lalu kema. Ani bialu haga kemago manda bialu ibugua ina bame handaya naholebirago iname ibuhondo mini mbiraore wu holene nga.
Hale hadaba. Waitigime anda ibalu ina balu wayali hayagua nde Yudia wali agali bibahende bo hana hai holebira. Ani bialu Ngode Datagaliwabenaga anda kago heba bo gialo wahai holebira. Ani biragola Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ibunaga anda barago pani inanaga darama poragome holebira.
Ina damene bo wahayaguabi maru garabaya yalu piyaguabi uruni iname bia ko hene mbira ngane hondowa bulebira. Ani bialu dindi inanaga mamalirunaga hiha howa bame ngini yu harimago bo gialo wahai halu bo labu hayagobi nde iname bia ko haramagome dege bulebira. Ani bialu ina garabaya biabe ale bialu kemagola tigua ina mo taga haragola waitigime ina mo taga timbuni halu kagome ina tinaga deni ko galone nabulene mbirago holeberema.
Ani birangi mbiralime dara holene nawulebira, lalu Yudidihanda lene.
Yudidi ibugua laabo halu lalu, Ani bulebirago ai mbaliniru-o ina damene bu karuhondo mana bayalego bu walia hami̱ya. Ai tinaga holene bibahende inanaga giha ngagoni ndobe. Ani bialu Ngode Datagaliwabenaga andabi ibunaga lomabu delaga dabubi inanaga giha dege nga.
Iname Anduane Homogo inanaga Ngode Datagaliwabe kagome bamba ina mamali bahandalu henedagua áyu inabi bahandaragoni.
Ibugua Abarahamahondo biyagobi Aisagahondo genda mo miyagobi Yagaba ibugua ibu hanini Labananaga nogo sibi hinalu Mesobodemia heangi biyarubi iname manda budai bulene nga.
Ngode Datagaliwabehanda agali uruni tinaga miniha agile ngabe hondolenaga ti henemane bahandaga binigo. Ai áyu inahondo ogonidagua bahanda ndo bira. Inaha genda mo ngiyaruni mana ko iname bialu harimago pani karulape ndo ngiya. Ai Ngode Datagaliwabehanda wali agali ibuni kagoria kaware hapara ho kagohondo lawai halu genda holene mo miaga ka, lene.
Ani layagola Usiahanda Yudidihondo ladai bialu lalu, Í̠na bi lariruni bibahende henene ngago lai hari. Mbiralime í̠na bi lariruni mo nagalone naholebira.
Áyu í̠naga mini manda bayale latagi haregoni áyu pigane ndo latagi hare. Bamba í̠ wandari berengi howa mini manda bayale í̠ha ngago latagi halu mana bayale ngago bu walia halu biraga bedegoni.
Anigo ainde wali agalime iba noleneore nawidagola tigua lo hongo halu iname buleore lalu habo nalolene bi ogoni lo widaba lalu ka. Ani bialu iname buleore lalu gi dolalu lo widaba lara.
Í̠ wali mini mbiraorewi bedegola í̠ore birarigonigo ainde Anduane Homogohondo inanaga bi lahabe. Bi halu mende Anduane Homogohanda iba dalu ibilalu inanaga iba hambiaga uli ngaru iba biru to̱laragola ina iba nalu hongohe holoma̱ya iba biru to̱lelo bi labe, lene.
Ani layagola Yudidihanda ladai bialu lalu, Hale harene. Ai inanaga waneigini aguane aguanalioremebi embeda naholene mbira i̱na bule manda bido.
Áyu mbiraga wali i̱naga biabe biaga bedago iya tagira polobaya tigua wai pabe panga dugupe hole manda manda bu halimu. Í̠na horo manda bialu tano ogo waitigi giha ya hole lalu bi lo wirigo tagira naibi ngaore dege Ngode Datagaliwabenaga hongoni howa i̱nime ina Isaraele wali agalinaga genda timbuni ngagoni mo wahai holebero.
Í̠na agile bulebe lalu i̱nihondo hale nahalimu. I̱na tíhondo ogoale bule lalu langia nabi howa buledago bupe harogola handalimulo, lene.
Usia halu agali haguane hearume bi ogoni hale howa tigua Yudidihondo lamialu lalu, Ngode Datagaliwabe ibunime í̠ handaya ho holebirago í̠ pu. Anduane Homogo í̠ heba kago ibunime waitigime inahondo mana ko bialu karuhondo pani mulebira, lene.
Ani lalu ti Yudidi andaga wahalu tini mamage hagane wiyagoria hole pene.
Ani lalu Yudidi ibu pialu anda tamu biragane wiagoria bulu palu wini. Ibugua aga dara howa karulolene wiago karulaabo ho biruwa be abalu ibunaga haguaneni dugu hiruwa berene. Ani biruwa ai tigua Yarusaleme ira hagua ngabi biaga lomabu delalu howa Yudidi ibugua Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi hongo howa ladaga halu lalu,
Anduane Homogo-o í̠ i̱naga mamali Simeononaga Ngode Datagaliwabeore kego í̠na agali dindi tarali hearume mana ko í̠na nabulene nga lalu lo wirigo biyagola í̠na Simeonohondo tiga bule pu lalu ayu tibu nene kirabaliha gadele wiago ibuhondo mirigoni. Agali tara urunime Simeono halu ti mbalini wandari mabuage bereagonaga aga minu budalu mana ko bule bialu hene. Ani buwa tigua aga budu wahai howa wandari ogoni kayu minalu mo ko hene.
Ani biyagola í̠na agali uruni tinaga agali haguane hearu tini dagia wali kayu biyagoria howa dege bo wahai harigoni. Í̠na agali biabe bia haga hearu heba tinaga agali haguane hearubi bo wahai halu handaya ho haga hearu bo wahai halu tinaga garabaya biabe ale bia halu haga hearubi heba bo wahai harigoni.
Í̠nime tinaga one wane berearu garabaya piai helalu tinaga dabudabu damene wiaru bibahende í̠ waneigini bayale bu hearu mo tahaga birigoni. Waneigini uruni tigua í̠naga mana lo ngago baya hangu taluwa bulene hame lo haga hene. Tigua mana ko tagabi ti dameneha biyadagonaga tandaga timbuni ho howa í̠na ti biamogo bia lowa í̠ni olalu hayagoni. I̱naga Ngode Datagaliwabe-o i̱ agalini homene i̱ wali dalo abogo beda lalu daga nalene nagalone bedogonigo ainde harugo lowa i̱naga bi larogo í̠na hale habe.
Mbirale áyu tagira ibirarunibi abale ibinirubi mani mbira ibulubadarubi bibahende í̠nime haru howa handaya ho kegola ibaga. Áyu ngaru bibahendebi mani bulubadaru bibahendebi í̠nime manda biai ho kegoni. Heneneore í̠na ogoale ibulebira lo manda bu harigo damene bibahende ibai haya.
Mbirale mbira i̱na bule manda bidego abaleore aube tobane tagira ibaga. Í̠na bule ngeru bibahende bambaore howa manda bu halu mbirale uruni bule ngego í̠ni minime mo tale bialu manda baya hangu biaga ke.
Ngode Datagaliwabe-o Asiria ti ami agali dewaore daga labe nahe kagoni de handa. Tigua tinaga ami agali damene dewaorebi ami agali nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga dewabi kago mitangi bialu ti agali daga labe nahedagola turu halu mine haga ka. Tinaga danda timubi humbi yandarerubi pume ege to̱le̱ baga yidarubi uruni damenenaga hongo manda bialu ti mine haga ka. Anigo tigua í̠ manda nabiore ka. Í̠ni degeme wai emene timbuni birago mo palia habehe kegoni. Anduane Homogo í̠niore ke.
Í̠naga hongo gibiore ngegome tinaga hongo bo podabe. Tigua dindi í̠ninaga loma biahe wiabagi hene biago mo ko halu mo dodohe ngelole ai í̠naga tandaga holeneme uruni balu bo bibaore habe. Tigua í̠naga andabi í̠naga lomabu delaga dabu kagobi bo gialo wahai hole ibu kagoni ndobe.
Tinaga mine hagane mana ngago de handalu í̠naga tandaga holeneme ti balu bo biba habe. I̱ mini nahe bame wali dege bedogome i̱na hameledogo ale buliya í̠na i̱ hongo ngibe.
I̱naga bi dege larogome agali biabe biahaga karubi tinaga anduane karubi bole pelo í̠na biamogo bibe. Tinaga mine hagane mana ngago walinaga giha howa wiamaro bilabe.
Í̠naga hongo ami agali dewanaga hongoni howa ndo ibaga. Í̠ wali agali tini mo dindiha ho haga karunaga Ngode Datagaliwabeore howa i̱na mbirali daga nalene mini nawi karu biamogo biaga ke. Í̠na mbirali hongo nahe karu handaya ho halu darabi yagibanoore kagoha ti baba mandagi kaware haga ke. Ani bialu maru homolene kaware ngagoria karia í̠na haru dai biaga ke.
I̱ mamali Simeononaga Ngode Datagaliwabe-o i̱naga bi áyu ogoni hale ha. Isaraelenaga ngaru bibahende aba kegoni. Í̠ni dahuliya andaga dindilanaga timbuni daligaore kegoni. Í̠ iba pedaru wabiaga howa uruni abaore kegoni. Mbirale bibahende í̠nime wabirirunaga kini í̠niore kegoni. I̱na bi larogo abale hale habe.
Bi ohowa i̱na loleberogome waitigi agali karu bo wahelo mo bia helabe. Irane tigua manda bialu bi lo kago í̠naga habo nalolene bi ina baba lo wirigo mo habo lelolebi í̠naga anda kago bo gialo wahai holebi Hari Saiono nene ngago mo ko halu mo ngubia holebi í̠ waneiginirunaga dindi ngago mo ko hai holebi manda bialu ibu ka.
Ainde í̠naga wali agali bu karumebi wali agali maru bu karumebi í̠ni tinaga Ngode Datagaliwabeore heneda lo manda biai helo ani bibe. Í̠ Ngode Datagaliwabe Bibahendenaga Hongo Haiheore howa kegoni. Ani howa Isaraele wali agali handaya ho haga í̠ni hanguore kegoni, lalu Yudidi ibugua Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lene.

Ai waini iba be mbirabi olibe lini ibane be mbirabi ibunaga biabe bia hagane wali biagome henelo mini. Ani biai halu libu tanonaga wai pabe panga haraba heagoria pialu hebiria Usia halu Bedulia tanonaga agali kirali Kabarisi Kamisila ti haru mandagi howa tanonaga wai pabe panga dugua hene.
Ani buwa handalu hemiria Yudidi wali baya dege lalu agi loabe tobaheni ibunaga dengui baya tara howa ibunaga agabi tara dege biaria hendene. Tigua turu halu bi ogodagua lamini.

Yudidi ibugua Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lai howa ibugua ladai bialu lalu, Ai i̱na mbirale bule lalu larugoni bule poliya agali biabe biaga karuhondo tano pabe panga dugua ladaba, lene. Ani layagola tigua igiri daliahe bu hearuhondo pabe panga duguadaba lene.
Panga dugua hayagola Yudidila wali ibunaga biabe bia haga bereago libu haru tanoha howa tagira pialu hari bare wiagoha daliape halu dindi tigabi wiagoha puabo halu pene.
Libu dindi tigabi wiagoha puabo halu hebiria Asiria ami agali bu hearu mamage ibagabu hearia ngola hene.
Tigua hapai howa Yudidi hale halu lalu, Libu dindi timbuni agoha howa ibalu hameigini ai aria eberebibe, lene. Ani layagola Yudidi ibugua ladai bialu lalu, I̱ Hiburu wali bedogonigo tígua wai bialu bo podanda holeberemigo manda bialu i̱ dindi yu wahalu ibida poro.
Ai i̱ ami agali tínaga agali haguane Holoberenesehondo bi bayale maru lolego ibu hondo polene hame ledo. Ibu dindi barebare ngaru bibahende bo podai holene hame leagua nde i̱na ibuhondo ogodagua bibe lalu bi lamerogo hale holene nga. Anidagua biyagua nde ibunaga ami agali bu karu bope halu ti wayali holeberemi, lene.
Ami agali biaru tigua handalu hemiria Yudidi baya taraore heagola tigua handaya hai hene. Ibugua bi layago hale hai howa tigua ladai bialu lalu,
Í̠ore wali oheme hariga baya handarida. Í̠na abale ibalu inanaga agali haguane Holoberenese hondole abale ibiridagome í̠ homolene nawi. Ai gi nahabe. Áyu ogoni ibunaga balai anda kagoha abale pu. Inanaga ami agali bu karume í̠ heba pialu haru halu inanaga agali haguane karia haru polebira, lene.
Í̠na ibu deni pu howa gi nahe howa bi bibahende áyu inahondo langirigo damene ibuhondo lamiai habe. Ani beregola ibugua í̠ baya hangu handaya ho holebira, lene.
Ani lalu tigua ami agali handari mbirame (100) Yudidila wali ibunaga biabe bia haga biagola haru halu Holoberenese ibunaga balai anda heagola berearia haru halu pene.
Ami agali balai andaha bu hearume hale halu hemiria wali baya taraorene tara mbira ibiya layago hale halu ti de hondole gerai ibugu ibugu bini. Tigua Holoberenese berearia wali mbira ibira lalu bi lo yalu piyagola Yudidi ibu balai anda haneni hondo hene. Agali ibu heagoria ho mabu bu howa
wali baya taraore heago hondowa mogo lowa tigua bi dewaore laga laga bialu hene. Tigua manda bialu Isaraele wali agali maru karu aria ndo tara mbira harua lo manda bini. Tigua lalu, Hameigini wali baya biraga uruni wali agali abime mege bibehedabe. Iname wali uruni agalini kago damene bo wahai holene karulapeda. Hameigini wali baya biraga tigua wali agali dindi bibahendeha palima pedaru mo hondo hai holigo, lene.
Ani lalu hemigola ami agali Holoberenese mamage haga hearubi agali ibunaga biabe bia haga hearubi bibahendeme tagira ibalu Yudidi minu yalu anda ibini.
Holoberenese ibu andaga tamuha palene. Ibunaga paliaga dagia ogoni aga mindibi hari mindini handalehemebi ngolo pume wabini wiagome hinabibi anda bu dambihe wini. Aga ogoni pu tara taramebi ege to̱le̱ muni timbunime miaga tara taramebi mo yári bia ho wini.
Agali biarume Yudidi ibiya lalu bi lamiyagola Holoberenese ibu balai anda haneni tagira íbu heagola agali marume lamu silibame wabini wiagome hale hedo yalu tigua bamba halu ibini.
Yudidi ibu heyu heagola Holoberenese halu agali ibunaga biabe bia haga ibiyadaru ti de hondowa Yudidi dengui baya taraoreyago hondowa ti hame timbuni lene. Wali biago ibugua Holoberenese wanakuihayagi howa ibunaga mini yaraga halu ge duli hanga howa bulu palialu hearia agali hearume mo heya howa heyu helene.
Holoberenese ibugua Yudidihondo lamialu lalu, Wali-o í̠ mini burugu lolene nawi. Í̠ gi holenebi nawi. Wali agali Kini Nebugadenesa dindi bibahendenaga kini timbuni handame ho bedago andaneha holeore lalu anda ibiyaru aria mbiraoreli hangu halu mbiraorebi i̱na uruni mo ko halu bo wa naharuli.
Ani bialu í̠ damene uyu hari bareha paluyu pedaru tigua i̱hondo erembira nangidale nde i̱na ti baba wai nabidole. Anigo ai tinime bia ko haya.
Anigo í̠na ti helalu í̠ pora bialu ibida ina hemaria ibiridago irane agibe. Í̠ ibiridago bayale biridago ani ibiridagome í̠ni bayale biruleberego í̠ gi nahabe. Áyu mbiraga ogoni howa mani birama poleberegoha í̠ mo ko naholebira.
Agali o karu bibahendeme wali agali í̠naga agali haguane Kini Nebugadenesanaga bi hale halu ibu andaneha karu baya hangu handaya ho hagadagua í̠ baya hangu handaya ho holebira, lalu Holoberenesehanda Yudidi lamini.
Ani layagola Yudidihanda ladai bialu lalu, Aiore agali haguane-o i wali í̠naga biabe bia haga bedogoni. I̱ bi maru lolene karulapebe. Ai mbiraga kamangi i̱naga agali haguane kagohondo ke halu bi nalolebero. Anidagua bulene nawiore.
I̱na bi loleberogo í̠na hale halu biriyagua nde Ngode Datagaliwabehanda í̠naga giha howa biabe timbuni tara bulebira. Mbirale í̠naga agali haguane ibugua bulene ngago mbiralime mo habo nalolebira. Ibugua birago tigabi dege piaho wulebira.
I̱na heneneore gi dolalu Nebugadenesa ibu dindi bibahendenaga kini howa agali haguanebi ibuore howa ibugua dindi bibahendeha pialu wali agali baya hangu helo tigua mo tiga bule pudaba layadago ibunaga mini lalu larogo Holoberenese í̠na biabe timbuniore birigome wali agali hangu ndo dindini ema bialu piaga bibahendebi ega bedarubi bibahendeore ibunaga hongo timbuni ngago andaneha hai ka.
Iname abale hale harimago í̠ agali manda bayaleorebibi mini bayalewibi mbira ke laya. Wali agali dindi tarani haga haga bidaru bibahendeoreme manda biai kago Asiria dindiha í̠ biabe beregome bu bolangua holenebi manda timbuni bolangua henebi wai puwa bo podahana halu wayali holenebi í̠ ale mende nahe layane hale hai harima.
Ani bialu Agio ibugua í̠hondo bi maru layayago ina hale hai harima. Beduliali hearubi tigua ibu bo wanahe heleagola ibugua bi í̠hondo langiniyaru bibahende layane hale hai harima.
Agali haguane-o ibugua bi langiyago mo wanahabe. Ibugua bi ogoni heneneore layago í̠naga miniha yu haabo habe. Inanaga wali agali bu karu tigua Ngode Datagaliwabenaga deni howa ti mana ko mbira nabi heagua nde ti ayu tibu nene gadele ngagome nadibulebira. Ani bialu tiha mo ko holenebi nawulebira.
Anigo i̱naga agali haguane-o í̠naga biabe bulene ngago bia ko halu ibira holobadalo manda nabibe. Mana kome Isaraele wali agali dariba hene kagome tiha mo ko halu homoleneore nga. Tigua mana ko ngaru damene bialu kagome Ngode Datagaliwabenaga bu miniha tandaga nolene ngago mo yu anda ibaga.
Áyu dege tinaga tomo nalu holene ndia halu ibabi nai habehe nga. Ani biyagola ai tinaga nogo bulumaga karu bo nai halu tomo maru Ngode Datagaliwabehanda nolene nawi leneru balu nai hole ka.
Ani bialu tigua tinaga mabuha widi pigane boga bini dedarubi waini ibabi olibe lini ibanebi Anduane Homogohanda ibunagaore leneru tini nole lalu bi lo mbira hai haya. Tomo uruni agali loma binigo mo miaga Yarusalemeni Anduane Homogonaga tano loma biaho helene biagoria biabe bialu karu tinaga wiaga wini. Tomo uruni agali mendeme ela nahaga loma biahowa wiabagi hene wiaga nga.
Anigo ainde tigua tomo ogoni narama lalu agali maru bi yalu ganisolo agali Yarusalemeni hearu lamule pudaba laya. Wali agali Yarusalemeni hearu tiguabi nde ogonidagua dege biya.
Ainde ganisolo agali Yarusaleme karu tigua karulapego nalimu lalu ladai biragola tigua tomo ogoni nayayagua nde horo ogoningiore Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ti í̠naga giha mo ya haragola í̠na ti bo wahaiore holebere.
Ai i̱ wali í̠naga biabe biaga i̱na bi ogoni hale halu i̱na ti yu wahai halu ibida pora bialu ibiru. Ngode Datagaliwabehanda í̠ mbirale timbuniore mbira iyane buleberebago ogoni dindi bibahendeha wali agali bu karume hale hai holebira. Ani hale howa ti mogo timbuni lolebirago ai i̱na mbirale timbuni ogoni buliya Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ibilaya.
I̱ í̠naga biabe biaga biruwa Ngode Datagaliwabe dahuliya andaga kagonaga bi hale haga bedo. Ani biruwa horo bibahendengibi mbiraga bibahendengibi ibunaga mini yaraga halu biraga bedo. Agali haguane-o horo bibahende i̱ í̠la biraabo howa mbiraga i̱ unu dindi ulini tigabi ngagoha Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mini yaraga hole pugu bulebero. Ani berogola Ngode Datagaliwabe ibugua Isaraele wali agalime ko ogongi biya lalu i̱ langulebira.
Ibu bi langirago hale howa í̠ langerogola í̠na í̠naga ami agali bu karu haru halu puwa wai beregola í̠ hapai halu í̠la wai bulene Isaraeleali mbira naholebira.
Í̠ Yarusaleme pobelonaga hariga Yudia dindiha pedadagua pialu pobelo i̱na hariga walia holebero. Ani bialu tano í̠ karulalu í̠ kini halu Yarusaleme tano dombeneha birulebere. Ani bialu í̠na wali agali uruni nogo sibi haru haga nahe yu wahalu pene haru haradagua haru kegola biango ko karume í̠hondo du̱a nalolebira. Bambaore howa mbirale uruni bulebira lalu Ngode Datagaliwabehanda i̱hondo langiyagola i̱ manda bu berene. Ai áyu Ngode Datagaliwabehanda í̠ lamule pu laya, lene.

Dindi amu ni tagira ibiragoha howa pialu ni paliragoha wali ogobi mbira berearia handa nabirima. Ibunaga dengui baya taraore mbirani ibunaga manda ngagobi wali maru bedarunaga manda ngago bolangua heneda, lene.
Ai Holoberenese ibugua Yudidihondo lalu, Bayaleore Ngode Datagaliwabehanda í̠naga wali agaliru helalu í̠ ala ibilayada. Áyu i̱na hongoheore howa wali agali i̱naga agali timbuni Nebugadenesa mege biaga karu tiha mo ko holene ngago ngola holebira.
Ainde í̠ wali baya taraore mbira bedegoni. Í̠naga dengui baya burugule mbirani bi í̠na larigobi dendebioreda. Mbirale í̠na bule lariruni biai hariyagua nde í̠naga Ngode Datagaliwabe kago ibu i̱naga Ngode Datagaliwabe holebira. Ani bialu í̠ni Nebugadenesa andaga pu bedegola í̠naga mini dindi bibahende ngaruha hale hayago lalu mini lene birulebere, lalu lene.
Holoberenesehanda agali biabe biaga hearuhondo lalu, Yudidi anda tamuha tomo nolene beledi silibame wabini ngagoria haru pu berelalimu, lalu lamini. Ani bialu ibugua agali biabe biaga bu hearuhondo lamialu, Tomo bayalebi waini ibabi i̱ni nagane ale maru mo milimu, lalu lamini.
Ani layagola Yudidihanda lalu, I̱na tomo uruniale nanolebero. Tomo nolene i̱ni hanalu ibinidaru karulape nolebero. Tígua ngeremigo naruyagua mana ngago puguligonaga nanolebero, lene.
Ani layagola Holoberenese ibugua Yudidihondo lamialu lalu, Tomo í̠ni hanaridago nai kegola í̠naga tomo iname agoha ngaria taya buluma̱yadabe. Yuda wali agali mbira ina baba mandagi nahedago agua taya buledabe, lene.
Ani layagola Yudidihanda bi layago ladai bialu lalu, Heneneore i̱na í̠hondo tigatiga langerogo. Anduane Homogohanda i̱ha howa biabe bule ngago bu maro biragola tomo i̱ nolene wiaabo holebira, lene.
Ani lalu agali Holoberenese ibunaga biabe biaga hearume Yudidi balai anda mbira heagoha haru piyagola ibu anda ogoniha paleaore mbi hanuni hene. Palialu egabi lolene kaware ngelowa ami agali mamage haga hearu bu heaore heyuwa Yudidihanda
Holoberenese hearia bi lama pudaba lowa lalu, I̱ tagira pialu dindi ulini tigabi ngagoha pialu Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lole poabe lalu í̠nihondo hale haro laya lalu lamule pudaba, lene.
Ani lama piyagola Holoberenese ibugua ami agali hearuhondo lalu, Ibu polebiragoha napobe. Hapai nahe mamage dege baya hangu halimu, lalu lamini. Ai Yudidi ibu horo tebira ami agali balai anda bu heagoha howa mbiraga bibahendengi Bedulia tanonaga dindi ulini wiagoha pialu iba bereagoha wayawaya biaga berene.
Wayawaya bai howa ibugua Anduane Homogo Isaraelenaga Ngode Datagaliwabehondo lalu, Isaraele tigua wayali halu waitigi bope helonaga hariga maru mo walia habe, lalu bi lalu berene.
Ibu Ngode Datagaliwabenaga deni dodo ko mbira para nahe holenaga biaga mana ngago biaabo halu berene. Ani biai halu ibunaga balai anda kagoha pu biraabo halu alendo tomo nolene tu haragola tagira ibaga berene.
Horo maneni hayagola Holoberenesehanda agali ibunaga biabe biagane hearunaga tomo timbuni dawa hene. Anigo agali ami agali haru halu bamba haga maru hearu ti ibalimu nalene.
Ani bialu howa Holoberenese ibugua agali mbira ibunaga mbirale wiaru bibahende handaya ho haga mini Bagoasa heagohondo lamialu lalu, Í̠na áyu ogoni puwa Hiburu wali í̠na handaya ho haga biaga tomo ibabi ina haru mandagi nalu i̱naga balai andaha birami̱ya haru halu ibabe.
Iname wali ogonibigo ibu heba te lalu mandagi bira nabi howabi ibula mandagi palia nabi howabi bameore biralu pelarimayagua nde ina mege gibiore bialu ina hondo oba holebira, lene.
Ani laya handala Bagoasa ibugua Holoberenese berelalu Yudidihondo pene. Ibugua puwa lalu, Wali baya-o í̠naga agali haguane baba bialu tomo nami̱ya ibuleberebe. Ibugua í̠ iba wainiru nalu ina baba turu hagabu birami̱ya hame layago. Ainde í̠na Asiria walirume Kini Nebugadenesa andaga biruwa biagadagua bule íbuore bibe laya, lene.
Ani layagola Yudidihanda ladai bialu lalu, I̱ aigo biruwa i̱naga agali haguane kagohondo naibule loabe. Ani bialu mbiraga ogoniore embeda nahe manda biaho biraabo howa homalu waholeberoda lo manda bido, lene.
Ani laya handala Yudidi ibugua puwa aga bayaleru mo karulalu yári tara tararu bialu bini. Ani buwa Yudidi ibu anda ibalu berene. Ani ibiyagola Holoberenese ibunaga bu miniha wali biago dimagoli timbuni halu mandagi paluenaga ladebodebo bialu biraabo hene. Ani bialu howa Holoberenese ibugua Yudidihondo lalu, Í̠na waini ibaru abale nalu ina baba turu ho birami̱ya, lene.
Ani layagola Yudidi ibugua ladai bialu lalu, Agali haguane-o áyu i̱na iba í̠la mandagi noleberogo irane horo áyu ogoni i̱naga horo timbuniore ngago manda bialu nolebero, lene.
Ani lalu Yudidi ibugua tomobi ibabi wali ibunaga biabe bia haga biagome manda manda biyadaru nalu berene.
Ani nalu bereagola Holoberenese ibugua Yudidi de handaya halu hearia dimagoli timbuni tagira ibiyagola ibu waini iba dewaore nagimbu bialu berene. Ibu iba abale nanagadagua dewaore áyu ogoningi nowa mo ko howa lulu yu berene.
Mbi hanuni hayagola agali Holoberenesenaga biabe bia haga biaru ti abale heyalu piai hene. Ani biyagola Bagoasahanda Holoberenesenaga balai anda heagonaga panga payanda howa agali biabe biaga maru hearu ibunaga agali haguane padagoha anda napole lalu bi lamiai hene. Tomo nalu luore biru wahayagome agali bibahende de umu lai hene.

Yudidihanda wali ibunaga biabe bia haga biago balai anda tagirahayagi haneni abale biagadagua ibu tagira ibuliya hondo habe lene. Wali ibunaga biabe bia haga biago lamialu ibu, Anduane Homogohondo bi lone lole porogo, lene. Ani bialu Bagoasahondobi ani dege lamini.

Ai Yudidihanda wali agalihondo lamialu lalu, Hagibuni mbaliniru-o i̱na bi larogo ala hale hadaba. Tígua agali haguane ogo mo yalu puwa wai pabe neneni mo paga hadaba.
Egabi lalu gao laragola tígua agali haguane mbira dabo helalimu. Agali hongohe kemigo damene bibahende danda timu yandareru yai halu tano wahalu tagira piai halimu. Asiriali mamage haga karu baba wai bule tagira peneale tingi halimu. Tigua henene wai bule daliape halu napilimu.
Ani beremigo hondowa Asiriali tigua wai biagane ale mo yai halu gerai lalu balai anda kagoha aminaga agali haguane barila hole polebira. Ani biragola agali haguane uruni tigua gerai lalu Holoberenese andaga balai andaha pialu karia tigua Holoberenese nahondolebira.

Ami agali maru Bedulia tano kaware hari bareha hapare howa balai anda bu hayago tibi nde ibida piai hene. Ani biyagola ai Isaraele ami hearu abale daliape halu ti talima pugu pugu bini.
Ani biyagola Usiahanda Bedomasadaimi dindiha bi lo pelalu Bebai dindihabi Koba dindihabi Kola dindihabi Isaraele dindi bibahendeha layago lalimu lene. Ibugua mbirale o biyarunaga te lo pelalu agali ibida poraruni baba wai bialu bibahende bo wahai halimu, lene.

Wali agali Bedulia tanoha hearume Asiria ami agali balai anda bu hene biagoha puwa ami agali biarume mbirale bayale ngelo wahalu pene wiaru mo yini. Tigua dabudabu dewaore mo yalu tanoha dai bini.

Horo pira tebirani (30) Isaraele wali agalime dabudabu Asiria ami biarume balai anda bu hayagoria yu wahalu piyago mo yu tone bialu hene. Ainde dabudabu Holoberenesenaga damenego bibahende balai andabi ndisi be belediru silibame wabini wiarubi dagia paliaga wiagobi gabo be wiagobi dagia wiagobi biragane dagia wiagobi maruale wiarubi bibahende mo yai hene. Ani bialu Yudidihanda mbirale uruni mo kabu bigi buwa ibunaga nogo dongi erekunini mo paga halu ibugua garo nogo hosime gililagane mo manda manda bu ngelowa mbirale uruni mo paga howa gililo yalu tini dalu hari nene biagoha irigi hene.
Isaraele wali bibahendeme Yudidi hondole ibai ho hene. Tigua ibu mini leneore beda lowa ibunaga mini yaraga halu marume ibu mani ibilo ti turu halu mali lima bamba hene. Yudidihanda ira yuni bu yuwa maru ibu heba pirimigo mini.
Ibunibi wali maru ibu heba piyarubi tigua ira olibe magane yuni heaore mabu buwa tinaga emboneni tangi mo karulene. Ani bialu tigua iba gana lalu mali lima piyadagoha íbu lu bamba hene. Ani biyagola Isaraele ami agali tigua danda timu yandarebi wai biaga ale yai howa ira yunirume tinaga emboneni yári biai halu turu holenenaga iba ganaru lama walini piyadagua mama pene.

Yudidi ibugua Isaraele wali agali bibahende mandagi howa turu halu ka̱i̱ lolenenaga iba gana ogo layagola wali agali tigua talialu layadagua lene.
Iname i̱naga Ngode Datagaliwabe- hondo iba gana lalu kaboga wialu tabaga balu Anduane Homogo mini yaraga hama. Iba gana gahenge lalu ibunaga mini yaraga hama. Ibunaga mini timbuniore mini lene ka lalu iname ibunaga mini olalu, Ina biamogo bibe, lalu lama.

Asirialiru uyurayagi howa daliape halu abaleore ibiya. Tinaga ami agali dewaore howa dindi tigabi wiagoha ho namulai haya. Ami agali nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga bu hearume hari nene wialu ho karulai haya.
Tigua ina mo gi holenaga bi ogodagua laya Inanaga dindi andaru bo heda holeberema, laya. Tigua, Igiri daliahe karu ayu tiburume dibai holeberema, laya. Tínaga waneigini gali bibahende dindini mo paraho waholeberema, laya. Waneigini garabaya yalu poleberema, laya. Tínanaga wandari mabuage bedaru bibahende mo ko holeberema, laya.
Anidagua bule layagola Anduane Homogo Bibahendenaga Hongo Haihe kago ibugua wali mbiranaga giha howa ti bope hayagoni ndobe.
Tinaga agali haguane ogoni igiri daliaheme ndo bayiya. Agali hongohe mbirame ndo baya. Merari wane Yudidi ibugua hangu ibunaga dengui baya heagome agali mo luluya hayaya.
Ibugua ibunaga dara howa aga karulayago golo wahalu puwa Isaraele wali agali darabi hearu bibahende mo yaraga hayiya. Ibunaga dengui mbagua sandame hai howa ibunaga mandari aga baya mbirame kabu bialu aga bayaleru karulalu agalime hondowa dimagoli helo piyiya.
Agali haguane timbuni heagome Yudidinaga ge hondowa dimagoli halu ibu wali baya taraoreyago handaya. Ani bialu hearia Yudidi ibugua wai biagane ayu tibume ibunaga ma puguayiya.
Pesia wali agali hearume wali biagonaga hongo wiago hondowa ti mogo lowa durulalu haya. Midiali hearu tigua handalu hearia wali ogoni ibu gi nahaga heago de hondowa ti mogolo hendene.
Inanaga damene ala mo ko hene hearume ti turu howa hoaro layagola waitigi hayaru mogo lai haya. Tigua hongo howa hoaro laga laga biyagola waitigi agaliru mogolalu ibida piai haya.
Ina wali galone nahe biabe biaga waneiginirume ti homelo bo wahai harima. Iname garabaya agalime ibida poragola bagadagua bialu ti homelo bo wahaiore harima. Anduane Homogonaga ami agali giha howa ti ereba hai haya.
I̱naga Ngode Datagaliwabe kagohondo i̱na iba gana gahengeru lolebero. Anduane Homogo-o í̠ gibiore kegoni. Í̠ bolangua heneore kegoni. Í̠ bibahendenaga hongo haihe howa mendealime í̠ bope halu ti wayali habe nahe ka.
I̱na wabini ngaru bibahendeme í̠ni andaneha haiore holene nga. Í̠na bi dege larigola mbirale uruni bame hai hene. Í̠naga buhe pulanda harigola abaleore aube tobane buwa mbirale uruni baya gibi haya. Mbiralime í̠naga bi mo wahabe nahe.
Hari timbuni wedarubi iba solowara bedarubi tigua durulaga ndobe. Í̠ kaware eberegola ege to̱le̱ timbuni ngarume mo iba bu hinaga. Í̠naga wali agalime í̠naga bi hale haga karuhondo dara haga kegoni.
Loma ngabi dendebiore wiaguabi ogoni bame dege holebira. Nogo bulumaga habane lomabu delaga dabuni delayagua ogoni bame dalu biba haga. Mbiralime Anduane Homogonaga bi hale hayagua ibu galoneore holebira.
Dindi mbiraha padarume wali agali i̱ damene baba wai bule ibiyagua nde ti de hondowa ibulene nga. Anduane Homogo Bibahendenaga Hongo Haihe kagome godi hale holene horo timbuni tagira ibirangi tihondo bi hale holebira. Ibugua ti kagoha ira hedape halu tinaga tingini ngoeme hai helolebira. Ani biragola tigua tandaga handaabo halu howa dugu bialu haabo holebira, lalu iba gana ogoni lai haya.
Ani bialu wali agali Yarusaleme dai buwa tigua Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lalu hene. Wali agali tini Ngode Datagaliwabe deni dodo nahe hole mana biaga wiago biai howa tigua loma irani dai helonaga lomabu delalu wali agali tinime Ngode Datagaliwabe loma turu halu mule lalu bi lo winirubi tini hameme hangu hangu yalu ibiyaru bibahende loma uruni bu migi bialu hene.
Mbirale Holoberenesenaga dabudabu mo yayaruni wali agali tigua Yudidi mo miai henego ainde Yudidi ibugua Ngode Datagaliwabe mo mini. Ani bialu labolabo hinabibi hagira biaga Yudidi ibuni Holoberenesenaga mo yini biagobi Anduane Homogo dege mini.
Ege tebiraru bibahende howa wali agali ti turu halu Ngode Datagaliwabenaga anda Yarusalemeni heago kawareni haabo henego ai Yudidi ibubi nde ti haru hene.
Turu ho holene horo uruni hai halu wali agali bibahende tini dalu dai biai hene. Yudidi ibu nde Bedulia tano dai buwa ibunaga dindi wiyadagoria berene. Horo ogoningi howa ibu Isaraele dindiha mini lene mbira biraabo halu homalu wahene.
Yudidi ibu agalini Manase homayagola tigua ibu mamaliru homali heagoria mandagi hora halu Yudidi dalo bereagola agali marume dabu dabulene manda bialu hemiria ibu agali nape biraabo halu homene.
Ibunaga mini loyogo lai hene. Ibu agalini andaga heagoha biraabo halu ibunaga mali handari mbirani duria (105) berene. Ani biruwa wali ibunaga garabaya biabe ale bia haga biago yupe halu pu lene. Ani bialu ibu homayagola Bedulia tanoha ibu agalini Manase hora heagoha dege hora hene.
Yudidi ibu homayagola Isaraele wali agalime dara howa horo karu dugu bialu duguanda ho hene. Ibu homa nabi dege biruwa ibunaga paluni wiaru bibahende tale buwa maru ibu agalini Manase damene hearu talebu mialu maru ibuni damene mini.
Yudidi ibuni bereangibi mani Yudidi ibu homeagolabi waitigime Isaraele wali agali mo gi holene henge mbira nawiore bayale haabo hene.
Mbirale uruni biyagola Pesia dindiha Segesisi ibu kini heangi bini. Ibu kini howa Pesia dindiha dindi timbuni Susa tanoni kini biragane dagia wiagoria handame ho howa haru hene. Ani howa ibugua dindi hobane handari mbira pira kirani karia (127) bibahende India dindiha howa wima pialu amuroaore Sudana dindiha wiairi hene. Ibu kini henego mali tebone howa ibugua dindi bibahendenaga agali bu hearubi agali manda timbuni bi hearubi bibahendenaga tomo timbuni dawa hene. Pesia dindi howabi Midia dindiha howabi nde tomo ogoni nalu berene. Ani bialu dindi hobane emene mbira mbiranaga agali haguane bu hearubi bibahende íbu birai hene. Ani howa ege waraganeni ibunaga muni yaribi bayale wiaru damene bibahende agali haguane bu hearu wanakuini mo walia hai hene. Ani bialu mani howa kini ibu dalu andagaha pabe bu mabu bini wiagoha yagi tomo timbuni lone dawene. Tomo ogoni agali taraha howa íbu hene tanoha hearunaga dawa hene. Tigua tomo nalu horo karia bibahende hene. Pabe bu mabu binidago aga peleme mo yari bia howa pu mindibi hari mindini handaleheme dariba hene. Aga ogoni nguni bibahendeha silibame wabini mabubime daba haga buwa ege pabe heagoria mo paga howa mo yaribia haga bini. Ai pabe andaneha ege to̱le̱ baya tara pelebi daramabi wiarubi mindibi hari mindini handalehe wiarubi ege to̱le̱ tara iba wa̱i̱ handalehe wiarubi urunime dindini dunga ho wini. Ani wiagoria biragane dagia ngolome wabini silibame wabiniru pabe andaneha ege to̱le̱ dunga henedagoria wiai hene. Ani bialu dagia uruni aga baya tara tara wiarume dunga halu mo dambi howa mo yari bia halu bini. Ani bialu agali gabo be ngolome wabinirubi silibame wabini wiarume iba nalu berene. Ani biruwa gabo be mbira yolo timuni daligaore kina dege daosini pira tebirame (K30,000) miaga wiago ti mo walia hene. Ani bialu kini ibugua agali uruni waini iba dewaore nelo mini. Waini iba ogodagua nalu karulape lo manda nabi agali bedaru ti iba tini hame ledadagua karulape nelo mia dege bilimu lalu agali waini iba odo tale biaga ibu andagaha haga hearuhondo lamini. Horo ogoningi dege kuini wali Basidi ibugua nde kini andagaha dege walinaga tomo timbuni dawa nalu berene. Tomo ogoni walinaga hanguore wini. Tomo ani nalu biruwa horo kane hayagola kini ibu waini iba nowa emene lulu yu berene. Ani biruwa ibu andagaha biabe biaga agali karia hearu olalu ibidaba lene. Agali uruni mini Hamana Basana Tara Borase Sadoloda Abadasa Taraba layaru henego uruni ibini. Ani ibiyagola kinihanda lalu, Kuini wali Basidi haru ibidaba, lene. Kini ibugua Basidi haguaneni kuini walinaga tangi mo karula holenaga ani lene. Kuini wali ogoni bayaleore tara wali maru baba tabe tabe nabi berenego ai kini ibugua ibu one baya ogoni agali maru tomo nalu berearu mo walia hole manda bini. Ani manda bialu layaria ai kuini wali ogoni ibu ibulene hame nalene. Ani biyagola kini ibu keba timbuniore hene. Ani howa ibugua agali mana mandabi bu hearuhondo lamialu, Kuini wali Basidihanda bi mo wahayago ayu ibuhondo agi buabe, lalu hale hene. Ani hale hayagola agali haguane timbuni tebirali kini ibuniale dege henego ibini. Agali tebirali uruni tigua kinihondo ti daluha mana wiago lawai halu, Ai mbirale kuini Basidihanda biyadagonaga ogodagua bulene nga, lalubi lamialu bini. Agali tebirali uruni ti mini Ageseusu Sasadeusu Malesea layaru hene. Agali tebirali uruni ti Pesia dindibi Midia dindibi howa íbu hene. Ai kini ibugua ibunaga agali haguane Pesia dindialibi Midialibi hearuhondo mbirale kuini wali Basidihanda ibuhondo biyaru lamiai hene. Ani lamiyagola agali mbira mini Mugeusu heago ibugua agali haguane hearuhondo lamialu lalu, Kini-o bi ogo hale harene. Ai kuini Basidihanda ko ogoni í̠hondo hangu ndo biyada. Ibugua ina bibahendehondo biyida. Ainde inanaga wali bedaru bibahendeme kuini wali Basidihanda ogonidagua biya larago abale hale hayago lolobada. Ani bialu wali bedaru bibahendeme kuini wali Basidihanda biyadadagua dege ti agalininaga bi mo wahalu mine holobada.
Anidagua bulubadago ai kini-o í̠na manda bialu keria bi ogoni bayaleda lo manda bideyagua nde bi ogoni wali agali bibahende kagoha piai helolene karulapeda. Í̠na bi ogoni lo pelalu howa tihondo lalu, Ai Basidi ibu i̱ bedoria ibulene nawiore lolene nga. Ani lalu bi ogoni Pesia dindi Midia dindilanaga mana mbuga ngagoha gilibu wulene nga. Ani bialu wali bayale mbira taya buwa Basidi kuini wali berenegoria bira aribia helo taya bulene nga. Ai ogoni hangu.
Ai ṉ́aga bi ogoni dindi ṉ́a hondo kego bibahendeha wali agali bu karume hale hai harangi wali lenego bibahendeore agali haguane one bereaguabi agali damene one bereaguabi bibahendeme ti agalini bi hale hai holebira, lene.
Ani layagola kinibi ibunaga agali haguane biarume bi ogoni karulapeda lowa ai kini ibugua Mugeusuhanda lamiyadagua bini.
Ibugua beba gili bialu dindi ibugua wiaru bibahendeha wali agali bi tara tara laga laga biaga wiagodagua gili bialu pelai hene. Kini ibugua beba ogoniha gilibu wialu lalu, Agali ibu hangume ibu one waneigini bibahende handaya ho hai ka, lalu gilibu pelene.


































Mani howa nde kini ibu keba hayago wa hene. Anigo ainde ibugua Basdi kuini naberelo bo duguayago mitangi biaabo ho haga hene.
Ani heagola agali manda timbunibi hearume ibuhondo lamialu lalu, Ai wandari bayaore mbira taya bulene karulapeda.
Agali haguane dindi hobane mbira mbira ngaruha karu bibahendehondo wandari baya bedaru gabumanenaga tano dunini Susa tano haru ibalimu lolene karulapeda. Ani haru halu ibiragola í̠naga wali anda kagoha bere lowa í̠naga wali bedaru handaya hagane agali Hegai kago ibugua handaya ho helo. Ani handaya ho kagola wali bayale helonaga tinaga tingini yari bia weliru ha̱i̱ ha bilo.
Anidagua biragola wali mbira í̠nimeore hame ledego dabaregola ogoni ibugua Basidi berenegoria bira aribia howa kuini wali berelo, lene. Kini ibugua bi uruni karulapeda lowa bi layago talialu bini.
Ai tano timbuni Susa tano wiagoria Yudali mbira mini Modegai hene. Ai Modegai ibu Yairi igini howa Simai aguane halu Simai ibu Beniyamini hameigini aria Kisi igini heago aguane hene.
Bamba Babilono kini Nebugadenesahanda Yuda wali agali garabaya yalu piai hene. Ani piyadangi Modegai heba garabaya yalu pene.
Modegai ibu wane emene mbira mini Eseda berenego ti haru dege pene Eseda ogoni ibu Aminadaba Modegai aba hamene heyogone henego wane berene. Ainde Eseda aba ai̱yala homayagola Modegai ibu waneore biraradagua berene. Eseda wandari baya taraore mbira bereagola Modegaihanda ibuni dabu bulene manda bu hene.
Ai kini ibugua bi lo yu porogo lelayagola tigua wandari baya berearu haru halu Susa tano ibai hene. Ai Esedabi nde ti haru mandagi ibini. Haru ibuwa kini daluha yagi anda wali anda heagoha bere lene. Ani bereagola agali mbira mini Hegai henegome handaya ho hene.
Hegaihanda Eseda wali baya bereago hondowa ibu hame lo hene. Ani howa ibugua aga bayalerubi weli baya tara tara wiarubi Eseda yari bilo mo mini. Ani bialu tomo bayaleru nalu berelo mialu bini. Ani bialu howa ibugua wandari kira kininaga wali andaha berearume Eseda handaya ho berelo dabo bere lene. Ani bialu Hegaihanda wandari uruni hondo bayale dege bialu haabo hene.
Abale howa Modegaihanda Esedahondo bi ogodagua lene. Ibu Yuda wali bedo lalu nalabe, lalu lamini. Ani layagola Eseda ibugua ibu aba hamene biagome bi layago baya hangu manda bu berene.
Ainde horo bibahendengi Modegaihanda kininaga wali anda heagonaga haneni bolangua halu pugu biaga hene. Ibugua Eseda agua biraruabe hondolebi tigua Esedahondo agi bulubadabe hondolebi ani puíbu biaga hene.
Mali mbirani wandari haru ibiyaru bibahende bayale berelonaga mo yari bia ha tomo bayaleru nelo mia bialu haabo hene. Ani bialu ege waragariani tigua weli baya tara ira mue ibaneme wabini baya ngabi wiarume wandari uruni tingini bayale helo ha̱i̱ halu hene.
Ani bialu howa mani tigua wali uruni horo mbiru wali mbira haru pugu bialu kini Segesisi berearia haru pugu bini.
Wali ti kini andaga alendo ne̱ ledegola pialu egerebagi gao laragola dai bigi biaga wini. Ani dai biragola tigua wali uruni kininaga anda mende wali ibu one wabuni halu mende laga biraga anda kagoha bere lowa Hegaihanda handaya ho helo haru puwa bere laga hene. Ani bialu wali uruni lone kini andaga dai bulene nawi. Ai kini ibuni hameme wali mbirago mini olalu kini ibu andaga ibabe layiyagua nde pugu biaga wini. Tigua tini hameme kini andaga polene hariga nawi.
Eseda ibugua kinihondo polene horo tagira ibiyagola Eseda ogoni ibu Modegai aba hamene heyogone mini Aminadaba mbira henego wane berene. Ibugua Hegaihanda bi mana lalu lawai harago bibahende baya hangu hale howa talialu bereagola wali agali bibahendeme ibu gubalini timbuni halu turu hai haga berene.
Horo ogoni kini Segesisi ibu kini heane mali karia hene. Ai mali ogoninaga ege hombene (12) mini Ada layagola tigua Eseda kini berearia haru anda pene.
Ani haru anda piyagola kini ibu hondowa ibugua Eseda gubalini timbuni hene. Wali mende kininaga gubalini podene Eseda ale mende nabere ibu hangu berene. Ani biyagola ai kinihanda Eseda haguaneni kuini walinaga tangi mo karula hene.
Ani bialu horo kariani kini ibugua tomo dawa nalu biraabo hene. Ani bialu howa ibugua agali haguane hearubi agali manda timbunibi bu hearubi bibahende Eseda libu dabu bialu howa tomo dawalu turu haga bu birami̱ya ibidaba laga bini. Ai horo ogoningi ibu dindiha wali agalime dagisi muni wiaga wiadagua nami gadiape howa dagisi milimu lalu kinihanda latagi hene.
Horo ogoningi dege kinihanda Modegai kini ibu andaga handaya ho helo dabo helalu bini.
Bamba howa Modegai ibugua Esedahondo lamialu ibu Yuda wali bedo lalu mbirali nalamibe lalu lamini. Eseda ibunaga mana Modegaihanda bi larago baya hangu hale halu biai haga biruwa ibugua layago hale halu nale berene. Ibugua Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi laabo halu biraga biruwa ibugua Ngode Datagaliwabenaga bi mana baya hangu talialu biraga berene. Ani bialu ibugua mana Yuda wali agalime biaga wiaru mbira wanahe berene.
Ai Modegai ibugua kini Segesisinaga biabe bialu heagola agali haguane kininaga biabe bialu kini hadaya ho haga heagolabome kinila keba ho howa libugua kini bo wahole bi lalu lo manda bini.
Ani lalu hebigo Modegai hale howa ibugua kuini Eseda lamini. Mani howa Eseda ibugua bi Modegaihanda hale howa lamiyaru kini hale helo lamini.
Ani lamiyagola kini ibugua dabo handalu hearia bi uruni henene leneyane handa walia hene. Ani hale howa tigua agali kira ogoni labo irani bo derela hayagola homene. Ai mani kini ibugua Modegainaga mini mo yaraga holenaga lalu, Ai wali agalime biabe baya gibiore Modegaihanda biyago embeda nahelonaga te gabumane mbuga ngagoha gilibu widaba, layagola tigua te ogoni gilibu wini.












Ai bi ogo wali agali bibahendeme hale holene nga. Ai horo ogoni tagira ibirangi tí bibahendeme wali agali uruni homelo bo wahai hole manda manda bu halimu. Ani lalu bi ogoni tano timbuni dunini Susa wiagoria howa latagi hayagola wali agali bu hearu bibahendeore hale hai hene. Ai kini ibunibi Hamanabi libu hangu turu howa bu miniha dungulo howa waini iba dewa nalu lulu yu berene.









Ai Modegai ibu bi o layadagoni hale howa ibu gi timbuni ho hene ibunaga bu miniha genda timbuni ho howa ibunaga aga bu heago lerelo wahowa be abalu haguaneni dugu wu berene. Anidagua bialu tanoha anda pole pialu howa kiabu dugu bialu lalu, Wali agali ko mbira bini nawi karu homelo bameore bo wahole biragonida, lene.
Ani lama pialu kini andaga haneni pu hene. Mbirali kini andaga tamuha anda polenaga aga bayale karu lalu anda piagane wiagola ibu aga bayale nabi ibuwa tagirani berene.
Ai tigua kininaga bi biago dindi bibahendeha hale hai howa Yuda wali agali bibahende gi halu mogo timbuni lowa bu miniha genda timbuni yu hai halu ga̱ laga laga bialu hene. Ti tomo nane wahalu dugu bigi bigi bialu kiabu dugu bialu haga haga bini. Yuda wali agali dewaoreme aga ko budabagabi wiaru mo karu lai halu be abalu wiagoria paliai hene.
Wali Esedanaga biabe biaga berearumebi agali Esedanaga biabe biaga hearubi tigua Modegaihanda anidagua bira layago hale howa Eseda ibunaga bu miniha genda timbuni howa mini burugu lo berene. Ainde Modegaihanda aga ko biyadago golo wahalu bayale karu lelonaga aga bayale yalu pelo mbirali heagohondo mo mini. Ani yalu ibiyagola Modegai ibu manga hene.
Ani layayago hale howa Esedahanda agali mbira mini Hadaga heago olalu íbu lene. Hadaga ogoni ibu agali kininaga wali bedaru handaya ho haga howa ibu Esedanaga biabe biaga agali mbira helonaga kinihanda dabo helene. Ani henego ai Esedahanda Hadaga abale Modegai bedaria puwa í̠ agua biyabe lalu hale hole pu laya handala puwa hale hene.
