Í̠ godi lako haga kegoni ndobe. Mbirali ko nabiago kago ko biya lalu tinaga mini mo ko halu mo yobia haga kegoni. Ani bialu mbirali mana ko bini kago í̠na mo dambi halu wahalu pu laga ke. Anigo Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ledagome mbirali ko nabi kago bameore homelo bo wanahabe leda.
Anigo ainde heneneore Susana ibu agali mbiralila heneyagua nde í̠ tigatiga langi. Ai libu ira agile teneha paleneyabe, lene. Ani hale hayagola agali biagome ladai bialu lalu, Ira, dugu heago andaneha heneyabe, lene.
Ani layagola Danielehanda lalu, Í̠ ke̱ haregoni ndobe. Í̠ni ke̱ haregome í̠ ayu biba hene kegoni. Ngode Datagaliwabenaga dahuliyalime ayu tibu nene gadele yu kagome í̠ dibu dagabu ki holenaga handaya ho kagoni, lene.
Ai agali godi hale haga mbira biago pu lalu godi hale haga agali mende biago íbu lene. Ibiyagola Danielehanda ibuhondo lalu, Í̠ore Kenana dindiha puya ko ngagonaga igini kegoni. Í̠ Yudali ndo kegoni. Wali baya berearume í̠naga mini mo luluya hayada. Ani bialu mini dimagoli wu heagome í̠naga embone mo ko hayada.
Isaraele bedarume í̠hondo gi haragola í̠na ti mo guya halu mo hondo haga ke. Ai Yuda wali mbira birayadagome í̠naga dimagoli ko wiridago mo hengedo waharagoni.
Ai libugua hendenedago wali agali ogoni libu ira agile teneha ko bialu heneyabe, lene. Ani hale hayagola agali godi hale haga biagome ladai bialu lalu, Ira hale timbuni heago teneha kayu bialu haribiya, lene.
Ani layagola Danielehanda lalu, Í̠ ke̱ haregoni. Í̠naga ke̱ ogonime í̠ni bo waharagoni ndobe. Ai ayu Anduane Homogonaga dahuliyali mbira í̠ dibu dagabuki holenaga ayu tibu nene gadele giha yu kagoni ndobe. Ai libu kirabali biba holeberebi, lene.
Ani layagola wali agali bibahendeme bi hongo howa ladagadaga bialu Ngode Datagaliwabehanda wali agali ibunihondo mini mbiraorewi kago biamogo biaga kagonaga mini yaraga halu hene.
Ani bialu agali godi hale haga kirali biagolabome bi henene letingi howa ke̱ halu gi do lalu laribigo ke̱ore haya lalu Danielehanda ti mo walia hayagola wali agali tigua libuhondo keba timbuni hene.
Mosesenaga mana lo ngagoha bi ogodagua leda. Mbiralime ke̱ howa godi lalu mendeali kago pani nelo mule lalu karia handa walia harimiyagua nde mende ali pani nelo mulene manda biyago ibuni nelo mulene nga, lalu gilibu nga. Anidagua bialu tigua agali kirali godi hale haga biagolabo homelo balu wali Susana ko mbira nabi biago mo wialu haru dai bini.
Ai Hiligiabi Susana ai̱yabi Susana agalini Yoagimibi Susana damene bibahende ibu hayarubi tigua Susanaha ko bini mbira nawiyago hondowa ti turu timbuni halu tigua Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mini yaraga halu hene.
Horo ogoningi howa Daniele ibu agali mini lene timbuni mbira ka lalu hatagi ho hene.
Ai Kini Asadiagese homayagola Pesia dindi howa agali mbira mini Sairusu henego ibu kini ha aribia hene.
Daniele ibu Kini Sairusunaga nenegeore howa kinihanda Daniele gubalini timbuni haga hene. Kini ibugua Daniele gubalini timbuniore ho hagagobi ibunaga nenege maru bu karu nahaga hene. Danielenaga biabe kini mini bayaleru talebu miaga hene.
Babilono wali agalinaga bi pupu wiaga gime wabini mbira mini Bele laga wini. Horo bibahendengi wali agalime balawa bayaleoreru mbasegedi nuha honowa nu homberiabi (12) nogo sibi pira mariabi (40) waini iba dewaore genda magi manda lida handari kirani pira duria (250) lowa urunidagua Belenaga loma wiaga wini.
Ainde Kini Sairusu ibugua Bele ogoni galoneorebe toba ho howa horo bibahendengi ogonihondo bi pupu wu piaga hene. Anigo ainde Daniele ibu ibunaga Ngode Datagaliwabe kagohondo bi lalu haga hene.
Ainde horo mbirungi kini ibugua Danielehondo hale halu lalu, Í̠na Belehondo bi pupu nawi kego irane agibe, lene. Ani hale hayagola Danielehanda ladai bialu lalu, I̱na mbirale bi pupu wulenaga agali gime wabini urunialehondo bi pupu nawiaga ko. I̱ Ngode Datagaliwabe ibuni holeneyi howa ibugua hari daliga dindibi wabialu wali agali bibahende handame ho howa haru haga kago andaneha haga ko, lalu ladai bini.
Ani layagola kini ibugua lone hale halu lalu, Í̠na inanaga bi pupu wiaga ngago ibuha holene nayi nga larego irane agome. Mbirale horo bibahendengi loma bu mialu kemaru naiore haga ngago nahendedebe, lene.
Ani layagola Daniele ibugua oba halu lalu, Kini-o í̠ tigua mohondo halu helo waholene nakarulape mbira kegoni. Mbirale bi pupu wiaga mini Bele ogoni dindime wabuwa daliga mboronosime para hadambi howa ngago ogonime tomobi ibabi mbira nolene nakarulapeore ndobe, lene.
Kini ibugua bi ogoni hale howa ibu tandaga emene ndo howa ibugua Belenaga loma binigo mo miaga agali bu hearu ibidaba lene. Ibiyagola ibugua tihondo hongo howa lamialu, Tígua bi pupu wiaga Bele ogonime tomo loma bu mialu kemagonaga lalu heneneore mo walia naharimiyagua nde tí homalimulo bo wahai holebero. Anigo ainde bi pupu wiaga Bele ogoni ibugua loma wialu kemaruni bibahende heneneore naiore haga ngago mo walia harimiyagua nde Danielehanda inanaga bi pupu wiaga baya ngago mege biyago ainde ibuni homelo, lene.
Ani layagola Daniele ibugua kinihanda bi layadago karulape lene. Agali Belenaga loma binigo mo miaga pira karia (70) bibahende howa ti one waneiginibi bere hene.
Ai Daniele ibu kini heba bi pupu wiaga Belenaga anda heagoha pene.
Piyagola Belenaga loma binigo mo miaga agali hearume lalu, Kini-o ina bibahende tagira piai haramagola í̠nime tomobi waini ibabi tebolo dagia ngagoria mo manda manda bu wiai habe. Ani wialu í̠ni tagira pialu panga baya hangu paya dai bialu kininaga magi pangani helabe. Ani bialu egerebahagi dai bibe. Dai buwa handalu keria Bele ibugua tomo uruni nai nahe wiagua nde í̠na ina bibahende bo wahai habelo. Anigo tomo uruni nai hayiyagua nde Daniele ibugua inahondo bi ko layagonaga ibuni homelo, lene.
Anigo ainde agali loma binigo mo miaga uruni tigua anda ogoni tamuha panga wia do hene mbira dagia wiago andaneha ngelo howa ti mogo nale hene. Ani ngelowa mbiraga bibahendengi tigua panga wia do hene ogoniha anda puwa tomo ngago nai halu piaga hene.
Ai agali loma binigo mo miaga biaru ti peagola kini ibugua tomobi waini ibabi dagiani mo manda manda bu wiai hene.
Ani wiai heagola Danielehanda agali ibunaga biabe bia haga hearuhondo lamialu, Be abalu dewaore dugu yalu ibuwa anda tamuha wali agali ge haga wiagoria dugu paya bu ngeladaba, lene. Mbirale ogoni biyago kini ibu hangu hendene. Ani biai halu ti tagira puwa panga payadai bini. Payalu kininaga magi pangani de hondo wialu ti andaga pene.
Anidagua bialu peagola mbiraga urumaha agali Belenaga loma binigo mo miaga hearubi ti one waneigini bu hearubi bibahendeore horo bibahendengi biaga winidagua panga haraba wia do hene biagoha anda puwa tomobi waini ibabi dagiani manda manda bu wiyago naiore hene.
Egerebagiore kini Danielela heyalu Bele bi pupu wiaga andaha tomo wiyago hondole pene
Puwa kini ibugua Danielehondo lalu, I̱naga gi magigo hondole pangani helarugo budayadabe nabudidabe, lene. Ani layagola Danielehanda ladai bialu lalu, Agali haguane-o nabudida, lene.
Ai kini ibugua panga dugualu anda puwa handalu hearia tomo dagiani manda manda bu wiyago nawiyagola ibugua lalu, Bele í̠ timbuniore. Í̠ ke̱ nahaga kegoni, lene.
Ani lole lalu heaore dege Danielehanda oba halu kinihondo hondo ha hondo ha lowa lalu, Ai dindi ge haga ngagoria de ala handa. Ai i̱ hale holiya ge hayadago ogonaga ge lalu langi, lene.
Ani layagola kinihanda ge biago hondowa lalu, Walibi agalibi waneiginibi hai hayadane hendedo, lene.
Ani lalu kini ibugua keba timbuni howa, Agali loma binigo mo miaga biarubi ti one waneigini heba ibaiore hadaba, lene. Ai tigua ibalu anda tamuha panga haraba wiado hene ngagoha anda ibalu tomo nai haga wiago kini hendelo mo walia hene.
Ani biyiyagola kini ibugua badaba layagola agali loma binigo mo miaga biaru homelo bo wahai hene. Ani bialu kinihanda wali agalinaga bi pupu wiaga Bele wiago Danielehanda Bele heba ibunaga anda timbuni heagobi bo gialabaga bialu mo ko hai hene.
Babilono wali agalinaga bi pupu wiaga puya timbuni mbira wini.
Ainde mbirungi kini ibugua Danielehondo lalu, Ainde í̠na bi pupu wiaga puya timbuni ngago ibuha holene nayi nalolebere. Ibu holene yiore ngago ai í̠na ibuhondo bi pupu wulene karulape, lene.
Ani layagola Danielehanda ladai bialu lalu, I̱na Anduane Homogo ibu hangu holenehe kago ibunaga mini hangu yaraga haruli.
Ai kini-o í̠na karulape lariyagua nde i̱na puya timbuni ogoni bo waholebero. I̱na ogoni bole howa i̱na ayu tibu wai biagane nene gadele ngagobi kangobi mbira nayi howa bameore homelo bolebero, lene. Ani layagola kinihanda ladai bialu, Karulapego í̠na babehedabe hondole pu, lene.
Ani laya handala Daniele ibugua puwa mundu kalaro ale mbirale mindibi ndobabi wiagobi nogo habene wiarubi wali agalinaga mandaribi mo biamaga howa todobeneha hiruwa deagola mo molo̱ molo̱ bigi buwa puya biago nelo mini. Puya biagome mbirale uruni nai hayagola ibunaga tombene timbu halu pururu lalu tulalaki hene. Ani homayagola Danielehanda tihondo lalu, Tínaga bi pupu wiaga wiyuago ogonibe, lene.
Ani biyago Babilono wali agali bibahendeme hale hai howa tigua keba timbuni howa tinaga kini bope hole manda biai hene. Tigua hongo howa lalu, Ai inanaga kini biago ibu ai Yudali hayada. Abale inanaga bi pupu wiaga Bele bo pambulabaga bu wahai halu agali Belenaga loma binigo mo miaga hearu bo wahai hayago. Ani bialu mani inanaga puya dama bi pupu wiaga wimago bo wa hayada, lene.
Tigua kini berearia puwa kinihondo lalu, Daniele ibu inanaga giha minu ya habelo hame ledema. Anidagua layagola iname í̠nibi í̠ one waneiginibi í̠ damene bibahende bo wahai holeberema, lene.
Tigua genda timbuniore kini mo ya hene. Anidagua biyagola ibugua gi timbuni howa Daniele tinaga giha minu ya hene.
Ani biyagola tigua Daniele minu yalu puwa gundu uli laiono heagoha bape hene. Ani buwa tigua horo waragaria uli laiono haga wiagoha ngelo hene.
Gundu uli laiono haga ogoniha laiono karia hene. Horo mbira mbirani laiono ti wali agali kira nalu nogo sibi kira naga hene. Anidagua biaga henego ai horo ogoningi laiono urunime Daniele balu nelonaga tigua laiono tomo nami hene.
Horo ogoningi agali Anduane Homogonaga bi mana latagi haga agali mbira mini Habagugu Yudiaha hene. Ibugua agali maru mabuha biabe bialu widi gandulo mogo bialu hearunaga tomo dawa yalu polenaga nogo mbiriniru todobeneha iba heba dawa yalu mberediru ogoniha budu ibira haga buwa yalu pole pialu hene.
Harigani pialu hearia dahuliyalime ibuhondo lamialu lalu, Í̠na tomo ogoni Daniele nelo Babilono yalu pu. Daniele ayu ogoni Babilono dindiha uliha laiono haga wiagoha minu bape henego beda, lene.
Ani layagola Habaguguhanda ladai bialu lalu, Í̠ Babilono nahendene kogoni. Ani bialu laiono uli ogoni agoha ngabe i̱ manda nabi kogoni, lene.
Ani layagola dahuliyali biagome Habagugunaga mandari heagoria yaraga howa yalu harini puyabu poradagua bialu Babilono yu pene. Yalu puwa Babilononi laiono uli wiagoria kaware yu ibira hene.
Ani biyagola Habaguguhanda lalu, Daniele Daniele-o Ngode Datagaliwabehanda í̠naga tomo maru wia hayago mo ibu, lene.
Daniele ibugua Habaguguhanda bi layago hale howa Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi ogodagua lene. Ngode Datagaliwabe-o í̠na i̱ mitangi bu haga kegoni. Wali agali í̠ gubalini haga karubi embeda nahagaore kegoni, lene.
Daniele ibu abale heyuwa tomo nalu berea handala Ngode Datagaliwabenaga dahuliyali biagome Habagugu yalu ibuni dalu yu dai bini.
Ai horo kaneni kini ibugua Danielenaga dugu bulenaga laiono uli wiagoria pene. Puwa uli biagoha handape halu hearia Daniele laionome balu na nabi berearia hendene.
Ani hondowa kini ibugua hongo howa ladaga howa lalu, Danielenaga Ngode Datagaliwabe í̠ hangu Anduane Homogo kegoni. Í̠ hangu Ngode Datagaliwabeore kegoni, lene.
Ani lalu agali bu hearu hondo lamialu Daniele uliha bedago irigi halu ibilo yamidaba lene. Ani bialu kini ibugua Daniele bolene manda biaga hearu tini laiono uli biagoha minu bape hadaba layagola tigua minu bape hene. Ani bape hayagola kini ibuni de hondo heaore dege laiono biarume agali biaru abale balu buda migimigi bialu nai hene.
Alegesanda ibu Masedonianaga Kini Pilibi igini howa ibugua ami agaliru haru halu Masedonia dindi wahalu Pesia dindi Midia dindilanaga Kini Dariusula wai bule pene. Ani bialu Alegesanda ibugua Dariusu bope halu ibu Pesia dindinaga kini ho aribia hene. Pigane Girigi wali agali hangunaga kini hene.
Alegesanda ibugua wai dewaore bialu tano hongohe wiaru balu bo bodahana haga bini. Ibugua dindi kaundia tara tara wiaruha wai bialu kini bu hearu bo wahai halu dabudabu bayale tara tara wiaru mo page bigi bialu dindi anda bo labu haga bini.
Ani bialu ibugua dindi bibahende wiaru handame hai ho howa ainde ibu gibiore mbira kogoni lo mitangi bu hene.
Ibunaga ami agali hongoheore dabo helowa ibugua dindi tara tara bu wiarubi wali agali uruniha hearubi kini hearubi handaya ho heagola tigua ibu dagisi migi bialu hene.
Mani howa Alegesanda ibuni warago timbuni bayagola ibuni homeleda lo manda bini.
Ani manda bialu ibugua agali maru ibuni baba mandagi igiri emeneni howa hama ibalu ayu ti ami agali haru bamba haga heneru bibahendehondo dindi ibugua handaya ho heneru ti mo tahaga bini.
Alegesanda ibu mali homberia kini halu homene.

tini dindi uruninaga kini haga haga bini. Ani bialu mani howa ti igini aguanerume tini henegoria henge mialu ho aribia haga bialu mali dewaore hene. Ani howa tigua wali agali dindini hearu genda timbuni dewaore mo migi bialu hene.
Andiogusu Ebipanese ibu Kini Andiogusu tebone henego ogoni igini howa ibu kini agali ko henedaru aria mbira hene. Ibu tano timbuni Lomo wiagoria garabaya henego ai Giriginaga mali daga handari mbira pira tebirani karia (137) layagola ibu kini hene.
Horo odaruningi Isaraele dindiha wali agali Anduane Homogonaga bi mana mo wahaga maru howa tigua wali agali mo luluya halu lalu, Ai wali agali tara Anduane Homogo mitangi nabiaga kaware karu baba mandagi biabe biamaga halu holene nga. Inane hangu hemagola genda tara tara wiaru inaha anda ibugu biyagonaga ani bulene nga, lene.
Wali agali dewaoreme bi ogoni bayaleda lalu
marume turuore howa tigua wali agali tara Anduane Homogo mitangi nahaga tara karunaga mana ngago talialu bulenaga tigua kinihanda bule pudaba larabe hondole gerai lalu kini hale hole pene.
Ani bialu tigua gini biagane hama timbuni mbira Girigi dindiha wabu wigi biadagua Yarusalemeni wabu wini.
Ani bialu Isaraeleali tinaga tingini podene heago lone heladai bini. Tigua anidagua binigome habo nalolene bi Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ti baba lo wiyago pugini. Ani bialu ti wali agali tara tara Anduane Homogo mitangi nahaga hearubaba nenege halu howa tigua mana ko tara tara wiaru bialu hene.
Andiogusu ibunaga gabumane biabe bulene wiago buwa mo hongo hai howa ibugua Iyibi baba wai bialu Iyibinaga kinibi ibu dege howa ibugua dindi kirabali handaya ho holene hame lene.
Ani manda buwa ibunaga ami agali hongohe hearu haru halu Iyibi pene. Ibugua wai biaga garo ale nogo hosime gililaga karisi wiarubi nogo timbuni tara mini elepana hearubi haru halu nogo hosirubi haru halu sibi dewabi heba pene.
Pialu Iyibinaga Kini Tolemi heago baba wai bini. Wai bialu howa Tolemi ibu gi halu ibida dai bialu pu waore hayagola ibunaga ami agali bu hearu bibahende bo wahai hene.
Andiogusuhanda Iyibi dindiha tano hongohe wiaru bo poda anda howa ibu karu lai halu wali agali tinaga dabudabu wiaru damene bibahende mo hilo yai halu bini.
Ai mali handari mbira pira mariani tebira (143) hayagola ibu lone dai buwa ami agali dewaore haru halu Isaraele dindihabi Yarusaleme tanohabi wai bule pene.
Ibugua mineore tara howa Ngode Datagaliwabenaga anda heagoha anda puwa mbirale lotunaga wiaru damene mo yai hene. Anduane Homogonaga lomabu delaga dabu ngolome wabini heagobi lamu hale hedo wiaga gene hearu heba biabe ogoninaga biaga wiarubi
tebolo dagia mbira mberedi Anduane Homogo lomabu minigo wiaga heagobi waini iba hambu lomabu miaga gabo be wiarubi ira hagua ngabilo delaga mini inisenesi lomabu delaga ndisibe beledirubi labolabo timbuni Anduane Homogo anda tamu Hobane Loma Bia Heneore hoba amu heagoha panga paya amu haga heagobi mo yalu yári tara tara ngolome wabini wiarubi mo yai halu bini. Ani bialu anda biago haneni ngolome yári bia hearu gialo yai hene.
Ani bialu silibabi ngolobi gabo be tara tara muni dewaoreme yolo bu wini wiarubi muni bibahendeore mo do hearubi mo yai halu pene.
Mbirale uruni bibahende ibu dalu mo yu piai hene. Ibugua wali agali dewaore bo wahai halu mbirale o biyadaruninaga ibu wayaliore timbuni tingi howa ibuninaga mini yaraga halu hene.
Ani biyagola Isaraele dindi bibahendeha kiabu dugu dewa bialu hene.
Agali haguane hearumebi agali haru bamba haga hearubi tigua dugu timbuniore bini. Wandari igiri daliahe bu hearunaga hongo pirilope halu wali baya biragaru dengui mo koheru berene.
Agali maru ti wali aidege daubu hearume kiabu dugu bialu haga haga bini. Wandari maru agali andaga ayudege pene berearu dugu bialu biru wima pene.
Ainde wali agali dugu biyagome dindi dumbidumbi biyagola Isaraele hameigini bibahendeore taga hai hene.
Mali kira piyagola kini ibugua ami agali haguane mbira ami agali dewaore haru halu Yarusaleme wali agaliha dagisi muni mule pudaba lene.
Agali ami haru haga ogonime bi bayale lalu howa ke̱ halu ibunaga miniha ko mo hondo holene mana palia to̱le hene. Wali agalime ibunaga bi bayale layagoha mini pelai howa hale ho wai heagola wai abale hedope halu wali agali bu hearu bai hene. Ibugua ti bope halu Isaraele wali agali dewaore bo wahai hene.
Ibugua Yarusalemeha mbirale bayale wiaru mo yai halu tano bibahende bo heda haiore hene. Anda bu hearubi tanonaga wai pabe hongohe egeme bini heagobi bibahende irame bo heda hai hene.
Wali waneigini bu hearu garabaya helai halu nogo bulumaga bu hearu kayu haru hai halu bini.
Ani bialu mani howa tinime Yarusaleme tanonaga hobane mbira mini Debidinaga Tano laga wiagohayagi hagira bu mialu ege pabe daligaore biadaga howa pabe neneni ami agali mamage howa handapugu bu haga andaru bu helaga bini.
Ani buwa tigua agali maru mana ko ngago bialu mana puguaga hearume tinaga anda hongohe ogoniha mamage howa handaya ho helo helene.
Tini holenego mo hongo hai howa tini tomo nolenebi wai biaga alerubi mo mogo bu wiai hene. Ani bialu tigua mbirale Yarusalemeha page mo yayaruni anda ogoniha mo do howa wiai hene.
Tigua Isaraele wali agali baba waitigi timbuniore halu maru Anduane Homogonaga andaha pole piyaru mo gi haga bialu hene.
Wali agali bayaleru Anduane Homogonaga anda biagoha berearu homelo bo wahai haga bini. Mana ko tigua biyagome Anduane Homogo anda loma biahe baya heago mebia halu mo dodohe helene.
Wali agalime gi timbuni howa ti Yarusaleme wahalu ibida piai hene. Ani piai hayagola Yarusaleme wali agali tara hearu ti dege dalu wini. Wali agali tara dindi taraha howa ibini hearu tinaga tano buhinu wini. Yarusaleme wali agali tini tano ogoni wahalu piai hene.
Ngode Datagaliwabenaga anda biago wali agali naheha bameore ho wahene mbira ani hene. Horo timbuni turu ho haga winingi dara howa dugu bialu holene wini. Sabada horongi tagaho holene horo wia aribia hene. Ani wiagola wali agali tigua anda biago bayale mini lene ka lalu mini yaraga nahene. Ani nabi tigua anda ogoni mege bialu bi ko hangu lalu hene.
Bamba Yarusaleme mini lene daliga winigo ai ayu ibu tagabiore nga. Abale ibu turu ho hene. Ai ayu ibuha turu holene biago beregedalu dara holene wia aribia ka.
Ai kini ibugua mana mbira wabialu lalu, Wali agali bibahende dindi ibugua haru howa handaya ho kago bibahendeha bu kamiru tígua tíni dindinaga mana ngago wahai halu mana mbiraore hangu biame halu dindi mbira wali agali haradagua bialu halimu, lene.
Wali agali bibahende dindi bibahendeha bu hearume kininaga mana ogoni karulape lai hene.
Ainde Isaraele wali agali dewaoremebi kininaga bi layadago talialu howa mbirale bi pupu wiaga gime wabini wiaruhondo bi pupu wialu lomaru bu mialu howa Sabada mana lo ngago wahaiore hene.
Ai kini ibugua beba mbira gili buwa agali marume yalu Yarusalemehabi Yuda dindiha tano maru ngaruhabi piai helene. Ibugua beba ogoni gilibu wia howa lalu, Mana gahenge ngago talialimu, lowa pelene.
Ibugua tihondo lawia halu, Loma damene bibahende loma irame dai helolenebi widi lomabu delolenebi waini iba odo lomabu delolenebi uruni bibahende wahai halimu. Ani bialu Sabada horongi biabe bialu lotu laga horo timbuni tagira ibirangibi biabe bilimu.
Tí Anduane Homogonaga anda kagobi agali anda ogoniha biabe bialu loma binigo mo miaga karubi bibahende mo nagalone hai helalimu.
Ani bialu tigua mbirale bi pupu wule gime wabini ngagonaga andaru bia halu lomabu delaga daburu bia halu dindi wiabagi heneru mo ngelaga bilimu. Loma bo delole howa nogoru ema bialu piaga marubi tinaga maname nabiaga ngago bo lomabu delalimu.
Tí igini taba hanaragola dongone podo mabu bulene nawiore. Ani bialu tínaga maname tíni Ngode Datagaliwabenaga deni dodohe holino nabiagane ngago bialu halimu.
Tigua mana bamba Anduane Homogohanda Mosesehondo mini yu kago wahai holene nga. Ani bialu mana ogoni mo bagi halu waore holene nga, lene.
Ani lowa kini ibugua lalu, Wali agali mana ogoni talia nabi kago ibu homelo bo waholene wulebira.
Ani lalu ai kini ibugua bi ogoni dindi ibugua handaya ho howa haru hene wiago bibahendeha piai helene. Ibugua agali haguane maru wali agali haru helo dabo helaga bialu howa lalu, Yuda dindiha tano ngaru bibahendeni mbirale bi pupu wule gime wabini ngagohondo loma mialu halimu, lene.
Ainde Yuda wali agali dewaore agali haguane uruninaga bi hale howa talima pialu Anduane Homogonaga bi mana lo wini ngago erembira mialu piai hene.
Anigo mana ko ogoni bialu howa Yuda wali agali maru dindi tara tara wiaruha ibida pugu pugu binigo ai dindi tara uruniha hadoho haga haga biai ka.
Ainde ege mini Kisilebenaga horo nguini (15) mali handari mbira pira mariani duria (145) hayagola Kini Andiogusuhanda bidaba layagola mbirale ko taraore ogoni Anduane Homogonaga anda kagoha lomabu delaga dabu heagoria, Mo wilimu, lene. Ani bialu tigua Yuda dindi maru wiaruha loma bu delaga dabu bu helai hene.
Ani bialu anda harabanibi hariga pedago bibahendenibi ira hagua nga biaga inisenesiru delaga biaga wini.
Ani bialu howa tigua Mosesenaga bi mana lo wini mbuga mbira ngane handayagua tigua budabaga buwa iraha delaga hene.
Mbirali ibu habo nalolene bi lo winigonaga mbuga yu howa Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mana taluwa bialu heagua ogoni ibu homolene nga lalu kini ibugua bi hongohe ogoni lo wini.
Ege dewaoreni Isaraele wali agali tinaga tanoha hearia minu yania hene biaru mo ko timbuni halu hene.
Ai ege mini Kisilebenaga horo pira kirani duria (25) hayagola tigua mbirale bi pupu wiaga gime wabini biarunaga lomabu delaga dabu Ngode Datagaliwabe ibuni kagonaga lomabu delaga dabu heagoria wiadambi haga biagoria lomabu delene.
Tigua kininaga mana lo wiago talialu walime ibu igininaga tingini agalime podamabu bidaba lene bedaru bo wahai hene. Waneigini gali henedago ai̱ya ibuni mani pongobia howa libu haru homelo bo wahaga bialu hene.
Ani bialu tinaga damenerubi agali waneigini galinaga tingini podaga hayadagobi bibahende homelo bo wahai hai haga bini.
Ani bialu heago helowa Isaraele wali agalime kininaga bi mo wahalu Anduane Homogonaga maname tomo nanolene leago damene bibahendenaga hene.
Isaraele wali agali tigua habo nalolene bi Ngode Datagaliwabela lo winigo pugualu tomo tara tara maname nanolene lo ngaru nanole howa tini homolene karulape lalu homole manda manda bu hene. Anidagua bialu hayagome wali agali dewaore homai hene.
Ai ogoningi ti genda timbuniore yu hene.
Horo ogoningi Madadiasa ibu Yarusaleme wahalu Modeini tano pu hene. Madadiasa ibu Yone igini howa Yone ibu Simeono igini hene. Ani bialu Simeono ibu agali loma binigo mo miaga Yahoiaribi aria mbira hene.
Madadiasa ibu igini duria hene. Igiri mbirago mini Yone henego ibu mini mende Gadi laga hene.
Igiri mende Saimono henego tigua ibu mini Tasi laga halu
tebone mini Yudasa henego mini mende Magabeusu laga halu
manego mini Eleasa henego mini mende Abarana halu dauni mini Yonadana henego mini mende Abusu laga hene.
Ai Madadiasa ibugua handalu hearia wali agalime Yuda dindi bibahendenibi Yarusalemenibi tigua Ngode Datagaliwabenaga bi mana lo wini ngago bibahendeore puguai halu heago hondowa ibugua lalu,
Ainde mbirale ko ayu íbu ngaruni hondoliya i̱ ai̱yahanda i̱ aginaga taba henenedabe. Ainde Ngode Datagaliwabenaga tano loma biahe wiago bo gialahole biai hene wialu wali agali i̱ damene bu heneru bibahende homai hayago i̱ni deme hendedogoni. Ai horo tano ogoni waitigi heago mo miyangi wali agalime de hangu handaya ho bereagola agali tara tagira howa ibini biarume Ngode Datagaliwabenaga anda kago ti karulalu handaya ho kagonida.
Agali mini nawi daga nawi mbira kaligobi Anduane Homogonaga anda biago mo ko halu mo ngubia hene kagonida.
Mbirale lotunaga biabe biaga wiaru bibahende waitigime mo yu piaiore hayagonida. Waneigini bu hearu tano gibuni wiagoha bo wahai haya. Igiri daliahe hearu wai biagane ayu tibu nene gadele ngagome dabalu bo wahai haya.
Ainde ayu wali agali dindi tara tara wiaruha howa Isaraelenaga tano wiaruha íbu hai howa tinaga mbirale wiaru mo pagebu yai haragonida.
Tanonaga yári tara tara wiaru bo gialo yai haya. Ayu ibuha mbirale mbira nawi bameore garabaya biabe bia haga agali hagagobi nga. Ani bialu ibuni hameledago bilo golope hene ndo nga.
Anduane Homogonaga anda baya taraore kago de handa. Bamba ibu inanaga yári biahe taraore mbira hayago ai ayu agali tara bu hearume ibalu bo gialohole binigo ibuha mbirale bayale lenego mbira nawi bameore ngagoni ndobe.
Ainde inabi homai holene ngago nahome ibagabu kemago agua buleda, lene.
Ai Madadiasa halu ibu iginiru tinaga miniha genda timbuni yu howa tinaga aga bu hearu minu lerelai halu dara ho howa karu lagane aga ko wiaru karu lo howa dugu bialu hene.
Ainde kininaga biabe biaga agali haguane wali agalime Ngode Datagaliwabe erembira mialu helo mo bia haga bu hearume Modeini tanoha wali agali bu hearume mbirale bi pupu wiaga gime wabini wiagohondo bi pupu wilo mo bia hole ibini.
Isaraele wali agali dewaore agali haguane uruni heba mandagi heagola Madadiasa hangu ibu dameneru heba mandagi gibuniha hene.
Ani heagola agali haguane kininaga biabe biaga biarume Madadiasahondo hale halu lalu, Í̠ agali tano ogonaga haguane howa ogoha mini lene timbuni mbira í̠ kegoni. Ani kegola í̠ igini bu karubi í̠ damene bu karu tibi nde í̠ talima ibaga kagoni.
Ai í̠na kininaga bi ledago talialu ho bamba howa bialu ha nabi kego agibe. Wali agali tara tara bu karume Yuda wali agali heba maru Yarusalemeha karubi tigua taluwa bialu kago. Ainde í̠nabi ogonidagua bialu hariyagua nde í̠nibi í̠ iginibi tí mini kininaga nenege laga karu aria dege holeberemi. Ani howa ti mini lene timbuni howa muni silibabi ngolobi yári tara tarabi bame mo turu halu ngulebira, lene.
Ani layagola Madadiasa ibugua hongo howa bi ladai bialu lalu, Wali agali bibahendeore dindi bibahende kini ibugua handaya ho kagoha bu karume ti mamalinaga bi pupu wiaga mana ngaru wahai halu kininaga mana ngago talialu hai heaguabi i̱na anidagua bulene nawiore.
I̱nibi igini bu karubi i̱ damene bu karubi ina bibahendeore Ngode Datagaliwabehanda habo nalolene bi inanaga mamaliru baba lo winigo hongo howa yu haabo holeberema.
Heneneore gi dolalu larogo iname Ngode Datagaliwabenaga bi mo wahalu polenebi mana lo wini ngago pugualu polenebi nawiore.
Iname kininaga bi hale naholeberema. Ani bialu inanaga lotu laga ngago mo aribia naholeberema ndobe, lene.
Madadiasa ibugua bi ogoni lai hayagola Yuda agali mbirame wali agalinaga deni heyu howa mbirale dama mitangi bialu bi pupu wiaga gime wabini wiagonaga lomabu delaga dabu wiagoria heyu howa lomabu mule bialu hene.
Ani biyago Madadiasa ibu de hondowa ibunaga miniha tandaga timbuniore ira hunguale bialu tingini bibahende durula gimbu bini. Ani biyagola abale pogolalu pua agali lomabu delole bialu hayago ayu tibume gaibu dibuwa lomabu delaga dabu ibuni hayagoria ngelene.
Ani buwa kininaga biabe biaga agali haguane wali agalihondo loma ogoniale bu deladaba lowa bi lalu hayagobi o heagoriani heaore abale tibume burulaki ho ngelene. Ani buwa bi pupu wiaganaga lomabu delaga dabu bu heleagobi bo gialo wahai hene.
Ainde Madadiasa ibugua o biyadagoni Ngode Datagaliwabenaga bi mana lo wini ngago yu tiga ogobi bido lalu mo walia hene. Bambaore Piniasahanda Salu igini Simiri ogonidagua dege bialu bo wahene.
Ani bialu Madadiasa ibu hariga pugu biagoha pialu howa bi ladaga halu lalu, Wali agali maru Anduane Homogonaga bi mana lo ngago mitangi bu haabo howa ibunaga habo nalolene bi lo ngago talialu haga kemiru tí ayu ogoni i̱ talima ibidaba, lene.
Ani lalu Madadiasa halu ibu igini biaru tinaga mbirale wiyadaru bibahende tanoha ngelalu tini hari bare wiagoha ha do hole ibida pene.
Horo ogoni Isaraele wali agali dewaore Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mana ngago talialu hole hame lene.
Ai ti genda tandagala dewaore yu henegome ai tinaga walibi waneiginibi tinaga nogo bulumagarubi dabudabu wiarubi mo yai halu dindi ko wali agali nahaga wiagoha hole pene.
Ani peaha ami haru hagabi ami agalibi Yarusaleme Debidinaga tano wiagoha anda hongohe biagoha hayaru ti hale halu hearia wali agalime kininaga bi mo wahalu tini ha do hole ibida piya layago hale hene.
Ani hale halu ami agali dewaore wali agali uruni haruru talima pene. Pialu wai Sabada horongi bulenaga ti heago hondowa tinaga deni balai anda abale bini.
Ami agali haru haga agali haguane bu hearume Isaraele wali agali bu hearuhondo laamu halu lalu, Ayu ogoni tínaga henge emeneore ngagonigo ainde tí ha do harimidagoha howa tagira ibalu kininaga mana ngago talialu harimiyagua nde tí homolene nawulebira, lalu laamu hene.
Ani layagola wali agali biarume ladai bialu lalu, Ndo ina naibuleberema. Kininaga bi ogoni hale naholeberema. Ani bialu Sabada horo mana ngago napuguleberema, lene.
Ani laya handala ami agali biarume wai abale tungulope halu pene.
Anigo ainde Yuda wali agali tigua wai biadai nabini. Tigua ege to̱le̱ wiarume dugualu bolenebi tinaga bira do hagane wiago hagira bulenebi bibahende nabiore bame handaya ho hai hene.
Ani howa tigua lalu, Karulapego ina homoloma̱ya waha. Inaha ko bini nawi bameore hene kemago bame bo waharamigo mana ko timbuniore beremi. Ai ko birimi lalu latagi holene dindi ngagola dahuliya andagala libu ngagoni ndobe, lene.
Ainde waitigi biarume Sabada horongi wai bini. Ani buwa tigua wali agalibi waneiginibi bibahende daosini mbira (1,000) homelo bo wahai halu tinaga nogo bulumaga bu hearu heba bo wahai hene.
Ai te Madadiasa halu ibu damene biaru ti hale howa dara timbuni hene.
Ani howa ai tini dege bi la la bialu lalu, Ina damene urunime biyadadagua nabimi̱ya. Tigua waitigi baba wai bialu badai nabiyadagome tininaga holenebi mana lo wini ngagobi kirabali yu wahai hayada. Ainde inamebi ogonidagua dege birimayagua nde ina damene lenego mbira dindini nahe hameigini mbirago erebaore holobada, lene.
Ani lalu horo ogoningi dege tigua bi pongo wialu lalu, Ai waitigime ina baba wai Sabada horongi biyagua nde inamebi wai biadai bimi̱ya. Inabi nde ina damene maru tinaga ha do haga wiagoha homayadagua dege homoligo wai biadai bimi̱ya, lene.
Ai Isaraeleali agali wai biaga hongohe pari wayali Hasidi hameigini laga heneru ibalu Madadiasa heba hatago hene. Ainde Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mana lo wini ngago baba waitigi ho karu baba wai bulenaga ibini.
Ani bialu Isaraeleali abale ibida pialu ha do ho heneru ibalu Madadiasanaga ami heagoha hatago hai hene.
Agali uruni hatago hayagola ami agali hongohe mbira tagira pene. Ani howa tigua Isaraele agali mana pugualu piaga biaru baba keba ndo howa ti baba wai bini. Isaraele agali ko uruni aria maru ibida pora bialu puwa wali agali Anduane Homogo mitangi nahaga bu hearu baba pu hene.
Ai Madadiasa halu ibu nenege agali biarume dama mitangi bialu gime wabini bi pupu wiaga biarunaga lomabu delaga dabu bu helearu bibahende bo gialo wahai hene. Tigua Isaraele igiri emene ngola haga biyaru minu yania howa
tinaga dongone abale poda mabu nabi heneyagua tigua podaga bini.
Tinaga waitigi mine haga biaru bama talima pialu ai wai bayaleore bialu hene.
Tigua agali haguane bu hearumebi agali kini hearumebi Anduane Homogonaga bi mana Mosesehanda lo wini ngago tigua mo nagalone howa pugualu helo hame nale hene. Ani howa tigua agali mana ko biaga bu hearunaga hongo bope hai hene.
Ai Madadiasa ibu homole biruwa ibu iginiruhondo lamialu lalu, Mine holene mana hongoheore tagira ibalu ina bibahendeore bahandai haya. Ayu kemagoni genda timbuni bu ngangi kema.
Anigo tí i̱ igini bu kemiru tígua Anduane Homogonaga bi mana lo ngago hongo howa yu halu tigua Ngode Datagaliwabenaga habo nalolene bi ina mamaliru baba lo wini ngago hongo howa talialu kemigonaga harugo lowa homole manda manda bu haabo halimu.
Ina mamaliru ti dindi ogoria heangi howa bialu henerubi biabe tigua bialu hene ngarubi baya hangu mitangi bialu halimu. Baya hanguore talialu halimu. Ani bialu kemigola tínaga mini yaragaore hene timbuni howa mani holobadarume tínaga mini manda biaho haiore holebira.
Abarahama henego mitangi bilimu. Ibugua Ngode Datagaliwabehondo mini mbiraore hongohewi henego ai Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ibu bahandayangi ibu pi nale hene. Ani heagola Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ibu agali tigabiore ka lene.
Ani bialu Yosebe ibu nde genda ibuha anda ibiyangi ibu Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mana baya hanguore talialu heagome ibu Iyibi dindiha agali haguane hene.
Inanaga mamali Piniasa ibugua nde lotu mana baya hanguore hongo howa talialu heagola Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ibu damene hangume Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga haabobo holebira, lalu lamini.
Yosua ibugua Mosesenaga mana wiago hongo howa yu heagome ibu Isaraele wali agalinaga agali haguane hene.
Kalebehanda dindi hondo wialu dai buwa dindi ogobi wia lalu te lama dai biyagome dindi timbuni mbira ibu yolo ale tigua ibu tu wa mini.
Debidi ibu dindi Ngode Datagaliwabenaga nenegeore heagome Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ibuhondo bi lo wialu lalu ibu damene hangume kini haabo holebira lalu bi lo wini.
Elayahanda Ngode Datagaliwabenaga bi mana lo wiago hongo howa yu haabo henegome Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ibu mo yalu dahuliya andagaha pene.
Agali tebirali Hananiabi Asariabi Misaelebi ira timbuni de agoha bo delearia Ngode Datagaliwabehanda tigua ibuhondo mini mbiraore hongohe wua heago hondowa ibugua ti dugu eda halu pelene.
Daniele ibu agali bayale tigabiore heago hondowa laiono hearume balu nelo Anduane Homogohanda ibu yupe nahene.
Tígua ina mamalirunaga mana bayale bialu hene uruni baya hangu mitangi bialu mana uruni baya hangu mo yalimu. Mbirali ibu Ngode Datagaliwabehondo mini mbiraore wua haga heagua nde ibu pi nalaga.
Agali ko karunaga bi hongohe lalu kago hondowa tí gi nahalimu. Tinibi homalu tínaga dabudabu baya tara tara mo ngoaiho kago ereba hai haga ngago manda bilimu. Ani howa mani tinaga tingini dindiha padagola ngoe bedaru tinaga tomo holebira ndobe.
Heneneore ayu ti mini lene timbuni bu karunigo ainde yawi ti dindi ogoria naholebira. Tinaga tingini dindiha poragola mbirale tigua bule manda bu hayaruni tini heba mandagi ereba hamaga holebira.
Anigo i̱ igini kemiru tí Ngode Datagaliwabenaga bi mana lo ngagome agali mini lene helaga ngago manda buwa tí Ngode Datagaliwabenaga bi mana ogoniha hongo mialu halimu.
Tí hamene Saimono kago ibu agali manda timbunibi ka. Ani kago manda bialu ibu tí aba haradagua helo tígua ibunaga bi larago hale halimu.
Yudasa Magabeusu ibu wene igiri emene heangi howa ibu agali hongohe henego ka. Ani kago manda bialu i̱na ibu tínaga agali haguane helo dabo helarogo ibugua tí haru halu wai bamba holebira.
Agali Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mana ngago baya hangu talialu haga bu karu olalu tí heba mandagi mo ngoai ho halimu.
Wali agali tara tara Anduane Homogo mitangi nahaga bu hearume inahondo mana ko biyaru mitangi bialu pani migi bilimu. Ani bialu Anduane Homogonaga bi mana lo wini ngago baya hangu talialu haabo halimu, lene.
Ai Madadiasa ibugua ibu iginiru Anduane Homogohanda mo bayale helo bi lalu ibu homene.
Mali handari mbira pira mariani waragoria (146) layagola ibu homene. Homayagola ibunaga tingini ibu mamalirunaga homali Modeini tanoha heagoha hora hene. Ainde Isaraele wali agalime dara timbuni howa dugu bialu howa hora hene.
Yudasa Magabeusuhanda ibu aba Madadiasanaga henge mialu ibu aba henedagoria ho aribia hene.
Ani heagola ibu hamene bu hearumebi wali agali ibu aba heba mandagi haga bu hearumebi bibahende mo mogo bu howa ibu biamogo bialu hene. Ani bu howa tigua Isaraelenaga wai bu winigo tigua bu gilila mialu wai bule manda bini.
Yudasa ibugua bialu heagome ibunaga wali agali bibahende mini lene hene. Ibunaga yari wai pole karulaga wiaru mo karulowa agali timbuniore haradagua hene. Ibugua danda timu yandarerume waitigi bu karu bo wahaiore haga hene. Ibugua ayu tibu wai biaga ngago giha yu howa ibu damene bu karunaga dindi anda bu kago mamage ibuni haga hene.
Ibu laiono gabua hongohe hagadagua howa nogo meme sibiru balu nole hame lalu haabo hagagobi hene.
Ibugua wali agali Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mana mo wahalu pene karu taya bima ibaga bialu haabo haga hene. Ani bialu wali agali marume ibu aria heneru balu iraha bo heda haga hearu baya hangu taya bialu haga hene.
Agali ko bu hearume ibu hondowa gi halu tini mbirani mo mogo bu biruwa duru lalu haga wini. Anigo ainde agali ko biaga uruni mbira ibida palene henge nawioreni hene. Ainde Yudasahanda wali agali golope hene bayale helonaga biabe bayale ogonidagua bialu hene.
Ibugua kini dewaorenaga miniha mo tandaga halu haga hene. Anigo ibugua Isaraele wali agali mo turu halu haga heagome Isaraele tigua ibu mo turu halu ibunaga mini yaraga halu haga hene.
Ibugua Yuda dindiha tano wiaru bibahendeha ibaga biai halu wali agali ko biaga bu hearu bo wahai hene. Isaraele dindini genda timbuni bu wiaru bibahende mo wahaiore hene.
Ibunaga mini timbuni mo yaraga hene dindi wiaru bibahendeha wali agali bu hearume hale hai hene howa ibugua wali agali pu ereba holene hearu haru dai bialu hene.
Ani bialu heagola Aboloniusuhanda ami agali dewaore Ngode Datagaliwabe mitangi nahaga bu hearubi Samaria agali bu hearubi bibahendeore haru halu Isaraele baba wai bule ibini.
Ani ibira layago Yudasa ibu hale halu ibugua Aboloniusula wai bule abale puwa ibugua ti bogo hana hai halu Aboloniusubi homelo bo wahalu bini. Waitigi agali uruni aria maru homai haya handala maru ti ibida piai hene.
Tigua wai biai halu waitigi bo wahene wiarunaga mbirale wiaru mo ngoai halu howa Aboloniusunaga ayu tibu wai biaga wiago Yudasa ibu mo yini. Ani mo yuwa ibu yu haabo halu homalu wahene.
Ai Yudasahanda ami agali dewaore haru ka layago Sirianaga ami agali haguane mbira mini Serono heago ibu hale hene. Ti Ngode Datagaliwabehondo mini mbiraore hongohewi howa ti wai baya hangu hongo howa biaga agali hongoheore ka layane hale hene.
Ani layago hale howa Serono ibugua mitangi bialu agali kininaga bi mo wahaga Yudasanaga ami uruni baba wai bialu bo wahai holiya. Ani buwa dindi bibahende kini ibugua hendene ngaruha i̱ mini yaraga hene timbuniore holiya lo mitangi bini.
Ani bialu ibugua Yudasala wai bule piyagola Yuda agali ko bu hearume ami agali Isaraele baba wai bule ibiyaru biamogo bialu wai Isaraele baba bule pene.
Ani puwa ti hariga Bedehorononaga hari bare wiago iralu daulene hari bare wiagoria ibalu heaore Yudasa halu ibunaga ami agali emene dege daga lene hearume abale Serono halu ibunaga ami agalidaruni ngola hole pene.
Ani puwa handalu hemiria ami agali dagalabe naheore ibiyago hondowa tigua Yudasahondo lalu, Ainde inanaga ami agali emene dege kemagonime ami agali dewaore ibirago bope agua holedabe. Ani bialubi ina horo ayu hina tomo nane kemagome ina hongo nahe kemagoni ndobe, lene.
Ani hale hayagola Yudasahanda tihondo ladai bialu lalu, Emene hangume ami agali dewaore kago bope holene erekuibi ndo nga. Ami agali dewaore heaguabi emene hangu heaguabi Ngode Datagaliwabenaga deni ogobi degedege holebira.
Wai beremagola ami agali dewaore kagome ndo wayali holene nga. Ani ndo ami agali Ngode Datagaliwabenaga minini hongo ho howa birago ibu wayali holene nga.
Waitigi uruni ti mine haga howa mana ko dewa bialu hagabi howa ai ina baba wai bule ibira. Tigua inanaga wali waneigini biru karu bo wahai halu inanaga dabudabu tara tara bayale ngemaru mo yu polenaga ibulebira.
Ani biragola iname nde inanaga dindi ngagonagabi inanaga yutiga bu haga mana ngagonagabi wai buleberema.
Anidagua beremagola Ngode Datagaliwabehanda inanaga waitigi bu karu bo wahaiore holebirago iname gi nahe wai hongo howa bimi̱ya.
Ai Yudasahanda bi ogoni lai halu abale pora bialu Serono halu ibunaga ami agaliru baba wai bule pene.
Ani puwa Isaraele tigua waitigi biaru Bedehorono hari bare wiagoria howa bama talima pialu dindi ulini tigabi wiagoria talima tagira pene. Anidagua bialu tigua waitigi uruni handari halira (800) bibahende bo wahai hayagola maru pora bialu Pilidia dindiha piai hene.
Anidagua biya layago hale howa Ngode Datagaliwabe manda nabiaga bu hearu bibahendeme Yudasa halu ibu hameneru gi timbuni ho hene.
Yudasahanda galone timbuni uruni bialu ka layago kinimebi hale hene. Wali agali dindi tara tara wiaruha bi tara tara laga bu hearumebi Yudasahanda waitigi karu bo podahana halu wayali haga lalu te layago lai hene.
Ai Kini Andiogusu ibugua mbirale Yudasahanda bialu ka layago te hale howa ibu tandaga timbuni hene. Ani howa dindi ibugua haru howa handaya ho hene wiaruha ami agali hearu bibahende olomogo biai howa ami agali dewa daga labe naheore hene.
Ani heagola kini ibunaga muni anda heago panga duguwa ami agali biaru bibahende mali mbiranaga karulape yolo miai hene. Ani mialu ibugua tihondo lalu, Wai bule manda manda bu haabo halimu, lalu lamini.
Anidagua buwa handalu hearia ibunaga muni bibahende biba holene tiga bialu dagisi munibi tubagi hene. Anidagua binidagoni irane ibunaga mana abale wiagadago mo iriari bialu mana wabu aribia hayagome genda timbuni ogoni dindi bibahendeni tagira ibai hene.
Anidagua biyagola abale bini ngadagua ibunaga muni biba holilo manda bini. Ani tubagi haragola ibugua mbirale gahenge munime yolo bulenebi mbirale tara tara bayale muni dewaoreme miaga ngaru wali agali mo turu halu migi biagadagua nabulubada lo manda bu hene. Ibugua wali agalinaga gubalini ba mialu ibuha hatago helo mbirale bame ta hagadagome kini maru karubi ndo ibu daliga bolangua hene mbira hene.
Ibunaga bu miniha genda wiagome mo heya hayagola mini burugu timbuni lo howa ainde ibugua agali dewa lone mo mogo bulene manda buwa ai Pesia dindiha dagisi muni mo palene manda bini.
Andiogusu ibugua agali mbira ibuni damene dege agali haguane mini Lisiasa heago dindi bibahende iba Yuberedisi poragola Iyibi dindila hengeneha wiaru handame ho howa gabumane haguane helo dabo helene.
Ai kini ibu Pesia dindiha pole howa ibugua Lisiasahanda kini igini Andiogusu bayale halu dai bilo handaya ho habe lalu dabo helene.
Ibugua Lisiasahanda ibunaga ami agali nogo elepana heba kagohayagi haru howa handaya ho helo dabo helene. Mbirale ogoale bibe lalu bi baya hanguore lamiai hene.
Ani bialu Yudia dindihabi Yarusalemebi pialu wai buwa dindi anda bo heda hai halu bo gialo wahai habe lalu Lisiasa lamini. Wali agali dindi bibahendeha bu karume Isaraele wali agali Yarusaleme wali agalibi mbira hene lo manda nabi embeda ho wahai helo bo hilo wahaiore habe lene.
Ani lowa tinaga dindi ngagoria wali agali tara tara bu karu haru puwa dindi ogoriani ho aribia helo tuwia ta hai habe lalu kini ibugua Lisiasa lamini.
Ani lalu kini ibugua ami agali halu mende hearu haru halu dindi dunini timbuni Andiogo tano wiagoria howa pene. Mali ogoni handari mbira pira mariani karia (147) layagola tagira pene. Iba Yuberedisi peago domalu Pesia dindiha pole pene.
Lisiasa ibugua agali maru ami agali haru helonaga Dorimenese igini Tolemibi Niganobi Gogiasabi tigua haru helo dabene. Agali tebirali ami agali wai biaga pari wayaliru howa ti mini Kininaga Nenege laga hene.
Ti mbira mbirame ami agali daosini dege pira maria (40,000) geni ibaga bialu wai biaga daosini karia (7,000) nogo hosi erekunini biruwa wai biagaru haru haga haga biaga hene. Ani mo taho helowa Lisiasa ibugua ami agali urunihondo lamialu Yudia dindi bibahendehabi Yarusaleme tano ngagoriabi anda pugu bialu kinihanda bilimu lalu langiyadagua bibahendeore bo hilo wahai hole pudaba lalu lamini.
Ani laya handala tigua abale pialu dindi tigabi bayale Emaiasa tano kaware dindi wiagoria balai anda bini.
Ani bialu ami agali tidi mbira Idumia howa tidi mende Pilidia howala ibalu hatago hene. Agali biyinaya biaga tano kaware haparapara hearu tigua hale halu hearia ami agali wai biaga hongo gibihe ogoni ibira layago hale howa tigua lo manda bialu ami agali hongohe urunime ibalu Isaraele bo podahana halu maru garabaya biabe ale biaga helo muni taguirangi tigua maru yolo bule manda bu hai hene. Ani howa tigua muni siliba ngolobi dewaore hanalu wali agali hendeho yalu polenenaga senipubi yalu ami agali balai anda bu heagoria íbu dege bini.
Ai Yudasa halu ibu damene bu hearu tigua handalu hemiria balai anda ti daluha biyagola ai tiha mo ko holene waitigi abale anda ibiyadalo manda biai hene. Ani bialu kinihanda lalu, Isaraele wali agali bibahendeore bo hilo wahai halimu, lalu ibunaga ami agali hearu lamiya layago ti hale ho dege hene.
Ani hale ho howa ai Isaraele wali agalinaga mini mo hongo halu tinaga dindibi Anduane Homogonaga anda kagobi wai hongo howa bimi̱ya lalu hongo ho hai hene.
Ai wali agali bibahende íbu ngoai ho howa wai bule manda manda bialu Ngode Datagaliwabehondo ti dara howa biamogo bibe lalu ibuhondo bi lalu hene.
Yarusaleme tanoha bame dindi hangu wini. Wali agali mbira hamani puíbu nabiore wini. Agali Ngode Datagaliwabe mitangi nahaga hearume anda hongohe hearu ti mo wialu tigua ta nabi Anduane Homogonaga anda hamelo howa anda mebia halu biya. Isaraele wali agalinaga lone turu ho holene nawini. Ani bialu ngidaru balu iba gana baya laga winiru ereba hene.
Ai Yudasa halu ibunaga ami agali biaru tigua Yarusaleme abene be tagiraha bamba tinaga mamali Isaraelerume lotu laga dindi mini Misiba wiagoria mo ngoai ho hene.
Tigua horo mbira tomo nane hai halu dara ho howa karulagane aga ko wiago mo karulalu be abalu tinaga emboneni dugu wialu tininaga aga bayale biaru lerelo wahai halu bini.
Ainde wali agali Anduane Homogo mitangi nahaga bu karu tigua mbirale mbira bule howa tinaga bi pupu wule gime wabini wiagohondo hale haga wini. Anigo Isaraele wali agali tigua bi mana gilibuwi mbuga ngago anga lowa Ngode Datagaliwabenaga hame ngago hale haga nga.
Tigua agali loma binigo mo miaga bu karunaga aga karulaga ngaru yalu ibalu widi lomabi yu ibalu mbirale ngarunaga pini lomabu mulenebi yalu ibugu biaga nga. Ani bialu agali maru tinaga bule lalu bi lo winigo biaiore hene mini Nasa laga kago íbu lalu biaga hene.
Ani buwa tigua Anduane Homogohondo bi lalu, Ngode Datagaliwabe-o iname Nasa o karuhondo agua beremabe. Ani bialu mbirale o ngelo kemaru agua beremabe.
Agali bu hearume í̠naga anda mo ko halu mebia hayagola ayu mebia hene ko dodohe kagoni ndobe. Ani bialu í̠naga agali loma binigo mo miaga biaru ti dara timbuni howa tinaga nawiore bame bu kagoni ndobe.
Agali tara Anduane Homogo mitangi nahaga bu hearume ina balu bo bibaore holenaga ina baba wai bule ibira. Inaha ogoale bule ibira lalu í̠ni manda bide.
Ainde í̠nime ina biamogo nabiriyagua nde inanenaga hongome heyu holene karulape kemabe, lene.
Ani lalu tigua pilipe hongo howa pulalu wai huaro hongo howa ladagadaga bini.
Ani bialu maha Yudasa ibugua ami agali biaru mo tale bigi buwa tidiyu haga haga bilene tidi yu haga haga biyadagua maru pirali (10) halu maru pira duria (50) halu maru handari mbira (100) halu maru daosini mbira (1,000) halu buwa ona tidiyu haga haga bilene. Ani buwa ti haru bamba holene agali maru tidi mbira mbira headagua mo taho helene.

Ani bialu ibunaga ami agali uruni Emaiasa tano wiagonaga gibuni mbira unurahayagi balai anda bialu hene.
Ani bialu Yudasa ibugua ibunaga ami agali biaruhondo lamialu lalu, Aiore tígua agali Anduane Homogo mitangi nahaga bu karu baba wai bule manda manda bu halimu. Tigua Anduane Homogonaga anda bo gialo wahai halu inanebi mbira wanahe bibahende bo wahaiore hole íbu ka.
Ina bame howa ti birago de handaga bu kemaria inanaga dindibi Anduane Homogonaga anda kagobi bo gialo haealabagabu wahai holigo wai beremagola ina waiha homolene karulape nga.
Anigo ainde Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ibunime hame ledadagua bulebira, lene.
Gogiasa ibugua ami agali daosini dege duria (5,000) geni pialu wai biaga halu daosini mbira (1,000) nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga henego ai tigua tinaga balai anda bu hayagoria howa mbira tagira pene.
Agali maru Yarusalemeni anda hongohe biagoha mamage haga hearume ti hariga walia hene. Gogiasa ibugua Yuda ami kagoria mbiraga anda puwa wai mbiraga bu manda bini.
Ani bira layago Yudasa ibu abale hale ho bolangua halu ibugua ami agali haru halu Emaiasa tano wiagoria puwa kininaga ami biaru baba wai bialu hene.

Egerebagi gaolalu biyagola Yudasa halu ibunaga ami agali daosini tebira biaru hama tigabi wiagoria pu hene. Ani bialu ti dewali wai pialu karulagane agabi wai biagane ayu tibubi nawi hene.

Baya hangu mitangi bidaba. Bamba Iyibi kini heagome ibunaga ami agali haru halu ina mamaliru talima iba solowara mini Daramabi laga wiagoria ibiyagola Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ti mo wialu biamogo bini.
Ayu nde Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ina dara halu biamogo bilonaga ibu olama. Bamba ina mamaliru baba habo nalolene bi lo wiyago lone mitangi bu dai bialu iname wai hamani porabupe halu wai beremangi ibugua waitigi bame hengedopaya bilo iname ibuhondo bi lama.

Ainde Anduane Homogohanda ti biamogo biyagola tigua wai buwa tigua waitigi bope halu wayali hayagonaga turu howa wali agali bibahende dindini bulupalu ibira howa Anduane Homogonaga mini yaraga halu ibuhondo lotu lene.
Horo halira bibahendeni tigua lotu lalu lomabu delaga dabu ogoni Anduane Homogonaga ngelo mo loma bia halu hene. Tigua turuore halu loma irani dai helolene lomaru yalu ibalu Ngode Datagaliwabela hogimbu bulenaga lomaru yu ibalu Ngode Datagaliwabehondo ka̱i̱ lolene lomaru yu ibalu bini.
Tigua ngolomo pu payuwa mo yaribia haga buwa wai biaga humbi wiaru mo yáribia howa Anduane Homogonaga anda haneni wini. Ani bialu tigua wai pabe panga hearu baya hangu arema bialu agali loma binigo mo miaga hearunaga anda hobane bo gialahole bini wiaru lone mo arema buwa biadai bialu pangaru baya hangu wabu helaga biai hene.
Wali agali tigua mbirale ti mo taga holenaga agali Anduane Homogo mitangi nahaga hearume mo yu íbu wini biaru mo wahai howa ti turu timbuni ho hene.
Ani howa ai Yudasa halu ibu hamene biarubi Isaraele wali agali bibahendebi tigua bi lo mbira halu mali bibahendeni horo Anduane Homogonaga lomabu delaga dabu mo loma bia haramago mitangi biaabo hamalo. Lotu lolene horo timbuni ogo ege mini Kisilebe laragola horo pira kirani duria (25) haragola ngoai howa horo halira bibahende lotu lalu hami̱ya lalu bi lo wini.
Ai tigua Saiono neneni Anduane Homogonaga anda kagoha ege pabe hongohe daligaore bu mabu buwa pabe neneni mamageali anda hongohe bu helaga bini. Waitigi agali Anduane Homogo mitangi nahaga bu hearume abale ibalu mbirale Anduane Homogonaga mo loma bia hene wiaru hengeda hai halu mebia halu penedagua bulino pabe hongohe bini.
Ani buwa Yudasa ibugua ami agali maru dabalu Anduane Homogonaga anda mamage helo helene. Ani bialu Idumia dindi ngagohayagi handa daibu holenenaga tano hongohe Isaraele wali agalinaga tano Bedesu mo hongo howa ngelene.
Wali agali dindi kawareni bu hearu ti hale halu hearia Yuda wali agalime Anduane Homogonaga anda bo gialo wahayago lone hongohe biadai bialu Anduane Homogonaga lomabu delaga dabu biago lone biadai bialu mo bayale ho nga layago hale howa ti mogolo hene.
Ani howa Isaraele wali agali maru ti baba haga ti daluha hearu bibahende bo wahai holene manda bini. Ani buwa tigua Isaraele wali agali hearu mbira bo wahaga bialu hene.
Iso hameigini Idumia dindiha bu hearume Isaraele henge nami tigua hapai hayagonaga ai Yudasahanda ti baba wai bini. Ibugua Agarabadene dindi wiagoria wai bialu ibugua ti bope halu ibu wayali howa tinaga mbirale wiaru mo yai halu pene.
Ani bialu mana ko abale Baiana hameiginirume binigo Yudasa ibu mitangi bu dai bini. Wali agali uruni tigua Isaraele wali agali mo ko halu genda tara tara deware mo mialu haga hene. Tigua harigani bira do howa wali agali harigani bolangua haga biaru minu balu mo ko haga biaga hene.
Ani heago hondowa Yudasahanda wali agali bibahende Baiana tanoha hearu mamage haga tano pabe neneni anda daliga bu heagoha agali mamage hearu heba ho hagira bu yaanda hene. Bibahendeore homelo bo wahaiore hole lalu gi dolalu bi lene. Ani lalu puwa anda mamage haga daligaore bu helene hearu heba wali agali anda tamuha bini hearu bo heda hai hene.
Ani bialu mani Yudasa halu ibunaga ami agali biarume puwa Amono wali agali baba wai bule pene. Amono tinaga ami agali hongohe dewaore howa Timodi ibugua haru howa handaya ho haga hene.
Ani agali uruni beba Yudasa ibugua wai biaabo halu howa ibugua ti bope hai hene.
Ibugua wai buwa Yase tano karu lalu dindi emene wiapara para biarubi karu lalu bini. Ani biai halu Yudia dai bini.
Ani biagola dindi hobane mbira mini Gileada agali buhearume Isaraele wali agali tinaga dindiha bu karu baba wai bialu bibahende bo wahai hene. Ani biyagola Isaraele wali agali ti Dadema dindiha ha do holene anda hongohe heagoha pu hene.
Ani pu howa tigua Yudasa halu ibu hamene biaruhondo beba gilibu pelalu howa lalu, Wali agali Anduane Homogo mitangi nahaga oali bu karu tigua Timodinaga ami agaliru baba ho biamaga haya. Ani biya handala ina ibida puwa anda hongohe ogoha ibu kema. Anigo agali ko uruni tigua anda hongohe ogonibi giala holebu wahai holebirago

Ina damene dewaore tano mini Tobo wiagoria heneru bo wahai haya. Ani bialu wali waneiginiru garabaya helalu tinaga muni dabudabu wiaru mo page biai haya. Wali agali ogoniha henego bibahende daga daosini mbira (1,000) agima kaware dege henego homai haya, lalu bi lo wia hene.
Yudasa ibu beba ogoni wene daga lalu heagola agali mbira Galiliha howa beba mende yalu ibini. Agali mani ibiyadaruni tigua dara ho kago walia halu biagadagua tinaga agaru budabaga bu yalu ibini.
Ani ibuwa tigua lalu, Agali bibahendeore tano tebira Tolemesebi Taiabi Saidonobi heba agali bibahendeore Galilinaga abene uyurahayagi haga hearume tinaga ami agali dewaore mo tago bialu ina bibahendeore mbiraorebi mbira pora bialu napelo bo wahaiore hole ibira laya, lene.
Yudasa halu ibunaga wali agalirume bi ogoni hale howa ainde ti damene waitigi giha howa homai holobadago biamogo agua bimabe lole ti mo ngoai hene.
Ani mo ngoai howa Yudasa ibu hamene Saimonohondo lalu, Ina damene Galiliha haruago biamogo bule pelo agali maru abale dababe. Ai i̱ Yonadana iyame Gileada porabago, lene.
Ani bialu Yudasahanda ami agali maru hearu tigua Yudiaha baya hangu handaya ho halimu lene. Ani lowa ibugua agali kirali wali agali Yudiani hayadaru handaya ho helonaga Segaraia igini Asariala Yosebela dabo helene.
Ibugua libuhondo lamialu lalu, Wali agali ogoria karu libugua handaya ho halibulo helarogoni. Waitigi maru karu baba wai bulumini nabilibu. Ina dai buluma̱ya hondo halibu, lene.
Ani lalu ami agali daosini tebira (3,000) bibahende Saimono heba Galili pole pene. Ani piyagola ami agali daosini haliria (8,000) bibahende Yudasa heba Gileada dindi pole pene.
Saimono ibugua puwa Galiliha wali agali Anduane Homogo manda nabi hearu baba wai bialu bibahende bo podahana hai hene.
Ibugua bo padama pu dege bialu Tolomese tano tagira pialu daosini tebira (3,000) agima homene bo wahai hene. Ani bialu ami agali bo wahayarunaga danda timu yári tara wai pialu karulaga ale karulo haabore wiaru ti mo yai hene.
Ani bialu Yuda wali agali Galiliha bu hearubi Arabadaha hearubi bibahendeore mo mogo biai halu ti one waneiginibi tinaga dabudabu wiarubi heba yai halu Yudia dindiha dai bini. Ani biyagola wali agali uruni ti turu timbuniore hai hene.
Ogoni dege Yudasa Magabeusu halu ibu hamene Yonadana halu ami agali biaru Iba Yodana domalu horo tebira pialu dindi ko wali agali nahaga wiagoha pene.
Puwa tigua Nabadia hemeigini bu hearu ngola hayagola uruni tigua ogolabohondo turu timbuni howa mbirale bibahende Yuda wali agali Gileada dindiha hearunaga te baya hangu lamiai hene.
Tigua lalu, Yuda wali agali dindi ogoniha tano hongohe timbuni Bosora tanohabi Boso tanohabi Alema tanohabi Kasabo tanohabi Magede tanohabi Kanaimi tanohabi garabaya hai heleda.
Ani bialu Yuda maru Gileada dindiha tano emene ngaruha garabaya hai heleda, lalu lamini. Ani bialu Yuda wali agali lenego bibahende horo mbira hanguni bo wahai halu tinaga anda hongohe karu yawi dege bo gialo wahai hole tagira polebira, lalu lamini.
Ani layago hale howa Yudasa halu ibunaga ami agali biaru tigua dindi ko iba dalu naibi dindi ko wiagoha tano Bosora wiagoha pole pene. Pialu tigua tano ogoniha hearu baba wai bialu wali agali tano ogoniha haga bu hearu bo wahai howa tano bo heda halu wali agalinaga dabudabu tara tara wiaru ti mo yai halu bini.
Ani ti mbiraga hangu puabo halu tano hongohe mini Dadema wiaga kawareha Isaraele wali agali anda bu heagoria anda pene.
Egabi layagola Yudasa halu ibunaga ami agali biaru tigua handalu hemiria ami agali dewaoreme tanoha anda hongohe heago bo gialaga laga bialu hearia hendene. Tigua wai bulene masini tara tarabi wai pabe irigi holenaga egageriabi mo yalu íbu howa wai bulenaga wai pabe hongohe heago bo giala hole biyago de hendene.
Yudasa ibugua mbirale uruni biyago de hondo howa hale halu hearia tanoha wali agalime ga̱ hongo howa ladagadaga bialu pilipe layuagola ai wai biyada lo manda bini.
Ani hale howa ibunaga ami agali bu hearuhondo lamialu, Ayu ina hameneru biamogo bialu mo wulenaga wai hongo howa bimi̱ya, lene.
Ibugua ibunaga ami agali biaru halu tebira mo tale bialu waitigi erembira wiagohayagi wai bia aribia hene. Yuda tigua nai hongo howaore bialu waitigi bope howa tigua Anduane Homogohondo bi hongo howa lene.
Ai Timodinaga ami biaru tigua Yudasa Magabeusu ibiyago hondowa ti beregedalu ibida piai hene. Horo ogoningi Yudasa halu ibunaga ami agali biarume waitigi ami agali daosini dege halira (8,000) bibahende geme hengedai howa bogai hene.
Ani bialu Yudasa ibugua Alema tanoha wai bule pene. Puwa ibugua wai bialu agali tano ogoniha haga hearu bo wahai hene. Wali agalinaga dabudabu wiaru ti mo yai halu tano bo heda hene.
Ani bialu Kasabo tano bo podalu Magede tanobi Boso tanobi Gileada dindiha tano maru wiarubi bo heda hai hene.
Ani biyagola maha Timodihanda ami agali maru hearu lone mo ngoai howa Labono tanola hengene tubari iba gana emene wiago kawareni balai anda bialu hene.
Ani bialu heagola Yudasa ibunaga ami agali hearu aria marume waitiginaga balai anda bu heagoha baya hangu hondo wu pudaba lene. Ani laya handala marume hondo pialu dai buwa tigua lalu, Agali Anduane Homogo mitangi nahaga dindi ogoniha hearu bibahende tidiyu pialu Timodinaga ami agaliha hatago howa agali dewaore ka.
Timodihanda ami agali maru Arebia dindiha bu hearu ibu biamogo bule wai ibuha anda ibilo munime yolo bialu ibunaga ami agali dewaore hea. Ani howa tigua ina baba wai bule iba doma ederayagi balai anda buwa manda manda bu hea, lene. Ani laya handala Yudasa ibugua wai bule pene.
Yudasa halu ibunaga ami agali biaru iba ange wiago kaware ibiyagola Timodihanda ibunaga ami agali haru halu bamba haga bu hearuhondo lamialu lalu, Yudasahanda iba domalu ina kemagoha ibu ala ibiyagua nde iname ibu babe nahe ibugua ina bope holebira.
Anigo ibugua iba domalu naibi iba angeni hondo hayagua nde iname iba domalu puwa wai bialu ina ti bope halu wayali holeberema, lene.
Ai Yudasa halu ibunaga ami agali biaru bia ange wiagoria íbu howa ibunaga ami agali haru haga bu hearu iba angeni ibu hai helowa tihondo lamialu lalu, Ami agali tí bibahendeore wai pora biai halimu. Mbira hangubi hadai nabilimu, lalu lamini.
Ani lalu ai Yudasa ibuni wai pole bamba halu ibaha pora bialu piyagola ami agali bibahende piai hene. Ani piyagola ami agali Anduane Homogo mitangi nahaga bu hearu ibida pugupugu biai hene. Danda timu timbuni yiaru wahai halu ibida puwa Kanaimi tanoha bi pupu wiaga gime wabini wiagonaga anda timbuni heagoha ibida pialu birado hai hene.
Ani biyagola Yudasa halu ibunaga ami agali biarume haruru talima puwa anda timbuni ogoni heba wali agali anda ogoniha birado hearu bibahende bo heda hai hene. Yudasahanda Kanaimi tano bo podahana hayagola wali agali tano ogoniha hearume mo ko holene mbira Yudasahondo lone bibe nahe hene.
Ani bialu Yudasahanda Isaraele wali agali Gileada dindiha hearu bibahende mo mogo biai halu Yuda dindiha haru dai bini. Ti piyagola daga lamibe naheore dewaore tidiyu pene. Wali agali tara tarabi wali waneiginibi tinaga dabudabu wiarubi heba piai hene.
Ti pialu tano timbuni mbira mini Eberono ege pabe hongohe bu mabubi wiagoria pialu hemiria wali agali tano ogoniha hearume waipabe panga hongo howa payatagi hene. Ti hariga ogonidagua pialu tano ngago pu balalu pubagi halu polene henge nawiore hariga mbiraore hangu tano tamuha bolaangua halu polene mbiraore wini.
Anigo wali agali tano ogoniha haga bu hearume Isaraele wali agali bolangua halu pelo henge nami tigua ege to̱le̱ timbuni wiaru muwa pabe panga hongo howa payatagi hene.
Anidagua biyagola Yudasa ibugua bi bayaleore lo pelalu lalu, Ina tí daluha hariga dege bolangua halu inane dalu pole poloma̱ya henge ngidaba. Iname tíha ko mbira bulene manda nabi bame hariga dege bolangua halu poleberema, lene. Ani layago Yudasanaga bi hale nahe tigua panga payaho haabo hene.

Yudasa ibugua agali bibahende bo wahai halu tano ogoni bo gialahole biai halu tanoha wali agalinaga mbirale bayale wiaru bibahende mo hilo yai halu bini. Ani bialu Yudasa halu ibunaga ami agali biaru agali tinime bo wahene wiaru tinginini ge haga bialu pene.

Tigua wai biyagohabi hariganibi mo ko halubi waiha homabi nabi dege haabo halu dai biyagonaga turu timbuni hama Saiono nene irigi halu Ngode Datagaliwabehondo turu howa ka̱i̱ lama pialu loma irani dai holene lomaru bu delole pene.

Ani bialu heagola Yudanaga ami haru haga Yosebela Asariala libu hale halu hebiria tebirali hamenema biarume wai bialu tigua bo podahana haga bima pora layago te hale hene.

Ai Yudasa halu ibu damene biaru ti beregedalu Pilidia dindiha Asadodo tano wiagohayagi puabo hene. Ani ogoniha wiaru bo gialo payabu wahai halu Yuda dindi dai bini.
Kini Andiogusu mane ibu Pesia dindiha dindi timbuni Mesobodemia wiagoha howa hale halu hearia tano mbira mini Elimaisi nga layane hale hene. Tano ogoniha siliba ngoloru dewawi mini lene mbira nga layago hale halene.
Mbirale dama mitangi bialu bi pupu wiaganaga anda tano ogoniha hayadagoha mbirale bayale damene muni dewame yolo miaga dege dewaore nga layago hale hene. Wai humbi ngolome wabini wialu wai pole karulagane yari damene dewaore anda ogoniha nga layago hale hene. Mbirale uruni Masedonia Kini Alegesanda ibugua anda ogoniha mo winiya. Alegesanda ibu Pilibi igini howa Girigi dindiha kini timbuni mini lene pigane ibu henego ogonime mo wini.
Ani nga layago hale halu Kini Andiogusu ibugua Elimaisi tano puwa wai bialu mbirale uruni mo kayu bule manda bialu hearia wali agali tano ogoniha hayadarume te ala hale ho bolangua howa Kini Andiogusu ibiyagola tigua manda manda bu heneyago wai biadai bini. Ani biyago Andiogusu ibugua mbirale mo page bule piyago mibe nahe hene. Ani biya handala Andiogusu ibu beregedalu Babilono dai buwa ibunaga bu miniha genda timbuni ho hene.

Í̠na mbirale Hiriribi Hondolene Gibiore lomabu delaga dabu Yarusalemeni wiagoria mo wirigoni Yuda tigua mo wahaya. Ani bialu pabe hongohe daligaore ala hayagobi ndo lomabu delaga dabu kago bu mabu bida. Ani bialu í̠ninaga tano Bedesu ngago tigua karulalu mo hongo howa ngeleda, lalu lamini.
Ani layago hale howa kini ibunaga miniha genda timbuni howa mini burugulo berene. Ani biyagola ibu warago bamialu dagiani paliaabo henego irane mbirale ibugua bule mende bu wiyago damene bibahende mo habo lai hayagola ibunaga miniha mo ko hai hayagola dagiaha wiaabo hene.

Ani manda buwa ibugua agali maru Kininaga Nenege laga hearu mogo buwa ibugua tihondo lalu, I̱ u palibe naheore genda timbuni ngagome i̱naga bu gubalini nedagome i̱ mo ko kagoni.
Ainde i̱nihondo hale halu genda tara tara i̱ha tagira ibirago irane agidabe. Bamba nde i̱ha mo palia holene karulo kagola wali agalime i̱hondo turu hai hagago.
Anigo ayu i̱na ko bialu mbirale lotunaga biabe biaga ngolo silibarume wabini Yarusalemeha wini mo yu pirugomeda. Ani bialu Yuda wali agali bame bo waharugomeda.
Ai i̱na mbirale uruni birugome genda uruni i̱ha anda ibiyada lo manda bido. Ainde ayu i̱naga miniha ndibu lai harugo ai i̱ dindi kaundia ogoha homoleda lo manda bido, lene.
Ani lowa Andiogusuhanda agali mbira mini Pilibi ibu Kininaga Nenege laga heaga olo íbu lowa ibu dindi bibahende Andiogusuhanda hondo haga wiaru bibahende ibugua handaya ho helo dabo helene.
Ani helowa kininaga mandabi agabi gi hondene magibi Pilibihondo miai hene. Ani mialu ibu igini Andiogusu dauni kagobi nde mani kini helonaga mana baya hangu lawai helo lamini.
Ani lalu Kini Andiogusu mane ibu mali handari mbira pira mariani dira (149) layagola dindi kaundia ogoniha wialu homene.
Ani Andiogusu homaya layago Lisiasa ibu hale howa ibugua wali agali bu hearuhondo Andiogusu homayago ai ibu igini mini Andiogusu dege kagome ibu abanaga henge ibuni miya. Lomo tigua Girigiali one waneigini bu hearu garabaya haru hai halu dabudabu wiaru mo pagebu yai halu dindibi ti karulalu bini. Lomo tigua Girigi dindiha wai pabeanda hongohe wiaru bo gialo wahai halu wali agali bu hearu garabaya biabe ale bia haga helalu binigo ayu ani wiaabo henego nga.
Lomo agali tigua dindi bibahendebi dindi iba dombeneha wiarubi wali agali Lomo agalihondo mine hayaru bibahende bope hai halu bini.
Ai hameigini maru Lomo agali baba nenege howa ti heba mandagi haga bu hearume ti baya hangu handaya ho habe lalu olaga bialu hene. Tigua mana ogonidagua bialu kini kaware hearubi kaundiaha hearubi bibahende bo podahana hai halu bini. Ani biyagola wali agali bi te uruni hale hayarume Lomo agalia gi howa mogo lalu hene.
Ani bialu Lomo tigua dindi mbiraha agali mbira kini heloa hayagua nde kini helaga biaga. Ani bialu mbirali kini henego dugu wahoa biyagua nde kini kago dugu wahaga ka. Ani bialu heagome Lomo agaliru ti hongoheore halu mini lene hene.
Ai lomo agaliru ti mini lene hongohe ani ha howa tigua kininaga manda karulolebi kininaga manda karulolebi kininaga aga karulalu tininaga mini yaraga holene manda nabi haga hene.
Tinaga gabumane ngoai holene anda bialu anda timbuni ogoniha memba handari tebirani pira kira (320) bibahende íbu ngoai howa wali agali bayale helonaga biabe bulenenaga bi lalu dindi mo heya holenenaga bi lalu bule horo bibahendengi mo ngoai haga hene.
Mali bibahendengi tinaga memba mbirame gabumane biabe bulenebi dindi bibahende ngarubi handaya ho helo dabo helaga biaga hene. Wali agali bibahendeme agali haguane ogoninaga bi hale hai halu mbirale mendealinaga ngago ti dimagoli nahaga hene.
Ai Yudasa ibugua agali kirali Lomo pialu Lomo gabumane kagohondo nenege haba lama bi yalu pudaba lene. Agali mbirago Agoso aguane Yone igini Yubolemusu pialu mendego Eleasa igini Yasonola pudaba lene.
Yudasa ibugua ogonidagua binidagoni irane Girigi kini kagome ibalu Isaraele wali agali bo hilo waholobada lo manda buwa Lomo gabumaneme ibu biamogo bialu ibunaga genda ngago mo wahole ibilonaga manda buwa ani lene.
Yubolemusula Yasonola hariga luore pialu Lomo anda pene. Puwa Lomo gabumane anda heagoria anda puwa libugua gabumane agali biru wiaruhondo lalu,
Yudasa Magabeusu ibu hamenerubi Yuda wali agalibi tigua Lomo tí baba nenege halu ina mini mo mbiraore ho hami̱ya habo nalolene bi lo wule pudaba laya handala ibiriba, lene.
Ani layagola Lomo tigua bi ogoni karulape lalu,
Tígua habo nalolene bi uruni bi gili biaga boronosime wabini mbalape wiagoria gilibu wialu Yarusaleme yu dai bidaba, lene. Bi gilibuwi boronosime wabini ogoni hameigini kiralime habo nalolene bi lo winigonaga manane wini.
Habo nalolene bi lo gilibu winidagoni ogo, Iname mbirale bibahende bayale bulene dege Yuda Lomolanaga dindi ngagohabi iba solowara bedagohabi wiaabo helo hame ledema. Horo mbiru libuha ke̱ nahelo. Ani bialu libu wai nabilo hame ledema.
Hameigini tara kagome Lomo baba wai biyaguabi Lomonaga nenege kago baba wai biyaguabi
nde Yuda ibugua nenegeoreme biagadagua Lomo baba mo mbiraore halu waitigi ogoni baba wai bulebira.
Ani bialu Yuda tigua Lomo baba wai biragohondo tomobi munibi wai bulenealebi iba sibibi uruni ale mbirago mulene nawiore. Iname bi ogonidagua laramago Yuda tigua talialu howa inahondo yolo ngi lolene nawi.
Anidagua dege hameigini tara kagome Yuda bayagua nde Lomo tiguabi Yudala libu hamenelaore haradagua bialu waitigi baba wai bulebira.
Ani bialu Lomo tigua Yuda waitigi kagohondo tomobi munibi wai biaga ngarualebi iba sibibi mbirago Yuda waitigi kago mulene nawi. Ina Lomome bi ogonidagua laramago ke̱ halu mana mende bu aribia naholeberema.
Bi ogonime ina Lomo kemagome Yuda wali agali baba habo nalolene bi lo werema.
Anigo mani howa libugua bi lo mbira howa habo nalolene bi maru latago holeyaguabi maru mo waholeyaguabi karulape dege. Mo iriari bulenego bayale heneneorego bulene wulebira.
Ani bialu ina Lomome beba mbira gili bialu Kini Demidiriasa hearia í̠na Yuda wali agalihondo bialu hariyago mana ko biriya lalu gilibu pelarima. Ina bi ogodagua larima. Inanaga nenegebi ina heba hagabi Yuda kahondo mana ko biriyago aginaga biribe.
Í̠na Yudahondo ko lone beregola tigua ina kemaria ibuwa í̠na biridago bi lalu ina Lomohondo langiyagua iyame wai dindinibi iba solowara bedagoriabi bibiya, lalu bi gilibu pelarima, lene.
Ai kini Demidiriasa ibu hale hayane Nigano halu ibunaga ami agalirubi homai haya layago hale howa ibugua Alagimusubi Bagidesebi Yudia pudaba lene. Libu ayu ogoni halu mende pialu ami agali marubi haru halu pene.
Tigua hariga Giligala tano wiadagua pialu wali agali Abela dindiha dindi emene Mesalodini bu hearu baba wai bule balai anda ogoriani bini. Ani buwa tigua wali agali dewaore bo wahai halu dindi ogoni karulo hene.
Mali handari mbira pira duriani kira (152) layagola mali ogoninaga ege mbira hayagola Yarusaleme baba wai bule puwa balai anda kaware bini.
Ani bialu mani ti heyalu Beria dindi wiagoria pene. Tinaga ami agali daosini dege pira kira (20,000) haru halu ami nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga daosini kira (2,000) haru halu bini.
Yudasa ibu dindi mini Elasa wiagoria hene. Ami agali ibunime dabene daosini tebira (3,000) hene.
Ani howa waitigi dewaore ibiyago hondowa ti gi timbuni hene. Ani howa dewaore balai anda bu hayago wahalu ibida piai hene. Ani piai hayagola ami agali handari halira (800) hangu hene.
Ai Yudasa ibugua handalu hearia ibunaga ami agali ibida piai halu waitigi hapara hayago hondowa ibunaga ami agali biaru lone mo ngoai holene henge nawi ibida piai hayagola ibunaga bu miniha mini naibi ndibulo wahene.
Pigane ibunaga bu miniha duru lalu gi ho henego ai mani howa ami agali maru hadai bu hearuhondo lalu, Ayu iname wai bialu wayali holeberemabe toba ho kogo ai iname wai bimi̱ya, lene.
Ani layagola agali maru hearume ibunaga mini mo beregedalu lalu, Iname wai bibe nahedago ina hameneru heba howa wai bimi̱ya emene hadai bima. Ayu ina emene dege kamagoni, lene.
Ani layagola Yudasahanda ladai bialu lalu, Ani nabuleore. Ina waitigi handalu ibida polene nawi. Inanaga homolene horo ayu ibiyagua nde iname mogo lalu gi holene nawi. Inanaga damene bu karunaga homa haramagola inanaga mini bayale mini lene wiaabo holebira, lene.
Ai Bagidese halu ibunaga ami agali biaru tinaga balai anda helalu Yuda baba wai bule manda manda bialu hene. Ani howa ami agali nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga hearu ti halu kira talebuki halu tidiyu haga haga bini. Ami agali maru ege to̱le̱ puni yuwa baga hearubi danda timu yi hearubi tigua ami agali dewaore mani ibilo ti bamba hene. Ani bialu ami agali wai baya hangu biagaru tigua wai bamba howa hene.
Bagidese ibu gi tigahayagi hene. Waitigi halu kira biago pilipe biguli pu lama wai bule tidi yalu pene. Ani piyagola Yudasanaga ami agali hearu tiguabi pilipe biguli pu lalu wai pora bini.
Ani bialu wai gime minaga minaga biribiha geme dindi kulu lalu ema bilene. Wai egerebahagi howa binigo bialu hebine alendo ni palene.
Ani bialu howa Yudasa ibugua handalu hearia Bagidese halu ibunaga ami agali haguane hearu gi tigahayagi hearia hendene.
Ani heago hondowa Yudasahanda ibunaga ami agali wai gi nahaga pari wayali hearu dabowa haru halu Bagidese halu ibunaga ami haru hagaru heagohayagi wai gialaanda howa balu bo hengedalu maru talima pugu pugu bialu Asadodo hari nene wiagoria talidaga hene.
Waitigi biarume handalu hearia ti aria gi tigahayagi hayago ibira hayago handalu tigua Yudasa halu ibunaga ami agali biaru erembiraha aribia howa wai bima talima pene.
Wai bu alendo halu ami agali mende mendehabi kirabaliha timu dewa hai halu dewa homalu bini.
Yudasa ibunibi homaya handala ibunaga ami agali hearu ibida piai hene.
Mani ibu hamene Yonadana Saimonolame libu hamene tingini mo yalu pene. Mo yalu puwa tinaga aba mamaliru homali wiagoha Modeini tanoha hora halu duguanda howa dugu bialu dara ho hene.
Isaraele wali agali Yudasa duguanda dugu bialu horo dewaore howa tigua lalu,
Darabiore ina Isaraele wali agali mo wialu haru dai biaga agali haguane biago nde aginaga hayada, lalu hene.
Tigua Yudasahanda binigo damene bibahendeore biabe timuni bini ngarubi wai bini ngarubi bibahende te gili bulene dewaoreyagola tigua gilibu wiai nahe.
Yudasa homayagola wali agali Anduane Homogonaga bi mana mo yo handaga hearu Isaraele dindiha lone tagira íbu hene. Ani bialu agali mana ko biaga hearu ti hongo lone miadai buwa hongo ho hene.
Ogoningi tomo gariangi howa tomo nalu holene nawiyagola Isaraele wali agali ti waitigi baba hama pugu pugu bini.
Ani heagola Bagidese ibugua Yuda agali Anduane Homogo gi nahaga hearu dabalu tigua Yuda dindi handaya ho howa haru helo dabo helaga bini.
Agali haguane uruni tigua Yudasa aria hearu baya hangu taya buwa minu yalu Bagidese hearia pugu biyagola Bagidese ibugua agali uruni mo taga halu mo ko haga bialu hene.
Ai Isaraele wali agali mo ibu wini. Agali maru Anduane Homogonaga bi mana latagi halu mbiwia haga henegoria howa hama ibalu ayu ogoni dombeneha Isaraele dindiha genda timbuni ogonibi mbira nawinigo pigane ayu anda ibini.
Ai Yudasa nenego hearu ti mo mogo bu biruwa tigua Yonadanahondo lalu,
Í̠ hamene Yudasa homayagola ainde ayu agali ko Bagidese halu ibu aria karu homelo bo waholene agali hongohe Yudasa ale mbira naheore harimada.
Ani manda buwa ayu iname í̠na í̠ hamene Yudasanaga henge mialu agali haguane ibu hayadagua ha aribia howa í̠na ina wai haru bamba hagane habelo hame ledema, lene.
Ani layagola horo ogoningi Yonadana ibugua ibu hamene Yudasanaga henge ibuni mialu Isaraele wali agalinaga agali haguane hene.
Ai Yonadana Isaraele wali agalinaga haguane ka layago hale howa Bagidesehanda Yonadana bo wahole hariga taya bialu hene.
Anigo ai Yonadanabi ibu hamene Saimonobi ibunaga agali bu hearubi tigua Bagidesehanda ibu bole ka layago hale halu ti ibida pialu dindi ko iba dalu naibaga Tegoa dindi wiagoha puwa iba hambiaga iba uli mini Asaba laga wiagoria anda bu hene.
Sabada horo mbirungi hayagola Bagidese ibu hale hayagola Yonadana halu ibu aria biaru ogoniha ka lene hale halu tigua abaleore iba Yodana domaede halu pene.
Ai Yonadana ibugua ibu hamene mbira mini Yone ami agalinaga biabe biaga hearunaga agali haguane henego ogonihondo lamialu, Yonadana ibu nenege maru Nabadia dindiha karu hondo pudaba. Í̠naga dabudabu ngaruni ti daluha ngeloabe, lalu hale hene.
Ani lama pialu hearia agali maru Yambiri aria Medeba tano howa ibalu tigua Yone garabaya haru halu dabudabu biaru ti mo page yalu pu wahene.
Emene howa Yonadanala ibu hamene Saimonola libu hale halu hebiria Yambiri hameigini bu hearu turu timbuni ho ka layago hale hene. Ayu dege mbirali wali dabu biyagola wali agali dewa Nadabada tano howa wali agalime dabu bilodago haru halu harigani ibira layago hale hene. Wali ogoni Kenanali agali haguane mbira heago wane berenego haru ibini.
Ani layago hale howa libu hamene Yone homayago mitangi bialu libugua abale puwa harigani hari bare wiagoha bira do howa yu berene.
Libugua bira do howa handalu hebiria agali dewaore ngoaiho hearia de hendene. Tigua bi ladagadaga bima dabudabu dewaore yalu ibiyago hendene. Igiri wali dabu bulene biago halu ibu hamenerubi ibu damenerubi ti wali damene harigani ngola hale ibini. Tigua ngida tara tara bi wai biaganealebi dewa yalu ibiyago hendene.
Ai Yonadana halu ibunaga agali biaru ti porabu tagi halu puwa Yambiriali uruni baba wai bini. Agali dewaore homai haya handala maru hari bare wiagoha ibida pora bialu piai hene. Ani biya handala Yudali biaru ti dabudabu wiaru mo yalu pene.
Anidagua biyagola wali dabu bialu turu holene winigo wiaribia halu dara halu dugu bulene wini. Ngidaru balu iba gana bayale lole wiyago mo beregedalu dara howa agali homenenaga kiabu dugu bia aribia hene.
Libugua ogonidagua bialu libu hamenenaga darame pelayago pani libugua tininaga daramama pani bu aribia helene. Ani bialu libuni Yodana ibahayagi iba pugua wiagoha pene.
Libugua ani biya layago Bagidese ibu hale howa ibugua ami agali dewaore haru halu Sabada horoni iba Yodana peago angeni pu hene.
Ani íbu heagola Yonadana ibugua ibunaga ami agali biaruhondo lamialu lalu, Ayu genda yu kemago tara yu kemago ai wai bima, lene.
Ai hale halimu. Ayu ina homarimayaguabi nahome howa iname ti bai harimayaguabi karulape. Ayu waitigi tombehayagi ina halu iba Yodana erembiraha peda. Abene mende mendeha iba pugua ngagome ina polene henge nawida.
Ani bidago manda bialu ai Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ina biamogo bilo ibuhondo bi dege lami̱ya, lene.
Ani lalu wai bialu howa Yonadanahanda Bagidese ayume taula dibaro lo manda biyaria Bagidese ibu igiladai biyagola bako hene.
Ani biya handala Yonadana halu ibunaga agali biaru iba Yodanaha pora bialu howa ange mendeha do̱la ede hai hene. Anigo waitigi biarume iba do̱malu talima nape wahene.
Anidagua bialu horo ogoningi dege Bagidesenaga ami agali daosini mbira (1,000) agima homai hene.
Ani bialu Bagidese ibu Yarusaleme dai buwa Yudia dindiha tano wiaru mo hongo haga bini. Ibugua anda íbu holene Yarigo tanohabi Emaiasa tanohabi Bedehorono tanohabi Bedele tanohabi Timinada tanohabi Piradono tanohabi Tebono tanohabi bu helaga biai hene. Ibugua wai pabe daligaore biai halu wai pabe panga hongohe wabu helowa bengena aeane hongohe wabu helai halu bini.
Ani buwa tano bibahendeni ibunaga ami agali maru Isaraele wali agali genda mo mialu helo helaga bini.
Ibugua tano kira Bedesula Gesela mo hongoho ngelalu Yarusalemeni wai pabeanda heagobi mo hongo halu buwa tano uruniha ibunaga ami agali dewa helalu tinaga dabudabu dewa tano uruniha mo wialu bini.
Ani bialu Yuda agali haguaneru igini hearu minu yalu puwa Yarusalemeha wai pabeanda hongohe biagoha garabaya helaga bini.
Ai mali handari mbira pira duriani tebira (153) layagola mali ogoninaga ege mende heagola Alagimusuhanda agali bu hearuhondo, Wai pabe hongohe halu mende Anduane Homogonaga anda bu mabu bini heago wahalu gialo wahadaba, lene. Ibugua anidagua bialu bamba agali Anduane Homogonaga bi mana latagi haga henerume biabe bini wiaru mo ko holenaga ani bini.
Anigo tigua biabe ogoni bule bialu heagola Alagimusu ibu warago timbuni bo wiagola ibunaga biabe bule bialu heago wahene. Warago wialu ibunaga ne hariga ndibulo wahai halu gi gebi homalu hongo naheore halu homai hene. Ani biyagola ibunaga ne hariga halalu bi mbira labe nahe halu ibu andagaha biabe bulene ngago gi ge ema bialu mbira bibe nahe hene.
Anidagua bialu Alagimusu tandaga timbuni nalu homene.
Ai Bagidese ibu hole halu hearia Alagimusu homaya layago hale halu ibu kini hearia dai biyagola Yuda wali agali ti mali kirani bayale hene.
Ani biyagola agali mana puguaga bu hearume ti mo mogobu howa lalu, Handadaba. Ai Yonadana halu ibunaga wali agali tiha mo ko nahe bayale kagoni ndobe. Ai wali agali uruni mbi mbira hanguni minalu garabaya biai helo Bagidese haru dai bimi̱ya, lene.
Ani lalu tigua Bagidese hondo piyagola
ibugua ami agali dewaore haru halu ibini. Ani ibu howa ibugua Yudiaha ibunaga nenege bu hearuhondo ohowa beba dindiha gilibu wia haga bialu, Tígua agali Yonadana halu ibu damene karu minalu garabaya helalimu, lalu lo pelaga bini. Ani layago Yonadana ibu hale ho bolangua ho heagola tigua minabe nahe hene.
Ani howa Yonadana halu ibu damene hearume agali haguane biabe ko uruni biaga pira duria (50) hearu minalu garabaya buwa homelo bo wahai hene.
