Ani bialu Yonadanabi ibu hamene Saimonobi libu aria bu hearubi bibahende heyalu pialu dindi ko wali agali nahaga tano Bedebasi wiagoha hole pene. Tano ogoni bamba giala holebini winiyago ainde tigua puwa lone mo hongo halu arema buwa mo hongo halu hene.
Ai mbirale libugua bialu ka layago Bagidese ibu hale howa ibunaga ami agali hearu mo ngoai halu Yudia dindiha agali hearu ibidaba lalu bi lene.
Ani bialu mani ibuni dai buwa Bedebasiha wai bule balai anda bini. Ibugua wai biagane masiniru wabu ngelowa wai horo dewaore bialu hene.
Yonadanahanda ibu hamene Saimono wali agali baba tanoha helalu ibuni heba ami agali maru haru halu irabuha pene.
Puwa ibugua Odomera halu ibu damene bu hearu bo haealabaga bialu Pasirono halu ibu aria tinaga anda bu heagoria hemiria puwa bo wahai hene. Ani bialu puwa Yonadana halu ibunaga ami agali biarume Bagidese baba wai bini.
Ogoniangi Saimono halu ibu aria hayaru tigua tano howa tagira puwa wai biagane masini wabu wiaru irame heda hai hene.
Tigua Bagidese baba wai bialu Bagidesenaga ami agali hearu bope howa bo hengeda hai halu bini. Ai Bagidese ibunaga miniha wai hono wiago bibahende mo habo lai halu biabe bule biyago habo lai hayagola ibu manga timbuni ho hene.
Ibugua Yudali agali ko maru ibu ibabe lalu bi yalu ibiyaru baba tandaga timbuni hene. Ani howa Yuda agali ko uruni maru homelo bo wahai halu mani ibuni dalu dai bulene hamelo hene.
Ai Bagidese ibu ibuni dalu dai bule ka layago hale howa Yonadanahanda agali maru Bagidese karia puwa lalu, Yuda agali garabaya helariru bibahende golope halu gi tigani bialu wai palima lama pudaba, lene.
Bagidese ibugua bi ogoni hale howa ibuguabi Yonadanahanda bi layadagua dege bima lene. Ibugua bi hongohe gi dolowa lalu, I̱na Yonadana mo ko hole mbira nabi haabo halu homalu wahole, lalu bi lo wini.
Ani lalu ibugua garabaya agali Yudiaha howa haru peneru golope halu piai hadaba lene. Ani lalu ibuni dalu pu wahalu dai nabi wahene.
Anidagua binidagome wai timbuni Isaraele dindi biaga wiaru biba helene. Ai Yonadana ibu Migimasa tano wiagoria pu hene. Ani howa ibugua wali agali bibahende handame howa haru hai halu wali agali Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mana puguaga hearu bibahende bo wahai haga bini.
Mali handari mbira pira waragaria (160) layagola Kini Andiogusu igini Alegesanda Ebipanesehanda Tolemese tano ibalu tano ibu karulo hene. Wali agali ogoniha hearume ibu ibiyago mo turu hayagola ibugua tanoha gabumane biabe bulene wiago handaya ho hai hene.
Ai Kini Demidiriasa ibugua mbirale biyadagonaga te layago hale howa ibugua Alegesandala wai bule ami agali dewaore ho manda bu hene.
Ani manda bu howa Demidiriasa ibugua Yonadana mo gede holenaga bi bayaleru gilibu pelole manda bini.
Ibunaga miniha hangu mitangi bialu, Yudasa ibu Alegesandala gi tigani lalu ibula ala nenege howa libu mo gimbu bialu i̱ boligo i̱na Yudasala ala nenege halu gi tigani loliya, lo manda bini.
Ainde mana ko iname Yonadana halu ibu hamenerubi ibu dameneruhondobi birimago manda bu holebira, lo manda bini.
Ani manda buwa ainde harugo lowa Demidiriasahanda Yonadanahondo lawia halu ibugua lalu, Ami agali manda manda bu halu danda timubi wai pole yaga damene manda manda bu yu habe, lowa lalu, Yonadana iyaore mandagi haabo habiya, lalu lo pelene. Ani bialu Yuda agali maru Yarusaleme wai pabeanda hongohe biagoha garabaya hayaru golope halu Yonadana karia daibia lalimu lalu lo wia hene.
Yonadana ibugua beba ogoni yalu Yarusaleme ibuwa wali agali bu hearu denibi ami agali Yarusalemeha wai pabeanda hongohe heagoha mamage haga hearunaga denibi dagala tagi hene.
Ai kini ibugua Yonadana hongo mialu ami agali tidi mbira haru habe layayago hale howa ti mogolo hendene.
Agali wai pabeanda hongohe handaya ho haga biaru tigua bi uruni hale howa garabaya agali anda ogoniha helene biaru golope halu Yonadana hearia dai bidaba layagola ti aba ai̱ya hearia andaga piai hene.
Ani bialu Yonadana ibu Yarusalemeni howa tano mo ko ho wiaru arema bialu mo tiga bialu hene.
Ibugua agali biabe biaga hearuhondo lamialu, Ege to̱le̱ bayale tigabi ngaru mo yuwa tanonaga wai pabe baya hangu biatiga bialu Saiono nene ngago ege pabe hongohe bu mabu bulene nga, lalu lamini. Ani layagola tigua bilimu layadagua biai hene.
Ani biya handala agali maru dindi tara howa ibini Yarusalemeha wai pabeanda hongohe Bagidesehanda bu helene biagoha heneru ibida piai hene.
Ti bibahende Yarusaleme wahalu tini dalu pugu pugu bini.
Agali maru bi mana lo wini ngaru mo wahaga heneru ti Bedesu tanoha haabo hene. Tinaga hado anda tano ogoni wini.
Ai Kini Alegesanda ibu Demidiriasahanda Yonadanahondo ogoale bibiya lalu bi gili bu wia hayayago hale hene. Ani bialu Yonadana halu ibu hamenerume wai timbuni bialu henegobi biabe timbuni tigua bini wiarubi genda tara tara tigua yu henegobi bibahendenaga te ogoale bira lalu marume lo yalu ibiyago hale ho hene.
Ani hale ho howa ibuni hangu lo manda bialu lalu, Agali hongohe Yonadana ale mende nahe. Ibu inanaga nenegeore howa ina heba holene karulapeda, lene.
Ani manda buwa ibugua beba Yonadana hearia gilibu pelalu howa lalu,
Kini Alegesandahanda ibu hamene Yonadana bayale kebe lara.
Iname hale harimago í̠ agali wai biaga hongohe pari wayaliore ke layago. Ainde inanaga nenege hami̱ya hamelo kema.
Ani howa ayu í̠ í̠naga wali agalinaga Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali habelo dabo helarama. Ani bialu í̠naga mini Kininaga Nenege larama. Í̠na baba mandagi haga inanaga nenegeore habe, lene. Ani lalu Kini Alegesanda ibugua kininaga aga daramabi mbira kininaga manda ngolome wabini mbirala Yonadana karulelo mo yalu poa helo mo wia hene.
Ai Horo timbuni Anda Nemandaruha Palu Holene Horo ege kaneni Yonadana ibugua Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguanenaga aga karulagane ale mo karulene.
Ai Yonadana ibu Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane ka layago Kini Demidiriasa ibu hale howa ibunaga miniha tandaga timbuni howa ibugua lalu,
Alegesanda ibu ala nenege helo harimadago agidabe. Ibu ala puwa Yuda baba nenege halu mandagi hayada.
Ai inabi nde bi dendebiore lo pelalu ibula nenege halu ibuha ina biamogo bulene maru yamuliya. Ani bialu ti mo turu halu mbirale bayale duniniore ngago mo wia holiya, lene.
Ani lowa ibugua bi ogodagua gilibu wia hene. Kini Demidiriasa ibugua Yudia dindiha wali agali kemiruhondo horombe lalu bayale kemibe, lalu bi lo wia hara.
Ainde tígua ina baba bi pongo wirimago mo habo nale baya hangu yu haabo halubi ina baba nenego haabo halubi inanaga waitigi karu baba mandagi howa nenege nahebi kemigonaga ina turu ho kema.
Tígua ina baba nenege bayale haabo harimiyagua nde iname tíhondo bayale bulene ngago bialu haabo holeberema.
Iname tínaga dagisi ngiaga wirimigo mo wahalu tí mo turu halu mbirale bayale ngaru bame nguleberema.
Ayu ina Yuda tíhondo bi ogodagua laro. Ai tí dagisi maru wiaga wiyago ibi yolonaga dagisibi kininaga dagisi miaga wiyagobi mo wahai haro.
Tígua widi linibi ira lini nagane dedarubi halu tebonego ina ngiaga wirimigo ai ayu howa mani lone nangilimu. Ayu ogoni howa maniorebi ina Yudiaha howabi dindi tebira Samarianaga winibi Galilinaga winibi Yudiaha bo tago hene ngagoha howa dagisi ngi nalole ayu waharogoni.
Ina Yarusaleme ngagobi dindi emene maru kaware ngarubi bibahende loma biahe wiabagi hene nga lalu uruniha howa dagisi tara tara mulene nawiore lalu latagiho ngelaro.
Ai Yarusalemeha wai pabeanda hongohe hayago ina handaya ho haga wirugo yupe halu agali Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni kago ibu giha ya harogo. Ibunime ami agali maru dabalu anda ogoni mamage helo dabalu helolebira.
I̱naga dindi ngogoha Yudanaga ami agali garabaya kago bibahende ayu ogoningi dege golope halu pudaba lolebero. Tígua yolobia dai bilimulo ndo bame golope holebero. Ani bialu agali uruninaga nogo bulumaga sibi hinu kagonagabi dabudabu tara tara ngagonagabi dagisi ngi nalolebero.
Ai Sabada horobi ege gahenge ngabulo kagonaga horo timbuni lotu laga ngago tagira ibirangibi horo lotu lagane timbuni maru ngago tagira ibirangibi wali agali tara tara karume Yuda wali agalihondo dagisi ngi nalole. Ani bialu horo timbuni lotu laga uruni mani ibilo horo tebirani dagisi nabi halu hai howa horo tebira degeni dagisi mulene nawiore, laro.
Horo ogoningi mendealime í̠ kegoha ya lo hale holenebi tíha mo genda holenebi nawiore laro.
Yuda ami agali daosini pira tebira (30,000) kininaga ami agali baba hatago holene nga. Ani bialu tinaga yolo kininaga ami karu miradagua dege mulebira.
Maru ti kininaga pabe anda hongohe ngagoha halu marume gabumane biabe bulebira. Ani howa tinaga mamali mana bialu haga winidago abale kini ibuni bialu helo layadagua bialu holebira.
Dindi hobane tebira Samaria dindinaga winigo Yudia dindihayagi yamialu mo tago hayago Yudia dindiha wiaabo helo. Ani bialu bibahende gabumane mbiraore hangume handa gimbu buwa Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni kagonaga giha habelo.
Ani bialu muni maru Tolemese tanoha howa mo wigi bini ngogo tigua Yarusalemeni anda loma bia hene kagoha biabe bulene ngaru bilimulo ti mo turu halu bame ngulebero.
Ani bialu kininaga muni andaha muni ngago aria siliba muni daosini nguira (15,000) biabe tara bulene ngaru bilimulo ngulebero.
Mali maru piyagoha muni maru gabumaneme anda loma bia hene Yarusaleme hayaha biabe bulenego mope howa bame ngelo hayago ogonibi ayu yupe halu tini mo ngulebero. Ai ayu ogoni howa maninaga tinaga yolo tigabi mialu holeberemi.
Ani bialu lotu biabenaga dagisi siliba muni daosini duria (5,000) miruligo waharogoni. Muni ogoni ibu agali loma binigo mo miaga Anduane Homogonaga andaha biabe biaga karu yolo bilo ngelo waharogoni.
Agali mbira dindi i̱na handaya ho howa haru kogoha karu aria mbirame kinila dano ho howayagua maru baba dano ho howayaguabi ibu dano hangabe nahedagola ohalu puwa Anduane Homogonaga andaha ha do heyagua nde agali ogoni ibu garabaya napolebira. Ani bialu ibunaga mbirale ngago mo yulenebi nawi.
Ai anda biago kagonaga wai pabe biatiga bulenebi anda biatiga bulenebi uruni bulenenaga muni kini ibuniha howa ibulebira.
Ani bialu agali maru Yarusaleme wai pabe bu mabu biragonaga yolobi Yudia dindiha tano pabe biragonaga yolobi kini ibunime bulebira, lalu Kini Demidiriasahanda lene.
Ai Yonadana halu ibunaga wali agali hearume Kini Demidiriasahanda bi layago mo henene nahe hene. Irane ala Kini Demidiriasa ibugua tihondo mana ko bini dewa wialu genda timbuniore tiha mo ya hene wiagome nakarulape wini.
Ai tigua Kini Alegesandala dege habo nalolene bi lo wiyago yu howa gi tigani layago manda bu holene manda bini. Ani bialu habo nalolene bi ogoni pugua nabi haabo halu homalu wahabiya layago manda bu hene.
Ai Kini Alegesanda ibugua ami agali dewaore haru halu puwa Kini Demidiriasa deni balai anda bini.
Kini kirali biago wai bule ngola ho hebigola Demidiriasanaga ami agali hearu ibida piai hene. Ani biyagola Kini Alegesanda ibugua talima pugu pugu bialu bo wahai halu wayali hene.
Ani bialu wai hongo howa bialu bu alendo halu Kini Demidiriasabi waiha homalu bini.
Mani howa Alegesanda ibugua Iyibi Kini Tolemi hearia bi lama pudaba lowa lawia halu lalu,
Ai i̱ninaga dindini daibu howa ayu i̱ mamalirunaga kini biragane dagia ngagoria bedo. I̱naga gabumane biabe mo tiga biai howa ayu dindi bibahende handameho ko.
Ayu dege i̱na Demidiriasanaga hongo bo podalu ibunaga dindibi i̱na dege handame ho kogoni.
Ayu í̠la habo nalolene bi lo wibiya hame ledo. Í̠ wane i̱ daubuliya í̠na karulape labelo hame ledo. Ani beregola i̱na wariabu libu harume tabaga nahalibulo karulapeore bulebero, lalu lo pelene.
Kini Tolemi ibugua ladai bialu lalu, Ainde í̠ lone dai bialu í̠naga mamalirunaga dagia wiagoria í̠ni kini ti henegoria haaribia halu í̠ni birariyangi ina wali agali bibahendeme turu timbuni harima.
Í̠na bi lariyago i̱na hale howa i̱ wane bedago í̠ dau bibelo karulape laro. Anigo ainde i̱na í̠ baya hangu hondo manda bialu í̠nabi nde i̱ baya hangu hondo manda bibelo Tolemese tanoni ngola habiya, lene.
Ani lalu Kini Tolemi halu ibu wane Keleobadarabi Iyibi wahalu Tolemese tano ibini.
Ani ibiyagola Kini Alegesanda ibu ibalu ti Tolemeseni ngola howa Kini Tolemihanda ibu wane Keleobadara Alegesanda dabu bilo mini. Ani miyagola libu Tolemese tanoni yári baya tara tara kinime hamelaga wiaru karulowa ogoriani mo dabubia hene.
Alegesanda ibugua beba mbira gilibu wia halu Yonadana ibu ngola hole ibabe lalu lawia hene.
Ani layago hale halu Yonadana ibu yári bayaleru mo karulalu kini kirali biago labo Tolemese tanoni berebiria ngola hole pene. Puwa ibugua libu mo turu halu siliba ngolobi dewaore mini. Ani bialu libunaga ami agali haguane hearubi mo turu halu mbirale mia dege bini. Ani biyagola wali agali bu hearume Yonadana mo turu halu bi laga bini.
Anigo horo ogoningi dege Isaraele agali ko maru heneyago tigua Yonadana mo ko holenaga bi marubi lalu hene. Ani layago Kini Alegesanda ibu hale nahene.
Kini ibugua lalu, Kininaga aga daramabi ngago Yonadana ibu karulelo mini.
Ani bialu kini ibugua Yonadana ibunaga gi tigahayagi berelalu buwa ibunaga agali haguane bu hearuhondo lamialu lalu, Yonadana haru halu tano hanuni pupe hole pudaba. Ani bialu tígua wali agali bu karu lamialu tí Yonadanahanda ko biya lalu ke̱ howa bi mbira laremigo hale naholeore. Ani bialu mbiralime ibu mo genda naholeore, lene.
Ai agali marume ke̱ howa Yonadana ko biya lalu bi bame laede haga hearu tigua handalu hemiria kinime Yonadananaga mini mo yaraga hayayago de hondowabi kininaga aga daramabi wiago mo karula heago hondowabi ti gi halu ibida pene.
Anigo kini ibugua Yonadana mini timbuni mini lene helene. Ani bialu ibu mini Kininaga Nenege helalu ami agali haru haga agali haguane dabo helalu ibu daluha agali haguane ho bamba hene helo dabo helene.
Turu holene timbuni Yonadanaha to̱latagi halu ibu hendore mo palia holene karulo biralu nde Yarusaleme dai bini.
Mali handari mbira pira waragariani duria (165) hayagola Kini Demidiriasa mende ibu Demidiriasa mbira igini henego ibugua Kiridi dindi iba dege dombeneha wiago wahalu dai buwa ibuni dalu bamba ibu mamaliru berene wiagoria hole pene.
Ai Kini Alegesanda ibu Demidiriasa lone daibu ka layago hale howa ibunaga miniha genda timbuni halu ibu Siria dindinaga tano dunini Andiogo dai bini.
Demidiriasa ibugua Aboloniusu heago gabumane haru haga haguane Koelesiria wiagoria helo dabo helene. Ani heleagola ai Aboloniusu ibugua ami agali mo hongo ho helowa haru halu puwa Yabane tano kawareni balai anda bu hene. Ani buwa ibugua Yonadana hearia bi lowia halu lalu,
Í̠ hangume i̱la wai bialu howa wali agali bu karunaga deni í̠na i̱ lo guralu kego aginaga bialu kebe.
Ainde í̠naga ami agali kago para howa uruniha hongo hanaho howa lariyagua nde hari bareha kego wahalu dindi tigabi ngagoria howa hongo manda bialu wai bibiya daliape halu ibabe. Anigo manda ala bia handa. Tanoha ami agali hayadaru ti i̱ baba hatagoho kema ndobe.
Ai í̠na i̱ ai henedabe handalu i̱ heba ai dege henedabe hondole hondo habe. Í̠na i̱la bulene hongo nakarulapeore kegoni ndobe. Bamba í̠ aba mamaru tigua i̱la hongo manda bialu hearia nakarulapeoreya handala halu kira libu dindinaga wai hongo howa bia nabi ibida piyago í̠ manda bide.
Í̠na i̱ aguaore bope holene manda bidebe. I̱naga ami agali í̠na bamibe nahe gibiore maru nogo hosini biruwa wai bulenebi ami agali damenebi dewaore haru kogo ainde dindi tigabi ngagoria wai bibiya tagira ibalu keria í̠ erembira mulene ege to̱le̱ hibaria mbira nawulebira ndobe. Ani bialu í̠ ibida polene diri mbira nawioreni porabupe holebere, lene.
Aboloniusu ibugua bi ogoni layayago Yonadana hale howa ibu keba timbuni hene. Ani howa ibugua ami agali pari wayaliru daosini pira (10,000) haru halu Yarusaleme wahalu tagira pene. Ani biyagola ibu hamene Saimono ibuguabi ami agali haru halu íbu dege bini. Pialu agali halu kira piyago bibahende Yoba tano wiago be tagiraha balai anda bini.
Ani bialu heagola wali agali tanoha hearume tanoha pabe panga payatagi hene. Anidagua binidagoni irane Aboloniusunaga ami agali maru tanoha heagola bini.
Ani biyago bilowa Yonadana ibugua wai Yoba tanoha giala anda halu wai bini. Ani biyagola agali tanoha hearu tigua gi howa tanoha panga dugupe hayagola tano ogoni Yonadana ibu mo wini.
Aboloniusu ibu hale hayaria Yoba tano Yonadana ibu mo wiya layago hale howa ibunaga ami agali nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga daosini tebirabi (3,000) ami agali dewaorebi heba tidi yalu ohowa Asadodo ibida pole petingi halu pene. Ibunaga ami agali nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga hearume wai bilonaga dindi tigabi bayale wiagoria henge ngelonaga ibu emene dogolo mialu amura pene.
Yonadana ibugua Asadodo talima pialu ogoriani howa wai bini.
Anigo Aboloniusu ibunaga ami agali daosini mbira (1,000) nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga Yonadana erembiraha yagi wai tibini waraanda ho bereleago Yonadana nahende wai dombeni pora bini.
Mani howa Aboloniusunaga wai hanalu birayayago Yonadanahanda handa walia hene. Tigua Yonadananaga ami agali wara dombe bia howa timu tombe mbiraha doba bayago ti heagoria ibai hene. Wai egerebahagi howa binigo bialu alendo hene.
Anigo Yonadananaga ami agali biarume ibunaga bi hale halu hongo ho hai hene. Ani heagola waitiginaga nogo hosi biaru manga hai halu tinaga hongo pirilope hai hene.
Ani biyagola Saimono halu ibunaga ami agali biaru anda ibini. Ibalu wai abale pora buwa Aboloniusunaga ami biaru ba dege bialu bo hengeda hai hene. Ani biyagola waitigi biaru ibida pugu bialu piai hene.
Agali nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga biaru wai hama wiagoria pu luluya hama ibaga bialu hene. Ani bialu ti ibida pialu Asadodo tanoha mbirale dama mitangi bialu bi pupu wiaga gime wabini mini Dagononaga anda timbuni heagoha birado hai hene.
Ani biyagola Yonadanahanda Asadodo tano bibahende bo heda hai halu tano emene maru wiarubi heba bo heda hai hene. Ani bialu tano dabudabu tara tara wiaru mo yai halu bini. Ani bialu Dagononaga anda timbuni heago bo heda halu ami agali wai ibida pialu anda ogoniha birado hayago heba bo heda anda halu bini.
Waitigi waiha howa ayu tibume dibini homayagobi andaha waranda howa hedaanda hene homayagobi bibahende daosini halira (8,000) homene.
Mani Yonadana ibugua Asadodo tano wahalu puwa Asagelono tanoni balai anda bini. Agali tanoha haga hearu ibu ngola hole harigani tagira ibini. Ani ibuwa tigua ibunaga mini mo yaraga hai hene.
Ani bialu mani Yonadana halu ibunaga ami agali biaru tigua tinaga waitigi bo wahayarunaga mbirale bayale wiaru mo hilo yalu Yarusaleme dai bini.
Yonadanahanda wai hongohe biya layago Kini Alegesanda ibu hale howa ibugua Yonadananaga mini yaraga hene.
Ani bialu ibugua manda ngolome wabini mbira Yonadananaga wia hene. Yari ogoniale kini ibuni damene darama mbiraore kago miaga winigo Yonadana mini. Ani bialu Egerono tanobi dindi emene ogoniha wiarubi bibahende Yonadana ibuninaga tanoore ogoni wilo kini ibugua Yonadana mini.
Uruni bialu henedangi Iyibinaga Kini Tolemi waragane ibugua ami agali dewaore mo mogo bialu hene. Ibunaga ami agali daga labe nahe iba angeni iba mu ngadagua hene. Ani bialu ibunaga iba sibi dewabi wini. Ibugua Alegesanda mohondo howa Alegesandanaga dindi wiaru ibu bo yamialu ibunaga dindi dege wiagimbu bu ngelo ani.
Ani howa ibugua Siria dindi pialu agali ogoniha hearu baya hanguore bime ladebodebo bini. Ani biyagola wali agali tanoha hearume wai pabe panga payago dugua halu tini tagira puwa Kini Tolemi ngola hole pene. Abale howa Kini Alegesanda ibugua ibunaga wali agalihondo lamialu Kini Tolemi ogoni ibu imane kago ibiragola ibiribe lalu mo bila halimu, lalu lamini.
Anigo ainde tano mbira mbira pugu pugu bialu ibunaga ami agali maru helaga bini.
Ani bialu tigua Asadodo tano wiagoria tagira puwa tigua dama mitangi bialu bi pupu wiaga mini Dagononaga anda timbuni henego bo heda hene wiago Tolemi mo walia hene. Asadodobi tano emene emene wiarubi bo heda hai hene labu wiago de hendene. Wai bialu agali bo wahai henedaru dewaore wiago dengui hendene. Ani bialu agali maru Yonadanahanda anda heba heda anda hene biarunaga tingini Tolemi ibu polene harigani daga labe nahe wiaria hendene.
Wali agali bu hearu tigua mbirale uruni Yonadanahanda bini lalu lamini. Ani layago hale howa kini ibugua bi mbira ladai nabi dege hene.
Yonadana ibugua kini ibiyagola Yoba tano wiagoria ngola hole puwa turu halu ibiridago bayuwa birida lama pene. Libu gi tigani bialu turu haga bu howa libu haru tano ogoniha palene.
Ani bialu Kini ibu Yonadana libu haru pialu iba Eluderusu peagoria tagira pene. Ogoriani ngua halu Yonadana ibu Yarusaleme dai bini.
Anidagua bialu Kini Tolemihanda iba solowara angeange tano timbuni dunini wuyu pearu ibugua handame hai halu Selusia tano wiagoria handa tagi hene. Ibugua Alegesanda mohondo howa anidagua bini.
Ani buwa Kini Tolemi ogoni ibugua Kini Demidiriasa hearia bi lo pelalu howa lalu, Habo nalolene bi mbira lo wibiya. I̱ wane Alegesanda ibu dabu biyago wahalu haru dai berogola í̠ dabu bibelo. Ani bialu dindi í̠ abanaga winigo í̠nime handaya ho hai habelo.
Ainde Alegesanda ibugua í̠ bo wahole manda bialu hearia nde i̱ wane hono mirugo daraba.
Ibugua bi gendabi ogoni lenedago inane Alegesandanaga dindi baya wiago dimagoli ho howa anidagua lene.
Kini Tolemihanda ibu wane Alegesanda miyago lone haru dai bialu Kini Demidiriasa daubilo mini. Ibugua ogonidagua bialu habo nalolene bi lo wiribidago puguini. Ani bialu wali agali bibahende deni libu harume waitigi haga haga bini.
Mani howa Kini Tolemi ibu Andiogo tano ngagoria pialu ibu Sirianaga kini hene. Anidagua bialu ibu dindi kira Iyibi kini halu Siria kini halu bini.
Ogoningi Kini Alegesanda ibu Silisia wali agalime gabumanenaga bi mo wahayaya handala ibu ogoniha hama pene.
Ani howa Alegesanda ibugua mbirale Tolemihanda ogoni biya layago hale halu ibu Tolemila wai bule pene. Ani pialu hearia Tolemi ibu ami agali dewaore daga lamibe nahe haru halu harigani ibalu Kini Alegesanda ngola hayagola Kini Alegesanda halu ibunaga ami agali ibida piai hene.
Ani piai hayagola Kini Alegesanda ibida pialu Arebia dindi ha do heagola ayu Kini Toleminaga mini daliga mini lene timbuni hene.
Ani pu hado hearia agali mbira Arebiaali mini Sabadiele henegome Kini Alegesanda balu ibu haguane Kini Tolemi hearia pugu yalu pu lalu mini.
Anigo horo tebiru hangu howa nde Kini Tolemi ibunibi homa dege bini. Ani homayagola wali agali dindi anduane tano bibahendeha bu hearume Toleminaga ami agali wai pabeanda hongohe haru bibahende bo wahai hene.
Anidagua biyagola mani mali handari mbira pira waragariani karia (167) hayagola nde Demidiriasa mende ibu kini pigane hene.
Ogoningi Yonadanahanda Yudia dindiha agali bu hearu mo ngoai hai howa wai biaga masini hongoheru Yarusaleme tanoha wai pabe hongohe hearu bo gialanda holenaga wabialu hene.
Ani bialu heagola Yuda agali ko maru Yuda tini aria turu nahaga hearume kini hearia puwa lalu, Yonadanahanda Yarusaleme wai pabeanda hongohe biago ho hagira bida, lene.
Kini Demidiriasa ibu bi ogoni layago hale howa keba timbuni halu abale heyalu Tolemese tano pole pene. Puwa ibugua beba mbira gili buwa Yonadana hearia pelalu howa lalu, Wai bialu harugoni wahalu bi midini mbira lami̱ya abale ibabe, lalu gilibu wia hene.
Yonadana ibugua beba ogoni dagalo handa hondowa dege wai wanahe bialu haabo hene. Ani bialu howa dege ai agali haguane marubi Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga marubi ti haru kini hondo pole dabene. Ibuha ko mbira anda ibulubadago gi naheore hene.
Ibugua ngolobi silibabi agabi dewaore bame talebu migi bulenaga yalu Tolemese tano pene. Anda piyago hondowa kini ibu turuore timbuni ho hene.
Yonadana ibuni aria hearu marume ibuhondo keba howa Yonadanahanda ko biya lowa bi laga laga bialu hemiria
kini ibugua Yonadanahondo mana bayale kini ale henerume biagadagua dege bini. Ani bialu ibuni damene bu hearu deni howa kini ibugua Yonadana mini yaraga hene.
Kini ibugua Yonadana ibu Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni helo mo hongo halu mini lene timbuni helo mo yaraga halu ibu mini Kininaga Nenege ho bamba hene ka, lalu bini.
Ani bialu Yonadana ibugua kinihondo hale halu, Ibugua muni siliba daosini dege genda magi kilogarama pira (10,000) nguliya í̠na dagisi muni Yudia dindihabi dindi tebira Samariaha howa bo yu anda ibini biaruhabi nami wahabelo hameledo, lalu kini hale hene.
Ai kini ibugua bi Yonadanahanda ibuhondo hale hayago e̱ lalu ibugua Yonadananaga beba gilibu wia halu ladai bini. Ibugua bi lenedago ogo,
Kini Demidiriasahanda ibu hameneore Yonadana halu Yuda wali agaliru bayale kemida lara.
Iname beba mbira gili bialu í̠naga te gili buwa ina hanini Lasenesenaga wia harima. Beba ogoniha bi ogodagua gili birima.
Kini Demidiriasahanda ibu hanini Lasenesehondo lalu, Bayale kebe.
Iname Yudia wali agalihondo mana bayale bimi̱ya lalu bi lo wirimagoni tiore inanaga nenege howa tigua ina baba habo nalolene bi pongo winigo hongo howa yu ka.
Tigua Yudiaha dindi dewa bu ngarubi dindi tebira Eberaimibi Lidabi Arimadia ngagobi tigua handaya ho helo karulape larima. Dindi uruni iname Samaria dindiha howa mo bagi halu Yudiaha wiatago helarima. Wali agali Yarusalemeha lotu lole poragobi biamogo bimi̱ya larima. Ani bialu mabuha tomo hengedagonaga dagisibi ira lini dedarunaga dagisibi kinihondo mani lone namule larima. Muni uruni wahalu tini yu howa Anduane Homogonaga anda kagoha biabe bulene ngago bule ti yu helo larima.
Ani bialu dagisi maru tigua ngiaga wini mbirale bibahendenaga pinibi ibinaga dagisibi kini ibuninaga dagisibi uruni bibahende waharima.
Bi beba uruniha gilibu ngaruni mbirago maniorebi mbiralime mo iriari nabulebiraore.
Iname ani ledemagoha bi mbiraore helo í̠nabi beba mbira tigua dagalalu hari nene loma bia hene ngagoria handalu mo ngelelo gili bialu pelabe, lalu lo pelene.
Dindi Kini Demidiriasa ibugua handaya ho howa haru hene wiago bibahendeha wali agali tini mabuha ira lini daga hearu andaneha mbirale mbira gi nahe hadapaya bu hearia hendene. Ani bialu ibula waitigi mbira naheore hene. Ani howa ibunaga ami agali bialu biabe wahalu tini andaga dai biai helene. Anigo ami agali iba dege dombeneha howa ibini hearu dege ibuni heba hole helene. Anigo ami agali maru ala ibu aba heba biabe bialu lu hene bu hearu tigua dege tinaga biabe nawiyagola tinaga miniha Kini Demidiriasa baba genda yu hai hene.
Ogonigo agali mbira mini Tiribo hene. Bamba ibu Alegesanda baba mandagi hagaore mbira henego ibu hondo hearia Demidiriasanaga ami agali bu hearume keba hai ho heago hendene. Ani handalu Tiribo ibu Arebia dindiha agali mbira mini Imalague ibu Alegesanda igini Andiogusu henego ogoni handaya ho haga henego ogoni hearia pene.
Tiribo ibugua Imalaguehondo hongo howa hale halu lalu, Andiogusu ibu haru dai buwa ibu aba Alegesandanaga henge mialu kini haaribia helo haru poliya i̱naga giha yaha, lene. Ani bialu Tiribo ibugua te maru Demidiriasanaga mana ogobi nga lalubi ibunaga ami agali hearume ibuhondo turu naheore hearubi lamiai hene.
Ai Yonadanahanda Demidiriasa hearia bi lo pelalu, Kininaga ami agali Yarusaleme wai pabeanda hongohe ngagoha karu haru tagira pialu Yudiaha wai pabeanda hongohe maru ngaru ami agali bu karu bibahende hai tagira piai habe. Agali uruni tigua Isaraele wali agali bu kagoha wai bule duru bialu haabo kago ani bibe, lalu lo pelene.
Ani layayago hale howa Kini Demidiriasa ibugua Yonadanahondo ladai bialu lalu, Mbirale í̠na hale haridaruni i̱na karulape laro. Ani bialu i̱na í̠naga mini yaraga holebi í̠naga dindininaga mini yaraga holebi harigabi taya bialu ko.
Anidagua buliya ainde i̱naga ami agali hearume i̱naga bi mo wahalu piai hayago ainde í̠naga ami agali i̱ biamogo bule ibulene karulapeda, lalu lo pelene.
Ani layayago hale halu Yonadana ibugua ami agali pari wayali wai hongohe biaga hearu daosini tebira (3,000) bibahende Andiogo tano pelene. Yudia howa ami agali biaru Andiogo tano anda piyagola Kini Andiogusu ibu turu timbuni hene.
Ayu dege wali agali dindi ogoniha howa daosini dege handari mbirani pira kira (120,000) íbu ngoai howa kini bo wahole bialu hearia ibiyagola kini ibu turu hene.
Ai kini ibu ibida ibuni andaga piyagola wali agali tano ogoni bi hearume hariga wiadagua tini gungu bima pugu pugu bini.
Ani bialu hearia Yudia ami agali biaru olayagola tigua ibalu kini biamogo bini. Ani bialu tigua tanoha hariga pearu bibahendeha piai halu wali agali bai halu horo ogoningi daosini handari mbira (100,000) bibahende bo wahai hene.
Tigua kini baya hangu handaya ho ha howa tano ba heda hai halu dindi anda bibahende bo heda hai halu mo labu hai halu dabudabu bayale wiaru ti mo yai hene.
Ai Yudia ami agali biarume tano timbuni wiago ti handaya ho heagola ti mogolo hendene. Ani hondowa tigua kinihondo wai wahalu ti daraha lalu hale hene. Tigua ibuhondo lalu,
Í̠naga miniha keba ho kegoni wahalu Yudia ami agali bu karume ina baba wai nabi mo palia halu gi tigani ladaba, labe, lene.
Ani lalu agali wai biaga tanoha hayadaru tinaga mbirale wai biaga wiyadaru wahai halu wai palene. Ani bialu kininaga denibi ibunaga wali agalinaga denibi Yudia ami agali biaru ti mini yaraga hene timbuni mbira hene. Ani bialu Yudia ami ti waiha howa dabudabu bayale tara tara mo yayaru yalu tini dalu dai bini.
Ai Kini Demidiriasa ibugua ibunaga dindi baya hangu handaya ho heagola ibunaga wali agali emene tigi mbirani hangu bayale hene.
Anigo mani howa kini ibugua habo nalolene bi lo wiyago mo habo lene. Ani bialu ibugua Yonadanala mandagi nahe wahalu Yonadanahanda ibuhondo bayale bialu hayarunaga yolo mbirale mbira nami wahalu ibugua Yonadana mo genda halu hene.
Mani mbirungi Tiribohanda igiri emene Andiogusu haru dai buwa ibugua kininaga manda mo karula hene.
Ami agali maru Demidiriasa ibugua biabe wahalu tini andaga pudaba layaru ayu ti pialu Andiogusunaga ami anda piai hene. Ani puwa tigua Demidiriasa baba wai biyagola Kini Demidiriasa ibu ibida pora bialu pene.
Ani piyagola Tiribo ibugua nogo elebana dewaore haru howa Andiogo tanoha agali haguane howa handaya ho hene.
Ai igiri emene Kini Andiogusuhanda beba mbira gili bialu Yonadana hearia pelene. Ibugua lalu, Í̠ Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni habelo karulape lalu i̱naga dindi hobane maria ngago í̠na handaya ho habelo yupe halu i̱na í̠ mini Kininaga Nenege lalu laro, lene.
Ani lowa ibugua beledi be ngolome wabini wiaru mo wia halu ibugua lalu, Yonadana í̠na kininaga aga daramabi ngago karulalu ngolome wabini mandibu kini ibuni aria darama mbiraoreme karulaga ngago mo karulalu bibe, lene.
Ani bialu Yonadana hamene Saimono ibu gabumane agali haguane dabo helalu ibugua tano maru iba solowara bedago angeange wuyu pedaru Ponisia howa pialu Iyibi dindila tubari ngagoria handatagi helo dabo helene.
Ai Yonadana ibu dindi maru iba Yuberedisi doma ederahayagi wiaruha pole ibunaga ami agali hearu haru halu puwa dindi uruniha tano wiaruha anda pu haga bima pene. Ani piyagola Siria ami agali hearume ibu heba mini mbiraore halu ti heba mandagi haga bini. Ani bialu ibu Asagelono tano wiagoria anda piyagola wali agali tanoha hearume ibu ibiyagola turu howa ngola hole tagira ibai hene.
Anigo ai ibu Gasa tanoha anda piyagola wali agali tanoha hearume tano pabe panga payatagi hene. Ani biyagola ibugua ti baba wai bialu bo poda hana howa bope howa dindi emene emene wiaru bo heda heda hai halu mbirale dabudabu bayale wiaru mo pagebu yaiore hene.
Ani biyagola wali agali Gasa tanoha haga hearume Yonadanahondo hale halu, Keba hadalu wahabe, lene. Ani layagola ibugua ti baba gi tigani lalu wahene. Anigo agali haguane hearu igini dege minalu Yarusaleme garabaya helo haru piaga hene. Ani bialu ibu pialu Damasagasa tano puabo hene.
Ani pu howa Yonadana ibu hale halu hearia Demidiriasanaga ami agali dewaore haru halu ami agali haguane mbira hariga Yonadana dai bulebiyago hapai hole Galiliha Kadese tano wiagoria íbu ka layago hale hene.
Ani halu howa ibu hamene Saimono Yudia dindiha helalu Yonadana ibugua ngola halu wai bule pene.
Saimono ibugua Bedesua tano kawareni wai bialu luore biaho wini.
Ani bialu howa tigua Saimonohondo wai wahalu gi tigani lama layagola Saimonohanda karulape lalu anidagua bini. Ani bialu ibugua wali agali tano ogoniha haga hearu taliatagi hai howa ami agali marume tano ogoni handaya ho helo helene.
Ai Yonadana halu ibunaga ami agaliru puwa iba kuyama Genesarete bereago angeni balai anda bialu hene. Ani bialu gao layagola heyalu dindi tigabi Haso tano wiagoria tagira pene.
Ani pialu hearia waitigi maru dindi tigabi bayale wiagoria ibu ngola hene. Anigo ti aria maru hari bare wiagoha hado heago Yonadana ibu manda nabi hene.
Ai ami agali maru hari bareha hado hayaru tagira ibalu waiha hatago hayagola
Yonadananaga ami agali hearu ibida piai hene. Ani biyagola ami agali haru haga haguane kirali hangu Abasalomo igini Madadiasala Kalabisi igini Yudasala hangu Yonadana heba ona hene.
Ani biyagola Yonadanahanda taga timbuni halu be abalu ibunaga haguaneni dugu wialu ibugua Anduane Homogohondo bi lene.
Ani lalu íbu dai buwa waitigi baba wai bialu waitigi bope hayagola ibida piai hene.
Ai Yonadananaga ami agali abale ibida piyaru tigua handalu hearia Yonadana handalu ibida piyago hondowa tibi nde lone íbu dai bialu ami agali hatago hene. Waitigi talima pialu Kadese tano tinaga balai anda bu hene biagoria tagira pialu dindi ogoni Yuda ti karulene.
Ai waitigi daosini tebira (3,000) bibahende horo ogoningi dege homai hene. Ani biai halu Yonadana ibu Yarusaleme dai bini.
Ai Yonadana ibugua handalu hearia ibunaga biabe biyago bayale hai hayago hondowa agali maru ibunaga bi yalu Lomo tano timbuni ngagoha pudaba lene. Tigua habo nalolene bi ala lo wiyago lone mo hongo holenaga bi yalu pelene.
Ani bialu bi mbiraore dege gili bialu Sabarada tanohabi tano hongohe wiaruhabi pelai hene.
Agali bi yalu pene biaru Lomo pialu gabumane anda timbuni mana lagane anda heagoria anda pene. Anda puwa tigua lalu, Inanaga agali haguane Yonadana halu Yudiaha wali agali hearume tí baba habo nalolene bi ala lo wirimago mo hongo halu lone lo wule pudaba laya handala ibirima, lalu latagi hene.
Ani layagola Lomonaga gabumane agali haguane hearume beba gili buwa agali biaru ti giha ya hene. Beba uruni ti harigani Yudia dai bialu karia agali haguane dindi tara tarani bu karume ti harigani baya hangu handaya ho helonaga gilibu mini.
Yonadanahanda Sabarada dindiha gilibu pelenedagoni ogodagua lene.
Agali Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni Yonadana halu gabumane agali haguane bu karubi agali loma binigo mo miaga maru karubi Yudiaha wali agali bu karubi tigua ti hamene Sabarada dindiha karuhondo bi lo wia hara.
Bamba tínaga Kini Ariusuhanda beba mbira gili buwa inanaga Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni Oniasa hearia ibilaya. Ibugua lalu ina bibahende hamene hamene dege lo hami̱ya lalu langiya. Ayu iname bi ibunaga ogoni heba gilibu maga halu tí kemiria ibilaramago ai Ariusunaga bi ogoni heba inanaga bi heba tí handalimulo ibilarama.
Oniasahanda agali tínaga bi yalu ibiyadago bayuwa ibirida lalu turu howa beba ogoni yamini. Beba ogoniha howa ina mandagi nenegeore ho hami̱ya lalu bi wáleore lo wia heneya.
Heneneore ina dindi mende karu baba nenege naheha howa ina hongo Anduane Homogonaga mbuga ngagoha hongo miadai beremali.
Anigo ainde iname tí baba habo nalolene bi lo wirimago lone mo hongo ina nenegeore halu mandagi hami̱ya manda bialu gilibu wia haramago irane iname tíore wanahole manda buwa larama. Anigo ai beba tigua gilibu ibilene mbira nami dege hemaria mali mbira pu bolangua hayada.
Iname lotu lagane horo timbuni tagira ibirangibi inanaga horo timbuni maru tagira ibirangibi iname Anduane Homogohondo loma mialu howabi ina ibuhondo bi lalu howabi bibahendengi tí embeda nahe mitangi bu haabo haramali. Anidagua beremadago irane ina hamene mitangi holene duniniore mbira ngago manda bialu anidagua beremali.
Ani bialu tíore mini yaraga hene timbuni kemigonaga ina turu timbuni ho kema.
Anigo ina bayale nahe wai biabe bialu genda yu haabo haga kemago irane kini bu karume inahondo genda mo ngialu haabo halu kagome ina genda yu kema.
Ina wai beremago bialu howa tíbi ina baba nenege hene maru karubi tí genda mo mulene hame nalaramali.
Ina Ngode Datagaliwabe ibunime baya hangu handaya ho haga kagome ani beremali. Anidagua biaga kemagome inanaga waitigi ibira halu ina wayali hene kema.
Ani howa iname agali kirali Andiogusu igini Numeniusu Yasono igini Andibadela Lomo dindiha bi lo yu pialu ina baba nenego halu mandagi holenaga habo nalolene bi ala lo wirimago lone mo hongo halu lo wima lama piribi.
Ani bialu libugua tí kemiria puwa tí mo biala halu beba habo nalolene bi ala lo winigo mo hongo halu gili bini ogoni milibu larima.
Ainde ayu inanaga beba gilibu wia haramago ladai bilimulo hame ledema, lalu pelene.
Ai abale Sabaradali tigua Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni Oniasa hearia beba gilibu ibilenego ogo
Ai nde Ariusu Sabaradali kini kagome loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni Oniasa bayale kebe, lara.
Tigua bi mbira gilibu winiyago ogodagua leneya. Ai Sabarada wali agalibi Yuda wali agalibi ti hamenelaore ka. Libunaga mamali mbiraore Abarahama hene.
Ayu iname mbirale ogoni handa walia halu ayu ai ti bayale dege kabe hako kabe manda nabi howa bame hale dege harama.
Ainde tígua inahondo beba gili bialu bi ladai birimiyagua nde iname beba gilibu dai bilalu nogo bulumagaru dindiru maru nde tí talebu nguleberema. Tígua nde anidagua bulene manda birimiyagua agali inanaga beba yalu ibirago tigua bi uruni baya hangu ogobi hea lalu lama dai bulebirago hale holeberema, lalu beba gilibu wia hene.
Yonadana ibu hale ho hearia Demidiriasanaga ami haru haga agali haguane hearume ami agali ala haru emene lowa ami agali dewaore haru halu wai bule manda buwa íbu ka layane hale hene.
Ani hale halu Yonadanahanda waitigi ibu daluha anda ibilo hame nale howa ibugua abale Yarusaleme wahalu harigani ngola hole Hamada tano wiagoria pene.
Agali o penedaru tigua hondo wule penego ai tigua handalu dai buwa lalu, Waitigime wai ayu mbiraga bule mandabu hea, lalu lamini.
Ani hale howa Yonadana ibugua ami agali biaruhondo lamialu lalu, Ami agali karu lamialu ayu mbiraga u napale halimu lalu bibahende lamiai halimu. U napale wai biaganeale gime yai howa wai bule manda manda bu halimu lalu lamilimu, lene. Ani lowa agali mbira mamage hai helo dabalu delaga bini.
Ani bialu heago waitigi ti handa walia howa waitigi agali hearu ti gi hai ho hene. Tinaga ira delearu wene dalu helalu ti ibida piai hene.
Ainde mbiraga Yonadana halu ibunaga ami agali biarume agali biaru warahanda howa handalu hearia ira hangu dalu heago dalu helalu tini piai hayayago hendene. Egabi lalu
ai gao layagola Yonadana halu ibunaga ami agali biarume waitigi talia minabe nahe iba Eluderusu domalu pu waore hayago hendene.
Ani piyaya handala Yonadanahanda uruni ti pelo wahalu puwa Sabarada tanoha Arebia hameigini hearu baba wai bialu hene. Wai bialu ibugua ti bo podahana howa tinaga mbirale wiaru ti aribia howa mo pagebu yai halu pene.
Ani bialu mani Damasagasa tano wiagoria tagira pene. Ani puwa dindi ogoniha wiaru baya hangu de handama ibaga biaiore hene.
Ogoningi dege Saimono ibubi nde Asagelono tanoha dindi emene wiaru handama ibaga biai halu bini. Ani bialu lone beregedalu Yoba tano wiagoha puwa ibugua ami agali maru tano ogoni handaya ho helo dabo hene.
Ani dabo helenedagoni irane Yoba wali agalime tinaga tano hongohe ogoni Kini Demidiriasa mule ka layago hale howa ami dabo helene.
Ai Yonadana ibugua gabumane agali haguane bu hearu olo mogo bialu tigua Yudiaha wai pabeanda hongohe maru bu helole mitangi bini.
Ani bialu tigua Yarusaleme tanoha wai pabe daligaore helo biadaga halu wai pabe hongohe timbuni mbira tanola wai pabeanda kagola hengeneha bu hobaki ho bule manda bini. Anidagua biragome tigua mbirale yolo bulenebi mbirale tagulenebi nabilo manda bialu pabe ogonime bu tu wiaki hene.
Wali agali bibahendeme tanoha biabe bulene wiago bulenaga mo hilombira howa bialu hene. Ani binidago wai pabe amu ni tagira ibiragohayagi heago ko halu gialapaya bu wiago hondowa ani bialu hene. Ani bialu mendebi mini Kabenada laga heagobi dindini podo ibira ho wiago de hondowa ogonibi bule manda bialu hene.
Ani bialu heagola Saimono ibugua nde dindi abene amu ni paliragohayagi hari bare wiagoha tano wiaru mo hongo halu wai pabe hearunaga wai pabe panga payaga aeaneme bengena hongohe helaga bini.
Ainde Tiribo ibuni Sirianaga kini holenaga ibugua Kini Andiogusu homelo bo wahale manda bu hene.
Anigo ainde Yonadanahanda ibunaga mini wu kago hame nale howa ibu baba wai bulino gi ho hene. Ani manda buwa Tiribo ibugua ibunaga ami agaliru haru halu Bedesana wiago pole pene. Ibugua Yonadana minalu homelo bo wahole manda bialu pene.
Anigo Yonadana ibuguabi nde ami agali wai baya hangu biaga pari wayaliru daosini dege pira maria (40,000) haru halu Bedesana tano pene.
Ani piyagola Tiribo ibugua Yonadananaga ami agali dewaore haru heago hondowa ibugua Yonadana hamelo bole piyago gi halu wahene.
Wahalu ibunaga agali ho bamba hene haguane bu hearunaga deni howa ibugua Yonadana ibirida lalu mo bila halu hene. Ani bialu ibugua Yonadana mo turu howa mbiraleru bame mialu howa lalu, Wali agali bibahendeme kini ibuninaga mini yaraga haremilidagua Yonadananaga mini yaraga halu halimu, lene.
Ani lowa ibugua Yonadanahondo lalu, Iyaore keba holene mbira nawiore kebagoni. Ani kebagodago irane aginaga í̠naga ami agali dewaore haru kebe.
Ti maru tini daluha hama dai bidaba la. Í̠ni heba polene maru dege haru halu Tolemese tano ma. I̱na tano ogonibi wai pabeanda hongohe maru ngarubi ami agali marubi ami agali haru haga haguane marubi tale bialu maru í̠ ngulebero. Ani ngialu maha nde beregedalu i̱ni dalu dai bulebero. Ainde i̱ mbirale uruni dege bule ibinigo kogoni, lalu lamini.
Ani laya handala Yonadana ibugua Tiribonaga bi ogoni henene laya lo manda buwa ibunaga ami agali dewaore Yudia hole dai bidaba lene.
Ami agali daosini tebira (3,000) hangu ibuni heba hene. Ani howa lone mo tale bialu ami agali daosini kira (2,000) Galili helalu daosini mbira (1,000) ibuni heba pene.
Pialu Yonadana halu ibunaga ami agali biaru Tolemese tanoha anda piyagola agali tanoha hearume wai pabe panga payatagi howa Yonadana minu garabaya bialu ibunaga ami agali biaru homelo bo wahai halu tinaga wai biaga ayu tibu yu hearu tigua gingila miai hene.
Ani bialu Tiribohanda ibunaga ami agali maru geni piaga hearubi maru nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga hearu Galili dindihabi dindi tigabi wiagohabi pialu Yonadananaga ami agali maru hearu bo wahai hole pudaba lene.
Ainde Yuda ami agali maru biaru tigua manda bu handalu hearia Yonadana halu ibunaga ami agali maru piyaru bo wahayada lo manda bu hene. Ani manda buwa ainde tini degedege mo hongo haga haga bialu wai bule tidi yalu pene.
Waitigi biaru tigua handalu hearia Yudali biarume homolene gi nahe tigua wai bule hongo ho heago handalu ti ibida dai bini.
Ani biya handala Isaraele ami agali ti bayale dai bialu Yudia dindi anda pene. Ani bialu Yuda wali agalime Yonadana halu ibunaga ami agali homayagonaga dara timbuni howa dugu bialu duguanda luore hene. Tigua gi timbuniore ho howa dugu timbuni bialu hene.
Ai dindi bibahendeha hameigini tara tara palearume Yuda wali agali lenego mbiraore hangubi nahelo bo helo wahaiore manda bini. Tigua lo manda bialu, Ayu tinaga agali haguane ti haru bamba haga mbira nahebi agali ti biamogo bulenebi mbira naheore nga. Ani ngago ai mani howa Yuda wali agali dindi hene lalu tinaga te nalelo iname ti aria lenego balu bo amo lami̱ya, lene.
Ai Saimono ibu hale halu hearia Tiribohanda ami agali dewaore haru halu Yudiaha wali agali bu karu bo hilo wahai hole ibira layane hale hene.
Ani hale ho hearia wali agali bu hearume gi howa mogolalu duru timbuni lalu heago hendene. Ani hondowa ibu Yarusaleme pialu ti haru mandagi hene.
Ani howa ibugua tinaga miniha mo hongo halu lalu, Ai i̱ hamenerubi i̱ aba ibu damene bu hearumebi Anduane Homogonaga anda bayale ngelonaga baya hangu handaya ho halu Mosesenaga bi mana lo wini ngagobi bayale ngelonaga handaya ho halu buwa timbuni bialu harimago tínime handalu manda bu kemi. Ani bialu howa iname wai timbuni bialu harimagobi genda tara tara dewaore yu harimagabi tí manda biai kemi.
I̱ hamene bibahende Isaraele wali agali biamogo bialu homai hayagoni ndobe. Ai i̱ hangu wahenego o kogonida.
Ai wai birimagoha i̱ni hangu homolino wai bialu henebe toba holemini nahalimu. Ainde i̱ hameneru ti dindiha lowa i̱ daliga ndo ko.
Ayu agali dindi tara taraha bu hearume ina bo hilo wahaiore holenaga ti mo mogo biai halu wai mo miyadagola i̱na nde inanaga dindibi Anduane Homogonaga anda kagobi tinaga wali waneigini biru karunagabi wai bulene hamelo kogoni, lene.
Wali agali tigua Saimononaga bi ogoni hale howa tinaga bu mini ha lone hongo hadai bini.
Ani howa tigua hongo howa ladai bialu lalu, Saimono í̠ inanaga agali haguane kegoni. Í̠ hamene Yudasala Yonadanala libunaga henge mialu libu henedagua í̠ni ha aribia ha.
Ani bialu inanaga wai bia ha. Ina bibahende í̠ hangu talima ibule kema, lalu bibahendeme lai hene.
Ai Saimonohanda ami agali hearu bibahende mo mogo biai howa Yarusaleme tanoha wai pabe hongo howa biai halu tano maru wiaruhabi lone mo hongo halu abale biai helo mo daila hene.
Ani bialu ibugua, Abasalomo igini Yonadana halu ami agali dewaore Yoba tano pole pudaba, lene. Ani laya handala puwa Yonadana ogoni ibugua wali agali tano ogoniha hagane hearu bo taliatagi hai halu tano ibu karulo hene.
Ai Tiribo halu ibunaga ami agali dewaore Tolemese tano wahalu Yudiahayagi anda pene. Ogoningi Saimono hamene Yonadana garabaya helowa Tiribo heba mandagi Yudiaha pole pene.
Horo ogoningi Saimono halu ibunaga ami agali biarume puwa dindi tigabi mbira wiago gibuniha Adida tano wiagoria balai anda bialu hene.
Ai Saimono ibugua ibu hamene Yonadananaga henge mialu agali haguane ha aribia howa wai bule manda manda bu ka layago Tiribo hale hene. Ani hale howa Tiribo ibugua Saimonohondo lawia halu lalu,
Í̠ hamene Yonadana ibugua Yarusalemeha agali haguane hayago howa kininaga dagisi muni namiyagonaga ibuni garabaya helowa ina haru mandagi kema.
Ainde tigua siliba muni dewaore genda magi kilogarama daosini tebira (3,000) ibilarimiyagua nde ibu garabaya kago golope halu pu loleberema. Anigo ai garabaya golalu pu laramagola mani lone mine holigo ibu igini kirali kago labo ina baba howa libu aba henegoria ha aribia helo ibilalimu, lalu bi lo pelene.
Ani lo wia hayayago hale howa Saimonohanda ami agali lo manda bialu, Yonadana igini kira ogoni labo haru ibidaba, lene. Saimono ibu Tiribohanda bi layadago henene ndo layada lo manda bu howa dege Yuda wali agali tigua ibuhondo keba howa lalu,
Saimonohanda siliba muni biarubi igiri kirali ogoni labobi napelayagome nde Yonadana homaragonida, lalu ibuha bi podene ngelolobada lo manda bini.
Ani manda buwa ibugua munibi igiri kiralibi pelene. Ani pelayagola Tiribo ibugua henene bule lalu gi dolalu bi lo wiyago mo habo lalu ibugua Yonadana garabaya golope nahene.
Ani bialu mani howa Tiribo ibugua Yudia dindiha dewaore mo ko hole emene hama anda ibugu bini. Ibugua hariga paulalu Adora tano pole piaga luore wiadagua pialu pene. Ani pialu hearia Saimono halu ibunaga ami agalirume hariga ogonidagua dege pialu Tiribo pole piyago hariga hapai hene.
Ani bialu heagola ami agali maru Yarusalemeha wai pabeanda hongohe wiagoha haga hearume Tiribo hearia bi lo pelalu, Ina tomo nawiore kemago tomo maru yalu hariga dindi ko wali agali nahaga ngagoha ibalu tomo yalu ibabe, lalu hongo howa bi lawia hene.
Anidagua layayago hale halu ibunaga ami agali nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga bu hearu tigua pole manda manda bu hadaba lalu lamini. Pole manda manda bu palearia mbiraga ogoningi dindi guni timbuni ibira howa hariga polebiyago wiapai hene. Anidagua biya handala ti emene hadai bialu Gileada polene hariga wiadagua pialu pene.
Pialu ibugua Basagama tano wiagoria tagira puwa Yonadana ogoriani howa homelo bo wahene. Ani biyagola ibunaga tingini dindi ogoniha mo hora hene.
Ani bialu Tiribo ibu ibuni dalu dai bini.
Ani biyagola Saimonohanda agali maru ibu hamene Yonadananaga tingini mo pudaba lene. Mo yu dai biyagola ibu mamalirunaga tano Modeini tano wiagoria hora hene.
Ani bialu Isaraele wali agali ti Yonadana dara howa dugu bialu duguanda luore horo dewa berene.
Ani bialu Saimonohanda ibu aba hameneru mitangi bu haabo holenaga tinaga homalini anda mbira daliga bu gimbu bima irigi howa bu helene. Anda bu gimbu bima irigi hene ogoni dindi kaundiaha howa panaga handai habehe daliga dege hene. Anda ogoni erembirahabi tombehabi ege to̱le̱ ngiringarale muni yolo dewaoreme miaga wiarume mo yaribia helene.
Ani bialu nde Saimono ibu aba ai̱yalabi ibu hamene marialirubi mitangi bialu ege to̱le̱ timbuni karia mo dabadaba howa ogoriani dege ngelene.
Ege to̱le̱ ogoni wiyadagoria ira timbuniru gombedo yu ibuwa ira ogoriani aminaga wai yari biaga wiaru gili buwa bigiya wabu ngelalu iba sibinaga bigiyabi wabu ngelalu buwa hengene. Ira timbuni dibu hangaga binidaruni agali wai pialu tigua bo poda hana haga bini mitangi bialu daga lowa helene. Saimono ibugua mitangi bialu. Wali agali dindi tara tarani bu karume ibalu de handai helo mitangi buwa ani wabu helene.
Ai mbirale uruni ayu Modeini tanoni homali kagoria haabo ka.
Ai Tiribohanda Kini Andiogusu waragane igiri emene dege hayago mohondo howa homelo bo wahene.
Ani bialu Tiribo ibuni Sirianaga kini ho aribia howa ibugua dindi ogoniha mana ko dewa bialu hene.
Saimonohanda Yudiaha tano wiaru dewaore mo arema bialu hongohe ngelaga bialu hene. Wai pabe neneni mamageali de handa pugubu hagane anda daliga bu helaga bialu wai pabe ege pabe hongoheore bu helaga bialu wai pabe panga bengena aeane hongoheme helaga bini. Ani biai howa tano wai pabeanda hongohe uruniha tomo dewaore bu ngelaga bini.
Ai Saimonohanda Kini Demidiriasahondo bi agali kiralime lo yu pudaba lowa lalu, Tiribohanda ibu daluha mo ko halu mbirale mo page bialu haabo kago ainde ibu daluha howa dagisi muni miaga wirigo emene yupe harebe, lama pene.
Ani layago hale howa Kini Demidiriasa waragane heago ibugua beba gili bialu bi ladai binigo ogo,
Kini Demidiriasahanda agali Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga haguane timbuni Saimonobi Yudia wali agali bibahendebi tinaga agali haguanerubi turu haro laro.
Tígua manda ngolome wabinibi ayage alenaga yunibi wia harimiyago mirimago ai iname tí baba gi tigani bule manda manda bu kema. Ani bialu inanaga agali haguane bu karuhondo tíha dagisi mulene nawi lalu abale lamirima.
Habo nalolene bi ala lo wirimago iname bi ogoni karulape lalu haabo kema. Tígua wai pabeanda hongohe bu helaga bidemigo tíniha ha helo laro.
Ai mana ko tígua abale howa bialu henego ayu bialu haabo kemigoni bibahende wahai harama. Ani bialu kininaga dagisi muni yolo bulene winingi nabi ngelo kemigobi waharama. Ani bialu dagisi muni Yarusalemeha miaga winigo nami harimagobi mo waharama. Ani bialu dagisi muni maru tara tara Yarusalemeha miaga wirimagobi waharama.
Ai Yuda agali wai biaga pari wayali kemiru tí maru kininaga ami agali hatago hoa biyagua nde ani bulene karulape ka. Ina kemagoha mo ko holene nawi bayale dege hami̱ya hamelo kema, lene.
Ai mali handari mbira pira karia (170) hayangi howa Isaraele tiha wali agali Anduane Homogo mitangi nahaga hearume Isaraeleali abale haru henego ogoriani howa haru nahe wahalu pene. Isaraele wali agalirume tini hangu halu bayale hene.
Ai Saimono ibu Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga haguane timbunibi ibu ami agalinaga agali haguanebi Yuda wali agalinaga agali haguanebi ibu pigane hayangi howa tigua habo nalolene bi lo wiaganerubi uruniale lo wiaganerubi horo ogoningi howaore tini hangu lalu gilibu wiaga hene.
Ogoningi Saimono halu ibunaga ami agali heba pialu Gese tano wiagoria pialu balai anda buwa ami agalime tano ho mabubu hene. Ani howa tigua wai biagane masini mbira wabuwa tanoha wai pabe heagoha wiapara howa ngelowa pabe neneni mamageali handa amu nana bu holene anda pabe neneni heago tigatiga masini biagome pabe bo gialayagola anda daliga wai pabe neneni heago podope hene.
Ani biyagola Saimononaga ami agali bu hearume miyagola ami agali masini biagoria hearu abale tanoha porabu anda hayagola wali agali tanoha bu hearu bibahende ibida pora bialu piai hene.
Ai wali agali tanoha bu hearume tinaga aga minu budalu tanonaga wai pabe egeme bini heago neneni irigi hai halu tigua Saimonohondo wai wahalu gi tigani lama lowa hongo howa bi ladagadaga bialu hale halu hene.
Tigua lalu, Ainde ko iname birimago damene bibahende mitangi bialu pani nangi wahalu ina dara ha, lalu hene.
Ani layagola nde Saimono ibugua wai wahalu tinaga bi layago hale hene. Anigo ibugua wali agali tanoha hearu bo taliatagi hai halu mbirale dama mitangi bialu bi pupu wiaga gime wabini wiarunaga anda hearuha mbirale ko uruniale wiaru mo wahai halu anda hearu lone mo bayale haga bialu hene. Ibu tano ogoniha anda pialu howa ibugua Ngode Datagaliwabehondo turu halu iba gana lama anda pene.
Ani bialu tano ogoniha mbirale Ngode Datagaliwabenaga deni dodohe wiaru bibahende mo wahai halu agali maru Mosesenaga bi mana hale howa talialu haga bu hearu haru halu ibuwa tano ogoniha helaga bini. Ani buwa wai pabe baya hangu mo hongo howa biatiga bialu ibunaga mbira tano ogoniha bu helalu bini.
Ogoningi Yarusaleme tanonaga wai pabe timbuni heagonaga pabe panga ndibulo waheagola agali wai pabe andaha haga bu hearu tomo taya magedi tagira pobe naheore wini. Ani wiagola ti tomo nalu holene mbira nawiore howa dewa hina garime homai hene.
Anidagua biyagola tigua Saimonohondo lalu, Waitigi wahalu gi tigani bima, lene. Ani layagola ibugua ti baba gi tigani lalu dege agali wai pabeanda hongohe ogoniha haga hearu bo talia tagi halu anda Anduane Homogonaga deni dodo nahe helo lone mo bayale hene.
Ai mali handari mbira pira kariani mbira (171) heagola mali ogoninaga ege mendenaga horo pira kirani tebira (23) hayagola Yuda tigua wai pabeanda hondole Yarusalemeni hayagoha pigane anda pene. Puwa Saimono halu ibunaga agali bu hearume Ngode Datagaliwabehondo turu timbuniore halu tigua ira maganeru podo yalu tigua ngidaru tabagerubi balu iba ganaru lama anda pene. Tinaga waitigi timbuni henego mo ko hayagola tigua Yarusaleme turu timbuni halu hene.
Ani howa Saimonohanda mana mbira ogobi wabu wini. Mali bibahendenaga horo ayu kemago dege tagira ibiragola turu ho holene horo ngelo dabaro, lene. Ani lowa ibugua Anduane Homogo andanaga wai pabe abene pabeanda hongohe heagohayagi heago baya hangu mo hongo howa hongoheore bialu agali marume obisianda dunini ogoniha bu helene.
Ani buwa ainde Saimono ibuni igini Yone anda halu agali hongohe dege heagola ibugua Yone ogoni ibu ami agali haru hagane agali haguane helo dabo helene. Ani helaya handala Yone ibu puwa Gese tanoha hene.
Mali handari mbira pira kariani kira (172) layagola Kini Demidiriasa mende ibugua ibunaga ami agaliru haru halu Midia pole pene. Midiali tigua ibu biamogo bialu Tiribola wai bima lole hondo pene.
Ani pialu hearia Midia Pesialanaga Kini Asagese ibugua ani ibira layago hale howa ibunaga ami agali haru haga agali haguane mbira heagohondo lalu, Ami agali maru haru halu abale harigani ngola halu Demidiriasa minalu garabaya bule pudaba, lene.
Ami agali haru haga agali haguane ogoni ibugua pialu wai buwa Demidiriasanaga ami agali bope halu ibuni minu garabaya bu yalu Kini Asagese hearia dai bini. Ani piyagola Asagesehanda Demidiriasa garabaya helo helene.
Saimono ibugua Yudia dindi hondo howa haru heangi mbirale bibahende bayale dege wiai hene. Mali bibahendengi ibu Yudiaha agali haguane heangi ibugua agali haguane mini lene howa wali agali biamogo buleneale wiago biai halu hene. Ani bialu heagola tigua ibuhondo turu ho haabo hene.
Ibugua iba sibi íbu wiaga iba ange Yobani wiago bo podahana halu wali agali hariga ogoniha polene hearu ta nabi puíbu bialu Girigi dindiha pelo hariga bope heagome ibunaga mini yaraga halu mini lene timbuniore hene.
Ibugua wai bigi bialu dindi maru ibunaga dindiha bo yu anda ibalu wiatago helaga biyagola ibunaga dindi dewaore waore wialu mo timbu howa dindi uruni bibahende ibuni handaya ho hene. Ani bialu waitigi dewa garabaya helaga bini.
Ibugua tano hongoheore Gese tanobi Bedesu tanobi handaya ho halu wai pabeanda hongohe Yarusalemebi handaya ho hene. Ani bialu ibugua pabeanda hongohe ogoni mo gini bialu heagola agali mbirame ibunaga bi layago mo wanahe hai hene.
Ainde Yuda wali agali ti bayale howa tinaga mabuha tomoru hangalu hene. Mabuha tomo hengearu bayale anda hai halu lini bayale dalu ira lini dagane ale hengearume ira lini bayale dai haga bini.
Agali waheore ala hene hearume magedi hamani biruwa mbirale bamba ti heangi biniru te lamigi bialu berene. Igiri daliahe hearume ami agalinaga wai pole mo karulagane yari wiaru ti mo karulalu bame horongi yari karulole turu howa bame mo karulole haga bini.
Saimonohanda tano timbuni wiaruha bayale ngelonaga tomo dewa bu mialu wai biagane alebi dewa dege tano uruniha mo wigi bini. Dindi bibahendeha ibunaga mini yaraga hene mbira hene.
Saimonohanda Yudiaha mo palia holene mo yu anda ibiyagola Isaraele wali agali turu timbuni ho hene.
Agali ti hangu hangu tini headagua mbirale mbira gi nahe tinaga ira lini daga ale gerebi andanehabi poge andanehabi ni gumba biraga bini.
Tigua kini biaru bope hai hene heagome Yuda dindiha wai anda ibulene waitigi mbira nahe wini.
Saimono ibugua yagibano karubi biamogo biaga hene. Ibugua Mosesenaga bi mana lo wini ngagome bibe lalu ledadagua wali agali mana ko biaga bu karu bo talialu purogo lelaga hene.
Ibugua Anduane Homogonaga anda baya hanguore mo yaribia halu ibugua gabo be belediru tigua lotunaga biabe bilo mo migi bialu hene.
Yonadana homayagola bi te loyogo lalu Lomo dindihabi Sabarada dindihabi piaiore halu hale hai howa tigua Yonadana dara timbuni hene.
Ani howa dege Sabaradali tigua Yonadana hamene Saimono ibu hamenenaga henge wiagoria ibuni ha aribia howa Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbunibi Yudia dindi bibahende haru howa handayaho hagabi tano ngaru bibahende handaya ho hagabi ibuni dege ha aribia ho ka layago hale howa ti turu hene.
Bamba tigua habo nalolene bi Yudasa bababi Yonadana bababi lo wini biago mbirale boronosime wabini mbalapaya mbirani lone gili bialu Yarusalemeha yalu pelene.
Ani yu piyagola tigua wali agalinaga deni howa bi ogoni daga lene.
Habo nalolene bi ogo Sabarada wali agalime gilibu wia heneya. Tigua lalu, Agali haguanerubi Sabarada wali agali bibahendebi tigua Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni Saimonobi agali haguane bu kemiru bibahendebi agali loma binigo mo miaga kemiru bibahendebi ina hameneore Yudiaha kemiru tíbi bibahendehondo bayale kemidago turu harama lalu lo ibi larama.
Agali maru ina hemaria bi yu pudaba larimiyaru tigua ina hemaria ibalu tínaga mini timbuni mini lene ngagobi tí dunini abogo ka lene kemigobi bibahende ina langiai haya. Ti ibiyagola iname ti hondowa turu timbuni harima.
Iname bi libugua layago damene bibahende mbuga mbiraha gilibu ngema. Bi ogodagua laya. Andiogusu igini Numeniusubi Yasono igini Andibadabi libugua ina nenege haabo holenaga bi lo winigo lone mo hongo hami̱ya bi yalu pudaba larimiyago libugua lama ibiya.
Inanaga wali agalime libu ibiyago ngola hole íbu ngoai howa ibirida lowa turu hai halu libunaga mini yaraga haya. Iname libunaga bi layago gabumane mbugaha bi pigane layagonaga beba mo wulenaga turu halu mo werema. Ani bialu Sabarada wali agali tinaga bi kira nga. Bi mendego bebani gili bialu Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni Saimono hearia pelarima, lene.
Mani howa Saimonohanda Lomo dindialiru baba habo nalolene bi lo winigo lone mo hongo holenaga bi yalu Numeniusu Lomo pu lene. Ani laya handala Numeniusu ibugua wai humbi mbira ngolome wabini genda magi kilogarama handari duria (500) wiago mo yalu pene.
Saimonohanda mbirale uruni bira layago Isaraele wali agali tigua hale howa turu timbuni halu tigua Saimono halu ibu iginiruhondo, Ka̱i̱ agua loabedabe, lalu hene.
Ibunibi ibu hamenerubi ibu aba hamene maru hearubi tigua hongo howa haabo haya. Tigua wai bialu waitigi bu hearu balu bo taliatogo layagome dindi ogo hibaria golope hene ngagoni ndobe, lene. Tigua bi urunidagua lalu beba timbuni gili buwa Saiono neneni ira dibu hongowa ogoni handai helo bapara ho ngelaga bini.
Tigua bi gilibu winidaruni ogodagua lo wini. Ai ege mini Elulu hayagola mali handari mbira pira kariani kira (172) layagola ege ogoninaga horo pira mbirani halira (18) hayangi Saimono ibu Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni pigane henego hama ibalu mali tebone hayagola
iname wali agali bu hearu bababi agali loma binigo mo miaga hearubi agali haguane bu hearubi ina bibahendeme bi mbira lo wirima.
Wai dewaore dindi ogoha beremaligo ainde agali loma binigo mo miaga Yahoiaribi aria Madadiasa igini Saimono halu ibu hamenerume tini homolenehayagi mo embeda haga hene. Ani howa tigua hongo howa dindi ngagonagabi Anduane Homogo anda kagonagabi bi mana lo wini ngagonagabi hongo howa wai bialu haga hene. Tigua ogonidagua bialu inanaga dindi ngagonaga mini mo yaraga haya.
Yonadanahanda wali agali bu hearunaga bu mini mo mbiraore ho helalu ibuni Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni halu buwa nde homaya.
Waitigime ibalu inanaga dindi ngagobi Anduane Homogonaga anda kagobi mo ko hai halu bo labu hole ibiyagola
Saimonoha abale heyalu wai biaga hene. Ibuninaga muni dewaore wahalu wai bulene ale danda timuru yolo bialu ami agali bu karubi yolo biaga hene.
Ani bialu ibugua Yudiaha tano timbuni wiaru mo hongo hai halu Bedesu tano Yudia dindi gibunihayagi waitiginaga wai biaganealeru mo wini tano biagobi mo hongo hai haya. Ani bialu ami agali maru tano ogoni mamage howa handaya ho helo heleda.
Ani bialu ibugua Yoba tano iba solowara bedago angeni ngago mo hongo ho ngelalu Asadodo tano ngagoria kaware Gese tano ngagobi mo hongo ho ngelalu bida. Tano uruni abale waitiginaga winigo ayu ibu mo yu daibu wini nga. Ibugua Yuda wali agali tano uruniha hai helalu tinaga biabe bulene ale ibunime mo miaga ka.
Wali agali tigua Saimono hondo hearia ibu agali hongohe mini lene timbuni hayago hondowa tigua ibu tinaga agali haguanebi tinaga Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbunibi helo dabo helaya. Ibugua biabe urunidagua bialu ibu daluha mana bayale tigabi bulenebi mini lene timbuni nga lolenebi mo yu anda ibiyagome tigua ibu mo yaraga haya. Heneneore laramago ibunaga wali agali mini mo yaragaore ho heleda.
Ibu agali haguane heangi ibugua wali agali tara hearu bo taliatagi hai haya. Ani bialu waitigi Anduane Homogonaga anda kawareni bu hearu taliatagi haya. Waitigi uruni tigua wai pabeanda hongohe anda biago kawareni bu howa bibahendengi tigua tagira ibalu anda heago Anduane Homogonaga deni mo dodo haabo haya.
Ani biyagola ayu Saimono ibugua wai pabeanda hongohe ogoniha Yudiali dabo helalu ibugua anda ogoni arema bialu mo hongo howa dindibi Anduane Homogonaga andabi bayale helonaga ani biya. Ani bialu ibugua Yarusalemenaga pabe hongohe kago lone bialu daligaore heleda.
Kini Demidiriasahanda biabe Saimono ibugua biyago de hondowa Saimono Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni karulape kago ibu helo lalu helaya.
Ani bialu ibunaga mini Kininaga Nenege lalu ibu mini lene timbuni helo helaya.
Kini Demidiriasa ibugua o biyadagoni irane ibugua hale ho hearia Lomoalime Yudali ti nenegebi ti baba mandagi holenebi ti hamenebi layago hale howabi agali Saimononaga bi yalu piaga biarunaga mini yaraga hara layago hale howa ibugua anidagua biya.
Anidagua biyagola nde Yuda wali agalimebi agali loma binigo mo miaga bu hearumebi bi lo mbira halu agali Anduane Homogonaga mana latagi haganeore ibilo malia ho kemangi ibugua biabe bialu helo wahama larimi.
Tigua bi lo mbira halu Saimono ibugua gabumane agali haguane halu Ngode Datagaliwabenaga anda handaya ho halu ami agalibi haru helo helama larimi. Ani bialu agali gabumane handaya ho holenebi wai biaganeale ngarubi wai pabeanda hongohe tanoha wima pedarubi Anduane Homogonaga anda kagobi ibuni handaya ho helo waha lai harimi.
Ani bialu agali bu hearume lalu wali agali bibahendeme Saimononaga bi hale hai halimu laya. Ani bialu gabumaneme habo nalolene bi lo wigi birago bibahendeni Saimono ibunaga mini gilibu wialu dege ngelo laya. Ibugua kininaga aga ngago mo karulalu ngolome wabini mandibu ngago karulo halu bilo laya.
Agali loma binigo mo miaga karu ariamebi agali marumebi Saimononaga bi ledago mo waholenebi ibunaga aga kininaga aga karu laganeale ngago mendealime aribia howa mo karulolenebi ibunaga mandibu ngolome wabini ngago mo karulolenebi nawiore laya. Ani bialu agali dewa íbu ngoai howa bi midini mbira loleyagua nde Saimononaga bi ala hale howa ibugua karulape layagua midini lolebira.
Mbiralime mana ogoni mo bagi halu piyaguabi pugualu piyaguabi nde ogoni biaga kago ibu godi deni ibu holene nga.
Wali agali bibahendeme bi lo mbira halu Saimono ibugua mana ogoni talialu bialu howa wali agali haru helo larima.
Ani larimago Saimono ibugua Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane holenebi ami agali haru bamba haga agali haguanebi loma binigo mo miaga agali bu karunaga agali haguane holenebi wali agalinaga agali haguane holenebi ibugua dege holene karulape laya, lene.
Ai tigua bi lo e̱ lalu bi uruni boronosime wabini mbalapaya mbirani gili buwa wali agali bibahendeme de handai helo Anduane Homogonaga anda biago tamuha anda háini gilibu derela hami̱ya.
Ani bialu bi ogoni halu mende gili buwa Saimono halu ibu iginiru tini de handaga bilonaga Anduane Homogonaga andaha muni wiaga ngagoha ngelami̱ya, lalu bi lene.
Andiogusu Kini Demidiriasa igini mbira ibu dindi mbira iba solowara dombeneha dindi mini Kiridi laga wiagoha hene. Ai agali Andiogusu ibugua beba mbira gili buwa loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbunibi Yuda wali agalinaga agali haguanebi wali agali ibugua handaya ho haga bu karunaga agali haguanebi Saimono heagohondo beba gilibu peleneya.
Ibugua bi ogodagua lalu gili bini. Kini Andiogusuhanda Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni Saimono halu Yudia wali agalibi tíhondo bayale kemibe larama.
Agali ko hearume i̱ abanaga dindi ti karulai henego ai ayu i̱nime hongo halu lone mo yu dai buwa mo hongo halu abale bayale wiagagobi ngelo biabe bialu ko. Ami agali tagira howa dewaore i̱ biamogo bialu wai bilonaga yolo bialu haru halu íbu heledo. Ani bialu iba sibi dewa timbuniru mo manda manda bu wiai ko.
Iba sibi uruni yalu dindi mendehayagi puwa waitigi dewa i̱naga tanorubi dindi andaru bo labu hai halu mo ko haga biaru baba wai bulebero.
Ayu i̱nabi nde dagisi dewa tígua ngiaga wirimigo abale i̱ aba ibugua biyadagua mo wahai halu tígua yolo maru i̱ ngulene ngemigobi bibahende mo wahai haro.
Tí daluha munime biabe bulene ngago damene tínime bialu holene karulapego muni tíni taya bialu biabe tínime bialu holene nga laro.
Yarusalemehabi Anduane Homogonaga andahabi dagisi muni miaga wirugo yupe halu ayu waharogoni. Wai biaganeale wabu wu kemiru bibahendebi tano wai pabe hongohe bu mabubi ngemirubi uruni bibahende tíninaga giha ya harogoni.
Tígua kininaga muni andaha muni dano hole mo yiniyaguabi dano mani holenenagabi bibahende maniorebi ani wiaabo helonaga ayu mo waharogoni.
Mani i̱naga dindi ngago bibahende handameho howa haru kongi i̱na í̠naga mini yaraga howa mo daligaho helalu í̠naga wali agalibi Anduane Homogonaga andabi bibahende mini mo yaraga hai holebero. Anidagua beregola wali agali dindi bibahendeha karume tínaga mini mo yaraga hene mini leneore kemigo hondolebira, lene.
Mali handari mbira pira kariani maria (174) hayagola Andiogusu ibu dindi ibu aba mamalirunaga winiore wiagoria birule dai bini. Ami agali dewaore ibalu ibuha hatago hayagola Tiribo baba emene daga lene dege mbira hene.
Andiogusuhanda Tiribo baba wai biyagola Tiribo ibu ibida pialu iba solowara timbuni bereago angeha Doro tano wiagoha hado hene.
Tiribo ibugua manda bu handalu hearia ibunaga ami agali heneru dewaore piai hayagome ibugua wai bibe nahe ibu minalu boleneore wiayuane handalu ibu pora bialu pene.
Ani piyagola Andiogusu ibunaga ami agali wai biaga mugube pari wayaliru daosini handari mbirani pira kira (120,000) ami agali geni pialu wai biagabi daosini halira (8,000) nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga hearubi haru halu puwa Doro tano wiagoria wai bini.
Ibunaga iba sibi wiarume iba solowarani wai bialu heagola anidagua biyagome Andiogusuhanda Doro tano ho hagirabu yaanda hai hene. Ani bialu ibunaga ami agali hearume dindinibi solowaranibi wai biai hene. Ani bialu howa tano ogoniha mbiraoreli hangubi uba andatagi nabuleore lalu mamage baya hangu hai hene.
Horo ogoningi dege Numeniusu halu ibu baba haga hearume beba mbira gili buwa Lomo dindi wahalu dindi maruha kini hearunagabi dindi bibahendenagabi ta halu yu pugupugu bini. Beba ogoniha bi ogodagua lene.
Lomonaga agali haguane Lusiusuhanda Kini Tolemihondo, Í̠ bayale kebe, lara.
Ani bialu Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni Saimono halu Yuda wali agalime habo nalolene bi ala lo wirimago lone mo hongo howa ina nenege haabo halu mandagi howa ina hamene dege lo holenaga habo nalolene bi ala lo wirimago lone mo hongo hama lalu bi yalu agali kirali ibiniya.
Libugua wai humbi mbira ngolome wabini genda magi kilogarama handari duria (500) inanaga wabu wia heneyago yalu ibiya.
Iname bi lo mbira halu Yuda dindi mo ko halu bo labu haga kinibi agali haguane bu karubi bibahendehondo beba ogo gili bialu piai helarama.

Agali ko maru ibida pora bialu tí kemigoha ibiyagua nde tígua minalu Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni Saimono giha minu ya halimu. Ibunime howa agali ogonialego ti Yuda maname biaga winidagoale bilo minu milimu, lene.
Lusiusu ibugua bi ogoni dege gili bialu Kini Demidiriasahondobi Kini Adalusuhondobi Kini Ariadesehondobi Kini Asagesehondobi pelaga bini.

Ani bialu beba mbira loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane timbuni Saimono hearia pelalu bini.
Kini Andiogusu ibugua Doro tanoha wai halu mende bini. Ibugua ami agali dewaore haru howa wai biagane masini dewa wabu wialu buwa tano ogoniore bo gialanda hole lowa bu hondo wahalu hene. Ibugua tano ho hagira biai ho heagola Tiribo tagira pobe naheore wini.
Ani bialu heagola Saimono ibugua Andiogusu biamogo bialu ami agali ibunagaore haga heneru daosini kira (2,000) mialu muni silibabi ngolobi dewaore talebu mialu wai biaganeale danda timu yandare ayu tibu wai humbibi dewaore tale bu mialu bini.
Ani biyagola Andiogusu ibugua mbirale uruni yamia nabi wahalu habo nalolene bi ala lo wiyago mo habo lalu bini. Ani bialu libu mo waitigi hene.
Andiogusu ibugua agali ibunaga nenege mbira mini Adenobiusu heago Saimonola bi lole pu lene. Ani laya handala ibugua puwa lalu, Ayu í̠na Yoba tanobi Gese tanobi wai pabe anda hongohe Yarusalemebi handaya ho kegoni. Ai tano uruni bibahende i̱ daluha dege wiai ka.
Í̠na dindi uruni mo ko hai harigoni. I̱naga dindiha mo ko halu genda holene dewa mo yu anda ibiri. I̱naga dindi wiaru dewa í̠ karulo ke.
Ai ayu í̠na i̱naga tano timbuni wiwaru í̠ karulariruni bibahende i̱ni ngiadai bibe laro. Ani bialu tano Yudia be tagirahayagi wini í̠ karulo kegonaga dagisi muni ngibe.
Anidagua nabuleyagua nde í̠na muni siliba genda magi kilogarama daosini nguira (15,000) tano uruni yolo ngialu muni ogonidagua dege halu mende dagisi mitangi bialubi mbirale mo ko hai haridagonagabi ngibe laro. Anidagua nabiriyagua nde wai bibiya laro, lalu bi lama pudaba lene.
Ani laya handala Adenobiusu ibu pialu Yarusaleme anda puwa ibugua Saimono yari biarubi ibunaga beledi ngolome wabinibi silibame wabinibi ibunaga tebolo dagiani wiaru handalu mana Saimonohanda biaga wiarubi handa dege bialu ibu mogo lo hendene. Ani hondowa ibugua Kini Andiogusunaga bi layago Saimono lamini.
Ani layagola Saimonohanda ladai bialu lalu, Iname dindibi mbirale tara tara ngarualebi dindi mendenaga mo page nabiore henego kemagoni ndobe. Bamba inanaga mamali giha yu haga winiru dege inane mo yu dai bigi bini wu kema. Mbirale uruni waitigime bamba mo pagebu yu pugu binigo yu dai bigi binigo ngema.
Mbirale ina mamalinaga mo page bini uruni mo yu dai bulene hariga ayu dege handarima.
Í̠na Yoba tano Gese tanola hale haribe. Tano kira ogoni laboha karume inanaga wali agali kagoha genda tara tara mo mialu inanaga dindi ngagobi mo ko haabo haga ka ndobe. Anidagua biagago ainde harugo tano kira ogonilabo yolo bialu muni siliba genda magi kilogarama daosini tebira (3,000) hangu nguliya, lene. Ani layagola Adenobiusuhanda bi mbira ladai nabini.
Ibugua miniha tandaga timbuni halu kini hearia dai bini. Dai buwa ibugua kinihondo Saimonohanda bi layago lamiai halu Saimononaga yari biaria handayagobi andagaha wiarubi lamiai hene. Kini ibugua bi ogoni hale howa ibuguabi keba timbuni hene.
Horo ogoningi dege Tiribo ibu ohalu ibida iba sibi piyagoha pora bialu Odosia tano wiagoha pale pene.
Kini ibugua agali Sendebeusu heagohondo ami agali geni pialu wai biaga dewabi maru nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga hearubi talebu mialu dindi iba solowara bedagoha ngarunaga gabumane haguane hole pu lene.
Ani lowa Sendebeusuhondo Yuda wali agali baba wai bibe lene. Ani bialu Kederono tano baya hangu arema bialu wai pabe pangaru baya hangu hongohe wabu helalu bibe lene. Wai bulenaga manda buwa ani lene. Ani lalu kini ibunime Tiribo talima pene.
Sendebeusu ibugua pialu Yabane tano wiagoria anda puwa anda bu hearu bo gialapaya bialu mbirale wiaru mo ko howa bo labu halu hene. Ani bialu Yudia dindiha anda puwa wali agali dewa minu garabaya bialu bo wahai halu hene.
Ani bialu ibugua Kederono tano mo hongo howa lone arema bialu ibugua ami agali geni piagabi nogo hosini piagabi dewa tano ogoniha howa Yudiaha hariga pedagoha mamage puíbu bialu helonaga ani helene. Ibugua kini kagome bibe lalu lamiyadagua talialu ani bialu hene.
Ai Saimono igini Yone ibu Gese tano wahalu ibugua Sendebeusuhanda bialu heagonaga ibu aba Saimono lamule pene.
Puwa te layago hale howa Saimono ibugua ibu igini kirali Yudasala Yonela olowa libuhondo lamialu lalu, I̱nibi i̱ hamenerubi i̱ aba damene bu hearubi iname Isaraele wali agali biamogo bialu wai bamba i̱na igiri emene hewangi howa bialu haabo henego ayu kemagoni. Iname wai bialu howa Isaraele wali agali waitigi giha howa mo wialu haru dai bigi beremali.
Anidagua biaga henego ai ayu ina mbirale mbira bibe naheore agali miniwiore bedogoni. Ainde i igini kirali agaliore haribidago turu howa i̱na Ngode Datagaliwabehondo ka̱i̱ timbuni laro. Ainde Ngode Datagaliwabehanda libu haru holebirago ai libugua inanaga dindi ngago karulole waitigi ibirago baba wai bule pudaba, lene.
Ani laya handala Yonehanda ami agali daosini dege pira kira (20,000) geni pialu wai biaga hongohe pari wayaliru haru halu nogo hosini biruwa wai biagabi dewa dege haru hene. Tigua Sendebeusu halu ibunaga ami agaliru ngola howa uruni baba wai bule pialu harigani mbi layagola Modeini tanoha palene.
Egerebalene galaki biyagola abale heyalu wai hama dindi tigabi wiagoria pene. Ogoriani ami agali nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga dewaorebi ami agali geni pialu wai biagabi dewa ngola hene. Anigo ogoriani iba mbira peagome libu mo tu wia howa amura haga haga bilene.
Ani biyagola Yone halu ibunaga ami agali biarume puwa waitigi bu hearu handaede ho hene. Ani howa Yone ibugua handalu hearia ami agali biaru waitigi hondowa tigua iba domaede halu wai polene gi hayane hendene. Ani biyago hondowa Yone ibunime pigane pora bialu iba ala domole pene. Ani domalu piyago hondowa ami agali bibahende iba domalu ubaede hai halu pene.
Yonehanda ibunaga ami agali nogo hosini biruwa wai biaga biaru dombeneha helowa ami tidiki helowa lene labolabo helene. Anidagua binidago irane waitigi tinaga nogo hosi dewaore haru heago hondowa anidagua bini.
Tigua pialu pilipe biguli pu lalu puwa Sendebeusu halu ibunaga ami agali hearu bama talima pene. Ogoningi waitigi dewaore timu hai halu dewa wai hamani homai hene. Maru ibida pialu wai pabeanda hongohe Kederono tano wiagoha pene.
Wai ogoniha Yudasa timu hene. Ani ho wia handala ibu hamene Yonehanda waitigi bama talima pialu wai pabeanda hongohe Sendebeusu ibuni haga Kederono tano talima anda pene.

Ani pu bereagola Tolemihanda ibu imane Saimonobi ibu balibuni Madadiasa Yudasala mo hondo hene. Ibugua tihondo ibu andaga dindi emene mbira mini Dugu ibuni mo wini wiagoha nenege ibalimu lene. Ani lowa ibugua tomo timbuni dawalu badi bialu howa agali maru tamuha birado helene.

Ani bialu mani howa Tolemi ibugua o biyadaruninaga te gili bialu kini hale helo yu pelene. Ani bialu dindi ogoni ibugua haru howa handaya holiyanaga ami agali dewaore ibilabe lalu kini hole hale halu bini.
Ani bialu Tolemihanda agali marume Yone bo wahole Gese tano pudaba lalu bini. Ibugua ami agali haru haga agali haguane hearuhondo beba gilibu pelaga bialu, I̱na tí mo turu halu ngolo silibaru dewaore ngigi buliya ibalimu, laga bialu beba gilibu pelaga bini.

Ogoningi Kini Andiogusu halu ibunaga ami agali dewaore haru halu Pesia dindiha piya. Ani piyagola mbirali ibu baba wai biba lalu baede habe naheore pene. Ai Andiogusu halu ibu aria hearu gime wabinigohondo bi pupu wiaga anda heagoha anda piyangi ibugua mbirale gime wabini mini Nanea ogoni dabu bule poradagua piya. Anigo ibu ke̱ howa piya. Ibugua Nanea bi pupu wiaga anda heagoha mbirale bayale wiaru ibu dabuni mo yaradagua mo yule piya.

Ani buwa tini anda panga emene wiado hene wiagoha tagira puwa kini halu ibu aria maru tamuha hearu ege to̱le̱me balu home leneya. Ani bialu agali Naneanaga biabe biaga uruni tigua agali bayarunaga tingini bo budabaga biai halu tinaga haguane dege agali tagiraha de handa andaho heagoria mo batagi hene.
Mbirale bibahende bayale dege biai harigonaga Ngode Datagaliwabe í̠naga mini mo yaraga heneore ngelo. Ani bialu í̠na agali ko uruni homai helarigonaga mini yaraga holene í̠ha wiaabo helo, larama.
Ainde lotu lagane horo timbuni ege mini Kisilebenaga horo pira kirani duria (25) kaware ibiragoni ndobe. Iname horo timbuni tigua mbirale bi pupu wiaga gime wabini Anduane Homogonaga andaha wiago mo wahenegonaga horo mitangiho kemago ainde tígua Anda Nemandaruha Palu Holene Horo mitangi howa turu ho halimu lalu langerema. Ani bialu tigua agali Nehemaia ibu Ngode Datagaliwabenaga anda lone biadai bialu lomabu delaga dabu lone biadai bialu haga agali biagome loma mbira bu delalu hearia ira timbuni minana kululadaga hayago mitangi bialu halimu.
Waitigime ina mamaliru garabaya bu yalu Pesia dindi piyangi agali Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga agali bayale hearume lomabu delaga dabuni ira dene deago aria mbira hedo yalu puwa iba hambiaga uli iba nabere yobi wiagoha hedo do henego manda bilimu. Tigua baya hangu mo do howa wiagola mbiralime ira hedo do hayadago handa walia nahene.
Mali dewaore halu Ngode Datagaliwabehanda horo pongo winidago tagira ibiyagola Pesianaga kini heagome Nehemaia Yarusaleme dai bia lene. Ani layagola Nehemaia ibugua agali loma binigo mo miaga ira dene hedo do henedaru aguane mbira ai kemibe lalu hale ira dene ogoni lone mo pudaba, lene. Ani laya handala tigua taya bu pialu dai buwa lalu ti ira ogoni taya bu waharima dindi gede ndobabi dege uliha wiaria handarima. Ani layagola Nehemaiahanda lalu dindi ogoni aria maru mo yu ibule pudaba lene.
Ai mo yu ibiyagola agali loma binigo mo miaga hearume dindi waru ogoni budaga buwa maru loma bu delaga dabuni ira gabu wini ngagoria wialu maru loma delole ngagoha ha̱i̱ ho ngelaga bidaba lene. Ani layagola tigua bia layago biai hene.
Mani emene howa ni hari beralibame geho winigo ai beraliba pubagi heagola ni hongohe bayale dene. Ani biyagola aube tobane buwa lomabu delaga dabu heagoria ira hungu timbuni kilikulu lalu daga daga biyagola wali agali bu hearu mogo laiho hene.
Irame loma biago wene dalu heangi agali Anduane Homogonaga loma binigo mo miaga hearubi wali agali bu hearubi tigua Anduane Homogohondo bi lalu hene. Yonadana ibugua Anduane Homogohondo bi layagola Nehemaia halu wali agali tigua ladai bulene wiagohayagi ladai bialu hene.
Yonadanahanda Anduane Homogohondo bi ogodagua lene, Ngode Datagaliwabe-o í̠na mbirale bibahende karubi ngarubi wabiai hariya. Mbirale bibahendeme í̠hondo gi hai halu í̠ andaneha hai haga ka. Í̠ hongo haihebi í̠ tigabiorebi howa dara holene irane nawini dara haganeore Ngode Datagaliwabe ke. Í̠ni hangu kiniore howa mbirale bayaleru í̠nime ina ngiaga ke.
